Masaai: Embalunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te nebo nanu, nikirrep enkarna enye te nebo!

English: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
Masaai: nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papa, aime iyie Enkai te keper? Aimintore iyie nkitoriat pooki oo loshon? Enkaina ino etii engolon o enkidimata, ore enkaraki ina meetae oltung'ani likindimaa iyie.

English: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
Masaai: Meetae entoki natelekua eidipa ninye atadaayu; ore enkaraki ina mebikoo karsisisho enye.

English: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkaraki Daudi papaai lino, maas nanu ena too nkolong'i e nkishui ino, kake kalo nanu adung'oo enkitoria te nkaina o layioni lino.

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: Neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eilo asar lenye neyieng ninye te kutuk aji eilo ng'obor le ntumo; ore lelo ayiok le Aron, lelo apolosak neisuaaki ilo osarge ilo perere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
Masaai: Kaae nelo Yoab enetii olaiguanani, neliki ninye; neipotu ninye Absalom. Neaku eewuo ninye enetii olaiguanani, neirrug kewan te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop te dukuya olaiguanani; neng'utut olaiguanani Absalom.

English: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
Masaai: “Ng'ura ataanyua nanu irorei linono, atoning'o nanu nkirorot inono eng'eno nagut, ina kata ing'oru enijo.

English: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
Masaai: Obo ake olaishooroni loo nkitanapat o ladung'oni le nkiguana naa ninye oidim aitajeu anaa aitarruoi. Aira iyie ng'ae oiguanare olelatia ino?

English: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Masaai: “Shomo tijing'aki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, tiaaki meishoo iltung'ana loo Siraeli meipang'a aapuo te nkop enye.”

English: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
Masaai: Irrinyoki iyie tung'ani meshomo enterit, nijo, “Entorrinyoto, na kera e tung'ana!”

English: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
Masaai: Nji enkuna ti nimayianana iltung'ana le Israel entejo,

English: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?
Masaai: Koree olaiguanani le Hamat, o laiguanani le Arpad, o laiguanani le nkanasa e Sefarfaim o laiguanani le Hena, anaa olaiguanani le Ifaa?’ ”

English: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto e manyisho enye teine, neitu ninche eureyu Olaitoriani ore enkaraki ina neirriwaki Olaitoriani ilng'atunyo atua ninche, neinos lelo ng'atunyo kulikae lenye.

English: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
Masaai: Amu ore te mpiunoto nemeyamishoi, nemeishoori meyami, kake etiu anaa ilmalaika te keper.

English: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa olaiguanani otayiewua neikenisho te nebo isinkan lenyena.

English: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
Masaai: Nejo nkituaak, “Amaa apa pee kipejoki enkorropil enkaiguanani e shumata nikibukoki ninye olasar ooki, aimeyiolo apa ilmoruak lang pee kintayu imukateni naata enkitanyaanyukoto enye nikibukokininye ilasarri ooki?”

English: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
Masaai: Tenelo ake nikidumakino engoro e ilo oitoreisho, milo ake aing'uaa ewueji ino e siai, amu ore nena torrok kindimi aatapalaki tinigira aitirring'a.

English: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
Masaai: Neitanap Olaitoriani Yoshua olayioni le Nuni nejoki, “Tonyuaa nintagol oshoke; amu eilo iyie ayau nkera e Israel atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho ninche. Kaaku nanu tenebo iyie.”

English: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
Masaai: Ing'uesi o nkishu pooki, ntokitin naaiserpepiari te nkop o motonyi naapuo tiaai!

English: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
Masaai: Neitoki alo saa uni, netum kulikae eitashoo te nemirishoreki meeta esiaai,

English: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
Masaai: Neitashe arumaki ninye kop nearaa ilo kirobi, nepuku olkirobi aing'uaa. Neinyototo nabo kata aisiaai ninche.

English: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
Masaai: Ore too nkedeta oo Lawi neitashe Yeshua o Bani, o Kadmeil, o Shebania o Buni, o Sherebia, o Bani, o Kenani; nebuaku ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
Masaai: Neriku too lalashera lenyena ltung'ana imiet arikoki Farao.

English: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Beria: ile Heberi, olmarei loo le Heberi; ile Malkiel, olmarei loo le Malkiel.

English: And having an high priest over the house of God;
Masaai: nikiaata sii olapolosani kitok oitore enkaji e Enkai;

English: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
Masaai: Tenaiken nanu keper ometaa meetae enchan, anaa aitanap olmaati pee emut enkop, anaa airriu olmeitai atua iltung'ana laainei,

English: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
Masaai: Netesheta ninche olperere lo lasar te wueji neika neji Tofel, ina natii oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, pee etum aatapejoi ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye tiatua ina kima neitu nanu aitanap ninche neitu elotu atua ndamunot aainei.

English: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitarasaa ilo meregesh lo lasar opejori neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena nkaik enye endukuya eilo meregesh.

English: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
Masaai: Nchoo eisis ninche ninye te umata oo ltung'ana, neisis ninye ti atua eumata oo lpayiani.

English: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie nkiguanat e keper? Indim iyie aitasheyie enkitoria enye te nkop?

English: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
Masaai: Enkai ai, endapidapoi ai, laa ninye esarunoto ai elong'o ai o emowuo enjeunoto ai, oltim lai o enkisudoroto ai, Olaitajeunoni lai; kintajeu iyie nanu aitung'uaa entorroni.

English: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.
Masaai: Aime enkolong e nkisampuare e nkano ena olong? Ee, kaipot nanu Olaitoriani pee etum airriu endarata o enchan; niyiolouu nidolidolo aajo aikitok esuujisho inyi, apa nitaasa too nkonyek o Laitoriani, inkilikuanakiki ate olaiguanani.”

English: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
Masaai: Abraham apa menye le Isaak. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Isaak, Esau o Israel.

English: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.
Masaai: Kake te najoki nanu ilo barnoti, ‘Ng'ura etii mbaa te idia alo iyie;’ shomo, amu Olaitoriani likirriwayie iyie shomo.

English: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
Masaai: etoito nchorroi e Nimrim; netoito nkujit nemeetae inaabulu, meekure eetae nkaitubulu.

English: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
Masaai: ore too nkoitoi neishopo ilkuniyiani; ore too nchumat oo nkajijik o too nkisiajat eishirita pooki ng'ae netashala too lkiyio.

English: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajo, “Eyakaki nanu olalem.” Neaku eyauaki olalem dukuya olaiguanani.

English: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
Masaai: o Shumot le Harod, o Heles le Peloni,

English: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong negeluno neisikarra Herode aishop ilkilani le nkitoo, neton to lorika le nkitoo, neirorie olorere.

English: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
Masaai: Kake ore etaa keitorito enkewarie eomonito Paulo o Sila neranyaki Enkai isinkoliotin; neinining'ito ilooena ninche;

English: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
Masaai: Neiteru Yesu ajoki, “Enteng'enuoto meitapong'oo intae oltung'ani.

English: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
Masaai: neaku entoning intae ilairritak ororei lo Laitoriani:

English: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
Masaai: Iyamishe aata enkitok? Mijo oi alakuno pee maata. Ira ilo lemeeta enkitok naenikino? Ming'oru naa enkitok.

English: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
Masaai: Te ine kitudumunye nikimanaa o metabau Regio; enkolong nabo ake nashomo nedumunye osiwuo le moikuape ore te nkolong e are nikipuonu Puteoli.

English: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
Masaai: Amu eitagoro ninche ninye te nena wuejitin enye neeika; nepik ninche ninye olom te nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno.

English: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
Masaai: Newal lelo le Gad o lelo le Ruben aajo, “Ore anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani isinkan linono, ina kipuo aas.

English: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
Masaai: o Elienai o Siletia o Eliel,

English: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
Masaai: Neing'oru ake kulikae asirak o Lfarisayo embae naitang'orie Yesu aajo eitarruoyie; nejur pee edol te naa keeta oltung'ani oishiunye te nkolong e sabato.

English: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling place for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
Masaai: naa keaku Babilon osototi loo suut neaku emanyisho oo mbariak ewueji olkirutoto o enking'asia nememanya tung'ani.

English: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
Masaai: Meing'uaa eng'udi e nkitoria enkaji e Yuda, arashu orinka le nkitoria empolos oo nkejek enyena, ometaba anaa nebaiki ninye olopeny, neaku enenye enkanyit oo iltung'ana pooki.

English: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
Masaai: “ ‘Atejo apa nanu kebaa ayieu nanu naapik atua ilaiyiok laainei, naaisho iyie enkop sidai, ina jung'ore nalang nkuapi pooki. Najo nanu eikijo iyie papa lai, nimimbelekenyanya te sujata ai.

English: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
Masaai: ore pee eilepu enkolong nepej, naa ore amu meeta ntana netoyu.

English: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nimiasiasa esiaai nagol nintarasakiki Olaitoriani olasar opejori te nkima.”

English: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
Masaai: ore ina kata neitashe ilkerubi te nkalo e kopikop eina aji, ore peyie ejing oltung'ani atua; neiput enkatampoi olodung'oro liatua.

English: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
Masaai: Kaitame nanu lelo oobikito tiatua enkop e Misiri anaa enaidipa aitamio Yerusalem, to lalem to lameyu o to lmeitai,

English: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia keaku ninche isinkan lenyena. Pee etum ninche aatayiolo enkisiaayiare ai o enkisiaayiare oo nkitoriat oo nkuapi.”

English: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oikulu oyukoki oina muro naishoruaki indimidimi aainosa te pooki wueji nemeiduruk, iyie o layiok linono o ntoyie inono tenebo iyie, amu eishoruaki ninche anaa erubata ino o erubata oo layiok linono te lelo asarri le seriani loo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
Masaai: Na kitok, ai ti aji iyiolo te naa aiyie naitajeu olpayian lino? Lo payian, ai ti aji iyiolo te naa iyie oitajeu enkitok ino?

English: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Negorokino taa ilo asurai ina kitok nelo aitainye olarrabal eishoi natelekua e ina kitok, lelo pooki leton eibung'ita nkitanapat e Enkai, neishakenoki Yesu. Neitashe ninye to sinyai le naiposha.

English: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
Masaai: Neitayu Yonatan olkila apa oishopito neisho Daudi, o masaa enyena, o lalem lenye o enkawuo o enkimeita enye.

English: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
Masaai: Atayiolo apa nanu moitie te nchakenisho ino nchere ntobira apa ninche ntarasi.

English: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
Masaai: Ore Shimei olayioni le Gera, ilo lo losho le Benchamen, oing'uaa Bahurim, neisarisaru adou te nebo iltung'ana le Yuda pee enang'are olaiguanani Daudi;

English: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
Masaai: Najo apa nanu, ‘Ore pee eidip ataasa kuna pooki naashukokino nanu kake eitu ninye eshukunye,’ ore ina anashe enye nemeisiligayu Yuda nedol ina.

English: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
Masaai: Nchooi iyie kuna te nebo olasar opejori le tadekenya, laa olasar le mpejoroto le anaake.

English: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
Masaai: Ore ilusien enyena, o lgorieti enyena, tenebo iltuka lenyena naa erisiori nabo anaa lelo leina kishomi ina naing'orita enkalo oloosaen; naa inkedeta naapishana ninche naailepaki ine; netii olgoriet atua ine.

English: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
Masaai: Entayiolo ake duoo intae te nkitisipata nchere tenikiariara nanu matua, niyauu osarge lemeeta eleyiata shumata intae maate o shumata ena anasa o lelo oomanya, amu ore te sipata o Laitoriani laairriwua nanu enitii pee airo kulo rorei pooki ootii nkiyiaa inyi.”

English: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
Masaai: Nadumu ilo piyayati le mbuku te nkaina e ilo lmalaika, nanya. Naa kemelok anaa enaisho te nkutuk ai, kake ore ake pee aidip ainosa neitaduar enkoshoke ai.

English: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
Masaai: Neitoki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel auma te Shilo nepik olng'obor le ntumo ine; neirrag apa ina kop naibung'aki te dukuya ninche.

English: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.
Masaai: Kake eibung'a ninye irrekiei loo laiguanak le Israel. Eitobira doi ninye nkitanyaanyukot o ntokitin naatosholaki aaitobiraki Baal.

English: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong napolosisho Elkana, neisho ninye irubat Penina, enkitok enye o layiok lenyena pooki o ntoyie enyena;

English: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
Masaai: Naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani edumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaidur, naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani sii eun ninche ilng'oborri; ore te nkata naba anaa enabik enkatampoi te nchumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, nebik ninche too lng'oborri.

English: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Iwa ile Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki ti atua iltung'ana le Israel, o nkishu oo le Lawi te rishata oo nkishu enye; neaku Ilawi ilaainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
Masaai: Amu eetae Enkai nabo, naa obo olaitutumoni le Enkai o ltung'ana, oltung'ani oji Kristo Yesu,

English: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
Masaai: Eing'orita apa Musa ntare o laputani lenye oji Yesro, laa olapolosani le Midian, nerikoo eluaata enye aipirie enkalo o loontoluo le Midian, nelotu ewueji neji Horeb ilo doinyo le Nkai.

English: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
Masaai: Neaku ore pooki wueji nelo, too nkang'itie, too nkanas kituaak, o te ina kop, nerikokini iloomueyiaa aairragie too wuejitin neemirishoreki, nesai Yesu meisho eiseyie ninye olcholoi lo lkila lenye; ore lelo pooki ooiseyie neishiunyeki.

English: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
Masaai: Kake eishoo ninche Lyahudi te nkaraki olom nepuo aasotu ilarruok olwushuush too neemirishoreki, nesotu esiamo neliman ina anasa pooki; nerasaki enkaji e Yason, ejo pee erikoki ninche lelo tung'ana.

English: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
Masaai: ore ntamesin enye naa iip ong'uan o tomoni uni o imiet, ore isirkon lenye naa nkalifuni ile o iip naapishana o tikitam.

English: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
Masaai: Nadol nanu lelo malaika oopishana, ooitashe te dukuya Enkai, neishori ninche ntarumpetani naapishana.

English: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ti ong'ata oiseyie ilo otasesekuanaki to lalem, aashu olmeneng'ani, aashu oloito lo ltung'ani, aashu enkurare neaku olemesinya nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
Masaai: eton meetae hoo ilkeek te nkop anaa nkaitubulu naabulu tiong'ota eton eitu eisho Olaitoriani enkop menoto enchan, nemeetae sii apa oltung'ani otur enkop.

English: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
Masaai: Kisiaayia iyiook Misiri o Asiria, pee kitum endaa naraposh iyiook.

English: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
Masaai: Nebik ilarin aare oolulung'a te ine, te nkaji enye naisilenuo, neng'amu lelo pooki ooetuo enetii ninye.

English: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo Shalom olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, laa ninye oitoreisho te rishata e Yosia papaai lenye. Naa ninye oshomo aing'uaa ewueji enye: “Meitoki aekata ninye ashukunye ene,

English: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
Masaai: Naa ore sii ninche lelo kulikae, te neibelekenya aapal ina neitu eiruk, kerubakini sii ninche, amu keeta Enkai engolon naitoki arubakinye ninche.

English: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
Masaai: Enkosholai nemeeta tipat ninche, amu etanya Olaitoriani ninche.

English: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
Masaai: Shomo teina oitoi pooki nikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino, pee itum atopuaa, nitum sii ataseriana, nitumutumu aatobikoi tiatua ina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani.

English: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
Masaai: Aaisilisil nanu ilkituaak metii emporeet, kake eitashe oltau lai eanyit irorei linono.

English: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Masaai: Neitayu imbokishi naanapieki o lerai, nemur ninche te sahabu,

English: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
Masaai: Kake etanya ninye ina kikoo oo lpayiani, neing'oru enkikoo oo lbarnot le risiori enye.

English: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
Masaai: Meeu eseriani isunta inono, nelotu erripoto atua iltaleta inono!”

English: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD, in Hebron.
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin oong'uan nejoki Absalom olaiguanani, “Aatasayia nchooki nanu mashomo alak olmumai apa lainosa to Laitoriani, te Hebron.

English: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

English: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
Masaai: Ore tiapa, nirorie iyie te nduaata, ilo lino oisiligayu nijo, “Atipika nanu enkopiyia e nkitoo endukuya e obo magilani, aishoo nanu enkitoo ilo otegelutua iltung'ana.

English: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

English: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore nanu ele aikooni nataa apa olaiguanani oitasheiki Isiraeli te Yerusalem.

English: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eisumi entashati e mpalai o laiguanani Artaserser te dukuya Rehum o Shimshai olaigeroni o lelo le ncholuek enye, neisarrisar aapuo enetii Ilyahudi te Yerusalem ore te nkisikong'ata o te ngolon neitapal ninche esiaai.

English: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
Masaai: Neyiolou taa te ina kata ilooiteng'eni aajo Yohana Olaibatisani eimaka.

English: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
Masaai: Ore ake etiu neijia, neitamok ate enturuaisho neirrang'irrang aaruk inkajijik, neme neijia ake, kake eeta sii olmarenke o enkilepilep nekurrisho neiro mbaa nemeishiaakino neiro.

English: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
Masaai: Naya apa nanu papaai linyi Abraham aitayu te lido kekun olkeju narik nanu ninye ti atua enkop e Kanaan pooki; naitubul eishoi enye aitaa kumok. Aishoo nanu ninye Isaak;

English: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the LORD liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the LORD'S anointed. And now see where the king's spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.
Masaai: Ore ena toki nitaasa iyie neme sidai. Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kinchiaakinore iyie niye, enkaraki neitu iyie irrip olkitok ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput. Naa ore taata ing'ura enetii empere o laiguanani, o ina moti e nkare duoo natii embata endukuya enye.”

English: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
Masaai: Amu aainosa nanu olom te nkaraki enkaji ino, ore nena sukenyat e lelo likisukeny iyie, naatadoikitio nanu.

English: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
Masaai: Olalejani oltau alang ntokitin pooki, naa torrono oleng. Kaing'ae oidim atayiolo ninye?

English: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
Masaai: Neaku ore pee enyikaki Betfage o Betania, to ildoinyo oji oloo Loirienito, neirriwaa ilooiteng'eni lenyena aare,

English: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

English: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

Masaai: Ore lelo ooure Olaitoriani, neiro maate, naa keirrugoki Olaitoriani ninche enkiok ainining ninche. Neigeri embuku nadamunyeki te dukuya ninye, o lelo pooki ooure Olaitoriani, neing'oru sii enkarna enye.

English: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
Masaai: Neme too nkaik eisiaai ninye, anaa keeta ae toki nayieu, naa ninye sii doi oisho pooki ng'ae enkishui, o enkiyang'et, o pooki toki.

English: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
Masaai: “Wootu, matorrinyokinoto Olaitoriani; amu etopolosa pee etum aishiunye iyiook; etoosho ninye naa kelo aen iyiook.

English: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
Masaai: Enchom irara ng'eni ti alo lelo ootii auluo entaasishore inkat pooki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Manase, o enkomono enye e Nkai enye, o rorei le lelo aduaak apa oirorie ninye te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai e Israel, etii atua ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Masaai: Eeta sii apa Noa ilayiok o kuni, Shem, o Ham o Yafet.

English: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

English: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
Masaai: “Itoning'o aajo etejoki, ‘Miloloito.’

English: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Shomo enetii olelatia ino toomonu imasaa e aji to lelatia ino pooki, imasaa nemetii toki naa kumok.

English: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
Masaai: Te neme Enkai eing'uaa ele tung'ani meidim ataasa toki.”

English: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
Masaai: Nejoki ilgibioni ninye, “Mme mbae e nkosholai arashu sahabu erishata ang o Saul arashu enkaji enye; neme enaang pee kiar oltung'ani metua te Israel.” Nejo ninye, “Ijojo intae pee aitaas aa nanu intae?”

English: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Rehoboam, neye anaa loo menye nenukari too nkuraren oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Naama e Amon. neitoreisho Abijam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
Masaai: Eiroroki sii intae Gayo laa enkaji enye atii, o Erasto olashumani le nkanasa, o lalashera lang Kuarto.

English: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Finehas ilo apolosani ayioni le Eliesa ile Ruben o le Gad, o le Manase, “Kiyiolo iyiook, ena olong aajo etii Olaitoriani atua iyiook, amu eitu intae iasiasa ena kitarruoroto to Laitoriani; ore taata intajeutuo intae iltung'ana le Israel te nkaina o Laitoriani.”

English: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
Masaai: te naimutie niyiolou enaishiaakino neas oltung'ani ti atua enkaji e Enkai. Naa ninye esirit e Enkai naishu, ninye eng'ape, o lkitamanyunoto loo sipat.

English: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, kumok iloibonok le Nkai o ltung'ana supati oong'uar apa pee edol kuna baa nidolitata intae, neitu edol, o pee ening kuna baa nining'ining'i intae, neitu ening.

English: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
Masaai: Niya embata o sarge lo loing'oni nipik imowuarak olperere lo lasar to lkimojino lino; ore olikae sarge mbukoi ti abori olperere lo lasar.

English: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
Masaai: Amu aisidai eng'eno nagut alang isoito oogol enkinyiang'a ore pooki naaba anaa ining'uar, meidimi aaitanyaanyukie ninye.

English: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
Masaai: te nkaraki emukate e nkitoduaaroto, o lasar le ntapa le anaake, o lasar opejori le anaake, o sabatoni, o lapaitin ng'ejuko, o siruai gelunot, o ntokitin sinyat, o lasarri le ng'oki ooitobirieki olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki Isirael, o te nkaraki esiaai pooki e Nkai ang.

English: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
Masaai: Etamanya apa ilayiok le Gad aatashare ninche te nkop e Bashan ometabaiki Saleka.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Emileja maate, ijojo, “Kepuo Ilkaldayo aaing'uaa iyiook,” amu mepuo ninche aaing'uaa iyiook.

English: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
Masaai: lemetum inkatitin iip taata te na kata, aa nkajijik o lalashera o nkanashera o noo ng'otonye o nkera o nkurman te nebo oloisilisili, naa ore te idia kata nalotu netum enkishui nemeish.

English: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche ilmareita le Yuda te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o ile o iip imiet.

English: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
Masaai: Anaa enaiturrurru iltung'ana enkosholai o suyai o esekenkei o risasi o empirbil nepik atua olkokuet peyie ekutaki ninche enkima shumata ninye peyie etum aatoshol ninye; neaku kaiturrurru intaete ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi, napik intae atua ashol intae.

English: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Solomon aye tenebo loo menye, nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye; neitoreisho Rehoboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

English: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Ritma nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Rimon-peres.

English: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
Masaai: Entaboi torrono oleng nataase tiatua ena kop;

Masaai: Nemir Olaitoriani Sisera o ngarrin enyena pooki o enjore enye pooki te dukuya Barak nepik enepi olalem; nedou Sisera te ngarri enye neisik alo too nkejek.

English: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
Masaai: nchoo eyiolou olaiguanani nchere, ore ilapa Yahudi ooetuo eing'ua enitii, nepuonu enikitii neshomo Yerusalem. Enyaakita aashet enapa anasa kiserut e ntorroni; eidipa ninche isunta neramita ilkitamanyunot.

English: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
Masaai: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani lo tung'ana le Israel; amu eeta Olaitoriani olarrabal too ltung'ana lena kop. Metii esipata aashu esupatisho, nemetii eyiolounoto e Nkai ena kop.

English: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Nesujaki ninye Gebai, o Saalai, iltung'ana iip naaudo o tikitam o isiet.

English: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

English: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,

English: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
Masaai: neijia sii etiu inkituaak, inchoo ekus ate aaiririki te ng'eno o too lkilani ooishiaakino, neme te enchetata oo lpapit aashu te sahabu aashu too lului, aashu too nkilani naagol enkinyang'a

English: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
Masaai: o loom imiet te nkae shoto e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, o loom imiet too rubat e ilo ng'obor le Nkai tioriong te nkalo o loontoluo.

English: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

English: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

English: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

English: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

English: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Masaai: Neranyaki Musa o ltung'ana loo Siraeli Olaitoriani ele sinkolio ejo, “Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani, amu etimirishe oleng; ore embarta o lakedoni lenye etanang'aka atua enaiposha.

English: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

English: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Metaa mme intae apa likirriutua ene kake Enkai; naaeuo aaitaa menye le Farao, naaku olkitok le nkaji enye pooki o loitore e nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

Masaai: Eitu eas Samaria olpisiai loo ng'ok inono; itaasa intae imbaa kumok olminong aalang ninche, nintaa nkanashera inyi inaalioo aa supati ti atua nena baa pooki olminong nitaasa.

English: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
Masaai: o Amam, o Shema, o Molada,

English: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

English: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.

Masaai: Ainyoo italaita nanoto nkulie sirito, ai neme ena nchere eitu aaku olola te ntae? Entapalakaki ena kitadiaata!

English: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
Masaai: Etishipakine apa Olaitoriani nchere ena bae etoomono Solomon.

English: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi o lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootii te nebo ninye nepuonu ninche oreyiet te Besor, ina netonie lelo ooing'uari te siadi.

English: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
Masaai: nena ng'apeta pokira are, o lbakulini, o nena opiyiani naaishopokino, oina siaai oo usin naaripunyeki nkarash are naaimulumulieki nena girran naatii nchumat e nena ng'apeta;

English: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
Masaai: Etii inkiyiaa enyena iltoiloishi ooitureisho; ore etudupe, nelotu oloidaikie shumata ninye.

English: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

English: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
