English: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Shela ilarin tomoni uni, etaa ninye menye le Eber.

English: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
Masaai: Neya Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin apa ootii tenebo ninye lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootarayie Ishmael olayioni le Netania aitung'uaa Mispa ina kata pee eidip atasesekuana Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam o sikarini, o nkituaak, o nkera, o sunaishi oo gelema apa ooyaua Yohanan ashuku te Gibeon.

English: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
Masaai: Amu kening olaiguanani, nekordu esinka enye aitung'uaa enkaina o ltung'ani laaidim ainyala nanu o layioni lai te nebo aitung'uaa enjung'ore e Nkai.’

English: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
Masaai: Kake etiaka, “Eewuo olalashe lino to losek, neewa emayianata ino.”

English: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ng'otonye, eitashe te ine, o oloiteng'eni apa onyor, nejoki Yesu ng'otonye, “Yieyio, ng'ura enkerai ino.”

English: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche Yesu aajoki, “Mikiyiolo.” Nejoki sii ninye, “Maliki sii nanu intae enkidimata naasie kuna baa.

English: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD'S hand double for all her sins.
Masaai: Irorie Yerusalem te mborron, ninchiraki ninye tiaaki eisha olarrabal lenye, netapalakaki ninye ing'ok enyena, amu etang'amua apa ninye te nkaina o Laitoriani enkitalakunoto oo ng'ok enyena katitin are.

English: In your patience possess ye your souls.
Masaai: Kake te ng'iriata inyi itumutumu enkishui.

English: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
Masaai: “Meari ilpayiani metuata te nkaraki nkera enye, nemeari nkera metuata te nkaraki iloo menye; oltung'ani ake neari metua te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.

English: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.
Masaai: Ore apa etobiko Daudi te nkaji enye, nejoki ninye Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai, “Ng'ura, abikito nanu tiatua enkaji oo ltarakua, kake ore osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani naa olng'obor etii.”

English: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
Masaai: nejo, “Maatalama nanu ena te dukuya Olaitoriani tenaa kaas ena. Kaok nanu osarge le nkishui le kulo lewa? amu etipika ninche enkishui enye batisho pee eyau.” Kuna baa etaasa lelo tung'ana okuni magil.

English: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
Masaai: Keitu iyie iyiolou? Keitu iyie ining? Keitu apa kilikini iyie te nkiterunoto? Keitu apa iyiolou iyie ebaiki olkitamanyunoto le nkop?

English: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
Masaai: Neaku eiruko lkumok lene te nkaraki ina, o meiruko sii ninche nkituaak neme kuti naa nkarikok o Lyunani, o lewa leme kuti sii ninche.

English: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aitanapisho, neyauni Daniel nenang'akini atua eululu oo lng'atunyo. Nejoki olaiguanani Daniel, “Inchoo Enkai ino, ina nisiaaita anaake kikordu iyie!”

English: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Asheri, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
Masaai: Ekaaitagol iyie te nkutuk ai, ore enkitagoloto e nkiroroto ai neiwuang'ie emion ino.

English: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
Masaai: Neiko neijia, neyaki lpayiani too nkaik e Barnaba o Saulo.

English: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eyae Esta enetii olaiguanani Serser, ti atua enkaji enye e nkitoo to lapa le tomon, laa ninye olapa le Tebes to lari li opishana le nkitoria enye,

English: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche olasar lo lning'o lo sotua too nkolong'i naapishana te nkaraki olperere lo lasar aipok ninye aitisiny, neiteng'elakini ninye.

English: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Entotona ltung'ana.” Etii ine wueji nkujit kumok, netoni taa lewa, nebaya esiana nkalifuni miet.

English: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
Masaai: Ore ilpapit ooibor te ndukuya naa enkopiyia e nkitoo, etumi ninche te nkishui naitoriori.

English: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
Masaai: Ore te nkinosata e ina daa napolosakini enkitanyaanyukoto naitaai enkai “neme toki te nkop,” nikiyiolo aajo, “meetae ae Ai neme nabo ake.”

English: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoida olapolosani aisho ilarikok le njore iremeta o long'oi dapashi o nkutiti apa naara ino laiguanani Daudi, naa atua enkaji e Nkai etii.

English: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
Masaai: amu etoduaa pooki ninye, neiputukuny. Kake eirorie nabo kata nejoki, “Entagoluoto, nanu doi, emiureisho.”

English: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening kuna baa, neminisu neonyiki lala te ngoro.

English: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
Masaai: niaanyunyu Oinoti lenye eing'uaa shumata, ilo oitopiwuo ninye aitung'uaa lootuata, Yesu laa ninye olaku iyiook aitung'uaa engoro nalotu.

English: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
Masaai: nening menye ilo mumai lenye, o ina natejo ninye, nateenie ninye kewan, nemejoki ninye ae, ore ilo mumai lenye pooki neunoyu. Ore pooki natejo ninye aen kewan neunoyu.

English: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
Masaai: ore ake pee eidip iltung'ana pooki aatalang, nelang ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani o lapolosak te dukuya lelo tung'ana.

English: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana pooki leina kop aapuo enkaji e Baal neuroo ninye, o lperereni lenyena loo lasarri, ore nkitanyaanyukot enyena nebel aaitaa mbelibelat. Near Matan ilo apolosani le Baal metua te dukuya lelo pereren loo lasarri. Nepik ilo apolosani ilarripok ooing'or enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Musa ajo meekure eitoriayu iltung'ana (etapalayie Aron metaa meitoriayu, aitukurru ninche ti atua ilmang'ati lenye),

English: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
Masaai: nejoki, “Ing'oru olmonekie to Laitoriani Enkai ino; nchoo egutu anaa enemeneng'a aashu eado abaiki keper.”

English: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo litegelua iyie niyau aitinyiku, pee eton ti atua indung'orot inono! Eikindipakino iyiook te supatisho e nkaji ino, ina aji ino sinyati!

English: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Masaai: Etoyu nkujit nerrarrarri ntapuka; kake ore ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai ang neuno ntarasi.

English: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
Masaai: Near ninche metua enkoliai o ilo tung'ani omoni, nesesekuan ilo okishi;

English: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
Masaai: Amu ketaa kayieu napaji naa nanu makewan edeki naadung'ori aarishie Kristo te nkaraki lalashera, laainei entalipa o lorere lai.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo olaiguanani le Asiria, melotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, anaa engoroo embae teine, anaa elotu ataanikini ninye eeta elong'o, anaa elotu aman ang'adu.

English: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
Masaai: Neirorie Saul Yonatan, olayioni lenye, o lelo sinkan lenyena pooki, nchere pee ear ninche Daudi metua. Kake ore Yonatan, olayioni le Saul, keshipakino apa Daudi oleng.

English: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o miet le nkitoria o laiguanani kitok oji Tiberia Kaisaria, aa Pontio Pilato olbalusui le Yudea, naa Herode olkitok le Galilaya, naa Filipo olalashe lenye olkitok le Iturea o Trikoniti, naa Lisenias olkitok le Abilene,

English: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
Masaai: Nedung ilooiteng'eni anaa ake enaidima oltung'ani, aajo keirriwaki eretoto ilalashera oomanya Yudea.

English: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yosia naa: Yohanan olkikau lenye, ore oliare naa Yehoiakim, ore oliokuni naa Sedekia, ore oliong'uan naa Shulum.

English: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
Masaai: ore irrekiei lenye naa enkidaaroto o sinaitin,

English: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
Masaai: toning'o ake iyie itii keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo ltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, nirrinyu ninche menyaaki aapuonu ina kop apa ninchoo ninche o loo menye.

English: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
Masaai: Ore ake pee errinyunye Abna Hebron, neya Yoab ninye enkilepata te mpolos e kishomi pee eiro te nebo ninye too nkurrat, ore te ine nerem ninye enkoshoke, neye ninye, te nkaraki ilo sarge le Asahel olalashe lenye.

English: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Naftali aaipang'ie lelo oomanya Bet-she-mesh, aashu lelo oomanya Bet-anat, kake etobiko ninche ti atua lelo Kanaani oomanya ina kop; ore ake eyia, ore lelo oomanya Bet-she-mesh, o le Bet-anat netaa ilenkisiaayiare nagol te ninche.

English: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
Masaai: Kake etumuta Daniel nchere meyieu neisarkionie kewan te ndaa o laiguanani aashu te ina aisho oo sabibu apa naok ninye; neaku eikilikuana apa ninye ilo kitok loo laitasheikinok loo sunaishi oogelema pee enyorraa ninye, pee meisarkionie kewan.

English: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
Masaai: Airorie intae anaa ltung'ana ooning'u mbaa; eng'uanare intae kuna najo.

English: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
Masaai: ore kipuo te nkoitoi, ore ewueji nikirraga nikibol ilbenia lang, nemeeta olbene hoo obo lemetii irridat loo mpisai enkutuk olbene lenye, eba ake impisai anaa apake; neaku kitorrinyutuo pooki,

English: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
Masaai: Te neaku ilo rrekie loo Nkitanapat laturoyie aitoki aitasheyie, neitoduaaya naa ina nchere kesipa kara olotigila nkitanapat.

English: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
Masaai: amu ore lelo oorikoo ele orere naa keitapong'oo ninche, ore lelo oorikori naa keijori.

English: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
Masaai: Niya isoito are barrikon naaji oniks niguetaki asiraki ninche nkarn oo layiok le Israel,

English: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
Masaai: ore pee eibung osiwuo ina meli nelaikino emeli aitoriokinore, nikipalaa meterewa iyiook.

English: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
Masaai: maiken nanu nkonyek aainei airura nemaimug aimul nkonyek aainei,

English: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
Masaai: Kake eidipaki aaela ninche intae ilo Obo Sinyati, niyiololo pooki.

English: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ematua pooki e tomon oo nkishu aashu inoo nkerrai, ore eng'ues pooki e tomon e nena pooki naaim abori eng'udi olchekut, naa keaku sinyati to Laitoriani.

English: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
Masaai: Ore peyie kijoki iltung'ana linono, ‘Aimintodol iyie iyiook enautu ena?’

English: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Neaku intarasakiki sii intae Olaitoriani olasar oing'uaa nena matuan inyi e tomon, ning'amumu too ltung'ana le Israel. Naa ore te nena ninchosho ilo asar lo Laitoriani Aron ilo apolosani.

English: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
Masaai: lelo payiani kituaak ooyanyit ninche endukuya, ore ilo oiboni oibonisho te lejare ninye olkidong'oe;

English: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
Masaai: “Teneas oltung'ani ake duoo eng'oki eitu eotiki aas ae nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi, neaku oloitarruoyie,

English: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya neigeroki Daudi Yoab empalai, neirriwaa te nkaina e Uria.

English: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ninye olorere netum olng'ur te ninche amu eteekate ninche, nelepori neidapashari netiu anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut.

English: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Enchoo naa eaku anaa enitejo; ore ake olotumi eeta neaku orrindik lai, ore ilkulikae linyi pooki neaku meeta entioto.”

English: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ketukurrutua apa ninche ina kata apa pee eas mbaa olminong? Aa, eitu ninche ekurru tukul; menya ninche orere. Neaku kebatata ninche tenebo lelo oobatata; ore teina kata naitame nanu ninche, kenang'ari ninche,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
Masaai: Iyie ilo opolos kewan te ngoro ino, keing'uari enkop te nkaraki iyie, arashu eiwuang'ieki endapidapoi aaitung'uaa ewueji enye?

English: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Masaai: neibalunye pooki ng'ejep inchere Yesu Kristo ninye Olaitoriani, te nkitoo e Enkai Papa.

English: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
Masaai: Nidoyio iyie alo Gilgal te dukuya nanu; naa ng'ura, kalotu nanu enitii aitayu olasar opejori napolos olasar le seriani. Too nkolong'i naapishana taanyisho, o metaba anaa nalotu pee aaitodol iyie eniaas.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani: “Kaa torroni enotito loo papaai linyi te nanu pee aashomo aalam nanu, nepuo aasujaa empesho, neaku pesho?

English: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
Masaai: “Metaa emiure ninche amu, meetae embae naisudoyioki nemeyiolouni.

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitima le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;

English: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
Masaai: o Mispe, o Kefira, o Mosa,

English: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
Masaai: Toduaa iyie Enkai, na long'o ang, ing'ura enkomom e ilo lino litubukoko eilata aput!

English: And ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's.
Masaai: Kake irara intae ile Kristo, naa ole Nkai Kristo.

English: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
Masaai: Neyiolou Daudi ajo eitobirita Saul entorroni te nkaraki ninye; nejoki ninye Abiata ilo apolosani, “Iyau ina kila dorrop ene.”

English: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
Masaai: “Embung'a naa nkitanapat aainei pooki o nkiguanat aainei pooki, niasiasa ninche paa ore ina kop nariku nanu intae entamany nemelopu intae aitayu.

English: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye tena kata ng'ura, etii olchakeni lai keper, peyie eitashe terishata ai.

English: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ues narisha loisotok anaa neiperra iloisotok kat are, neinyaku ng'amura tiatua ng'uesi indim ainosa.

English: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
Masaai: Oi naaji aa nkariak ake endukuya ai, naa nkonyek oo lkiyio nkonyek ainei, pee atum nanu aishira dama o kewarie te sesekuanata eina tito oo ltung'ana laainei!

English: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
Masaai: Entayiolo ena nasipa nchere meetae hoo olololoito aashu oloo loirerioni, aashu oloo ng'uarrat torrok (nkitanyaanyukot taa eomon olotiu neijia), otum hoo enjung'ore ti atua enkitoria e Kristo o ene Nkai.

English: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
Masaai: Nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk aajo, “Ene Enkai ang enjeunoto: ina natonita to lorika le nkitoo o ene ilo Kuoo le Ker.”

English: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
Masaai: Nejo Abraham, “Ataasa amu atadamua ajo, metii ene euriata e Nkai katukul, naa kaari enkaraki enkitok ai.

English: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
Masaai: Ore apa Absalom, olayioni le Daudi, neeta enkanashe sidai naji enkarna Tamar; ore pee elusoo enkata, nenyorru ninye Amnon, olayioni le Daudi.

English: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
Masaai: Etesheta apa ninye Elot nerrinyoki ninye Yuda, ina kata eidipa olaiguanani atua.

English: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
Masaai: Nincho ninche meiguenare iltung'ana nkatitin pooki; ore pooki bae sapuk neyau enitii kake ore embae kiti nedung oopeny, pee eleleku te iyie nenap sii ninche olola te nebo iyie.

English: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
Masaai: o Shalum, o Amaria, o Yosef.

English: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
Masaai: Ile nkop ninche, metaa ore ina najo ninche naa ene nkop, naa ninche ening enkop.

English: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
Masaai: Ore too lkikaunot loo ltung'ana le Israel neya iropiyiani, shekeli enkalifu nabo o iip uni o ntomoni ile o imiet, naaitorisiokoki shekeli e wueji sinyati;

English: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
Masaai: Kaing'ae oinining intae tena bae? Amu ore anaa enatiu erubata e ilo olo olarrabal, neijia sii etiu erubata e ilo oton too lolan keng'ar ninche aaitoris.”

English: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
Masaai: Ore ilo siang'au le ntapa neitu aekata etoyu, neitu aekata eishunye ilo tulet le ilata, terisioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani oirorie Eliya.

English: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
Masaai: Ore eton edoyio alo nenang'are isinkan lenyena neliki ninye aajoki, “Eishu enkerai ino.”

English: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Amu, ng'ura kaipotu nanu iloshon pooki loo nkitoriat e moikuape, ejo Olaitoriani, naa kepuonu ninche ore ake pooki te ninche nepik olorika lenye le nkitoo tenejing'ieki nchomito e Yerusalem, aaigaraki isunta enyena pooki naamanita neman sii nkanas pooki e Yuda.

English: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
Masaai: Neishoru sii Daudi isekenke kumok naaitayunyeki ilmushumaani loo nkutukie oo nkajijik o nkikeneta, tenebo osuyai kitok oleng lemeimakinoyu enkiroishi.

English: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya enasirie nedumunye Yoshua nelo ninye Shitimu, te nebo iltung'ana pooki le Israel; nepuonu Yordan, neirrag ninche ine eton eitu elang.

English: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Naftali na Nahabi olayioni le Fopsi;

English: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto o lasipani nejurru enejo te newal, kake ore enkutuk eilo torrono nebuku intokitin torrok.

English: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king's face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana ootashare ninye naa Karshena o Shetar, o Admata, o Tarshish, o Meres, o Marsena, o Memukan, lelo kituaak oopishana le Parsia o Media, ootoduaa enkomom o laiguanani, naa ninche ootang'asa aatoni te nkitoo enye.

English: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake eyaua apa Daudi ilo sanduku le Nkai te Kiriat-Yearim neya ine wueji apa neitobiraka, amu etuuno apa ninye olng'obor tenkaraki ninye te Yerusalem.

English: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn e lelo tung'ana: ore olosho le Yuda, naa Kalebu olayioni le Yefune.

English: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
Masaai: Airraga nanu te mpolos oo lng'atunyo ooinos te nkowuarisho inkera e tung'ana iremeta o mbaa ilala lenye, naa ilalema oopi ilng'ejepa lenye.

English: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
Masaai: Atorikoyie nanu intae ilarin artam tiong'ata neitu emuta ilkilani linyi linchopitoto neitu emutari inamuka too nkejek inyi,

English: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
Masaai: Kake tanya ing'amu aiger inkolia kutiti: amu te nepaashari ninche neyieu neyami,

English: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
Masaai: Nejoki sii ninye ilo oitoomonisho, “Te nincho ltung'ana endaa aashu ntobiraki osirua, mimpot lchoreta linono o lalashera linono o lelo lo lmarei lino aashu lkarsisi le latia ino, pee mikiyooki sii ninche aaitoomon, nikilaaki enda apa nintaasa.

English: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
Masaai: Neaku ore eitayu Sakaria esiaai e mpolosare too nkatitin olkekun lenye te dukuya Enkai,

English: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Isinkan lenyena apa, Yasakar olayioni le Shimet o Yehoshad olayioni le Shomer ootanang'ie ninye enkop, neaku etua ninye nenukari tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Amasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
Masaai: Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Ore ilo tung'ani apa otumuta iyiook neitobir pee eidaikie iyiook, metaa mikitum iyiook ewueji ti atua enkop pooki oo Siraeli.

English: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
Masaai: Ee, ore te nkaraki iyie namir oltim loo lmang'ati; ore te nkaraki Enkai ai naidim aida esuntai.

English: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
Masaai: “Ing'ura etii osotua lai tenebo iyie, naa iyaku menye loo loshon kumok.

English: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
Masaai: “Teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo olelatia enye neinosieki ninye olmumai, nelotu ninye ainos olmumai te dukuya olperere lino lo lasar tiatua ena aji,

English: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nimbung'a araya iloshon kumok, eikimbung iyie aaraya ilo pisiai oleku loo ltung'ana te nkaraki osarge loo ltung'ana o larrabal te nkop, too nkanas e lelo pooki oomanya atua.

English: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
Masaai: Ore lelo olomanya enkop, neshipakino ninche, neitayu isiruai neishoro nkishorot, amu ore kulo oibonok le Enkai pokira aare, naisomita oleng lelo ootii enkop.

English: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
Masaai: ejoki ilo malaika le ile, oata emowuo, “Talaku lelo malaika oong'uan ooena to lkeju sapuk le Frati.”

English: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
Masaai: Indim aitodolu olkep te ninye indim atoomonu ororei te ninye?

English: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
Masaai: Ore teina olong neisho olaiguanani Esta enkaji e Haman, ilo mang'atinta loo lyahudi. Nelotu Mordekai dukuya olaiguanani amu etolikio Esta enabaikinore ninye;

English: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
Masaai: “Ntodolua iyie enyorrata kitok nauno to sinka lino Daudi, papa lai, enkaraki nashomo ninye te dukuya iyie te supatisho, o too sipat o to ltau oitoriori tialo iyie, nimbung'a iyie te ninye ena nyorrata kitok nauno, ninchoo ninye olayioni otonie olorika lenye le nkitoo ena olong.

English: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki Isaak Yakobo, “Wou tinyiku, peyie atum airrapirrapa ajur enkerai ai, matayiolo katukul metii olng'ash ajo ira olayioni lai Esau anaa aimira.”

English: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
Masaai: Naajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna, olkitok lai?”

English: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana, enturrurroto embung'a eumata nasinya; miasiasa esiaai nagol. Enkolong ina te intae nioshiosho imouarak,

English: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
Masaai: Ore enoshi kata eing'asie ninye Petero oleng eiguana makewan aing'oru enajoki ina duaata natamanikia, ng'ura! noolo lang'ole tung'ana ooirriwua Kornelio, ooikilikuanu enkaji e Simon ooitashe te kishomi.

English: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
Masaai: Neas Olaitoriani anaa enaikilikuanua Musa, neiwuang'ie ina mus oo lojong'a te Farao, o too laisiaayiak lenyena o too ltung'ana lenyena; eitu eing'uari obo.

English: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
Masaai: Neiteru Yehoshafat olayioni le Asa aitore Yuda to lari liong'uan le enkitoria e Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli.

English: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
Masaai: Eibatisa sii apa ninye Yohana olorere te Enon nataaniki Salim, amu ai sapuk enkare te ine; naa kepuonu ninche ine meibatisae;

English: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
Masaai: Ore apa pee eidipayu esuntai naidipa nkikeneta oo nchomito, neidipaki aategelu ilarripok loo nchomito, o laranyak, o Lawi,

English: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
Masaai: Ntaa iyie iyiook endung'et e rashe ti atua iloreren, entoki nakueniyieki ti atua iloshon.

English: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
Masaai: Keaku ninye oloip te ndama te nkaraki enkirowuaj, o te nkaraki sii enesaruni o enelutori te nkaraki olkutati o enchan.

English: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol ilalashera le Yosef aajo etua papaai lenye nejo ninche, “Ebaiki taa neibayu iyiook Yosef neitalak iyiook enapa lap nikintaasa iyiook ninye.”

English: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i isiet neitoki aatii lelo ooiteng'eni atua aji, netii Tomas te nebo ninche. Nelotu Yesu eikeno nkutukie e ina aji, neitashe te mpolos nejo, “Entaseriana.”

English: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
Masaai: Neton Yakobo te nkop e Misiri ilarin tomon o oopishana; metaa ore inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui e Yakobo naa iip o artam oopishana.

English: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
Masaai: neing'or Yohana Yesu elo nejo, “Ing'ura olkuoo le ker le Nkai!”

English: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
Masaai: Keaku kenya elejare o nanu tiatua oltau le lelo oibonok ooibonu elejare oltau lenye maate,

English: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
Masaai: “Amu kelo ena atiu anaa nkolong'i e Noa te nanu: ore anaa apa enainosa olmumai nchere meigil nkariak e Noa aapuonu enkop, ainosa sii olmumai nchere maaigil ae kata agorokino, nemaigil ae kata aisikong.

English: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
Masaai: ninko nkituaak moruak anaa noo ng'utunyi, ninko nkituaak kutiti anaa nkanashera inono te sinyatisho pooki.

English: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmarei loo layiok le Noa, te risioroto oo ishoritin enye, too loshon lenye. Naa te kulo eidapashakinote iloshon oriong enkop eidipa atulusoi oloirrag le nkare.

English: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Na kitok, kaa kiatayie neton eng'or enkata ai?”

English: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
Masaai: Nedoli kop e naiposha, neirragieki ilkitamanyunot le nkop meirraga aaibalayu, te nkisikong'ata o Laitoriani, te nkutata e nkiyang'et oo nkumeishin enyena.

English: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa nchoo pooki tung'ani otelekua, te pooki wueji nemanya ninye, eretu ninye iltung'ana le manyisho enye te nkosholai o te sahabu, o too masaa o too ng'uesi, tenebo nena kishorot o lpela tenkaraki ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem.”

English: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
Masaai: Kepuo iltung'ana laainei aabik te manyisho e seriani ntarasi, ti atua ewueji e nkirrita oo wuejitin neeitirring'areki aayeng'iyeng'are.

English: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
Masaai: Ore Eliesa olapolosani neya embata o sarge le ina ashe to lkimojino lenye, neisuaki embata e ilo sarge dukuya e ilo ng'obor le ntumo katitin naapishana.

English: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
Masaai: ore teina olong naa keisiku olaishirani ayaki intae lelo omon.

English: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
Masaai: meekure ening'o Moab. Tiatua Heshbon eitobira ninche entorroni tenkaraki ninye: ‘Wou, maiwuang'ie iyiook ninye meitoki aaku olosho!’ Ore sii intae, lo tung'ana oomoda, keitigiri intae; kesujaa intae olalem.

English: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Yakobo, “Tudumunye ilepa shomo Betel, nilo amany ine; nintobir teine olperere lo lasar, aitaiki Enkai ina nikimpang'aka ina kata apa peyie ilo ailany olalashe lino Esau.”

English: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
Masaai: neyooki alotu olkitok le ilo aisiaayiani to lkekun, lemeiteikini o te saa nemeyioloi, neitame neitaboitaki ilemening'isho.

English: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
Masaai: Ore ilo oning'u ororei naa kebulaa, neshipa oleng ilo oisilig Olaitoriani.

English: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
Masaai: neitadoiki olkimojino lenye le tatene atua ina ilata natii endap enkaina enye e kedienye neisuaaya embata eina ilata to lkimojino lenye katitin naapishana te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
Masaai: Toduaa olonya mimen olemenya, nimidung'oki olemenya enkiguana olonya; amu etang'amua Enkai ninye.

English: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina aaikok iyie naa pee inyiang'u te nanu sahabu natisilaki te nkima, pee itum ataa karsis, ninchop ilkilani ooibor pee eitemoo enkurruna e masipaisho ino, meitokini aadol, o lchani liyelie nkonyek inono pee idolishoyu.

English: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
Masaai: Entoning intae lelo oolakua, ina nataasa nanu; ore intae kulo oolakua, entayiolo enkidimata ai.

English: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
Masaai: Amu ore nkolong'i enyena pooki nebore emion, ore esiaai enye pooki naa oltau eiroshiyie; neijia ninye etiu kewarie meeng'iyeng'a indamunot enyena. Ore sii ninye ena naa ene pesho.

English: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
Masaai: nepiki nena bokishi aaimie lelo giso metaa ketii imbokishi nchot pokira o lperere te nenapi.

English: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
Masaai: Ore peyie epuo ninche, neim enkalo ake nabo te nena ong'uan eitu eibelekenya epuoito, kake ore ake pooki alo neibelekenyakino enkeju engarri e dukuya nesuju nkulie pooki, eitu eibelekenya epuo.

English: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
Masaai: Kake ore olng'arua o lkishankual lenye; nemesila asidanu ekeing'uaa ninche metaa emunyan.

English: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
Masaai: “Ore ntokitin pooki naata inaipuko naapuo too nkejek ong'uan naa olminong te intae.

English: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
Masaai: Kake amaa, kaji eiko iltung'ana te neipot ilo leitu eiruk? Naa kaji eiko te neiruk ninye oleitu ae kata elikini metoning'o? Naa kaji eiko te nening meeta olalikioroni?

English: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.
Masaai: Ilepa shomo Gilead niyau olchani, na selenkei e Misiri! itooko iyie ilkeek kumok pesho; meetae enkishiunoto te iyie.

English: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
Masaai: Eibalunye keper esupatisho enye; neing'or iloreren pooki enkitoo enye.

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Yesu ajoki ninye, “Ore enaasita nimiyiolo iyie taata kake iyooki ayiolou te siadi.”

English: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
Masaai: Kake enotoki tiatua ina anasa oltung'ani aisinani ng'en, neitajeu ilo tung'ani te ng'eno enye enkanasa. Nemeetae hoo obo otadamua ilo tung'ani aisinani;

English: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
Masaai: Eirotoki ninye enkatampoi nairrusha enkare; ore nkatampo neidapash enkiwuang'ata enye.

English: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee edol Isiria aajo etimira Isiraeli ninche, neirriwaa ilkiliku meyauni lelo Siria apa ootii te idia alo olkeju le Frati, tenebo Shofak le njore e Hadadesa te dukuya ninche.

English: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia airorie lelo kituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki ejo, “Olaitoriani, laairriwua maibonoki entorroni ena aji o ena anasa lelo rorei pooki litoning'o.

English: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
Masaai: entuala e sahabu o long'u, nemanaa te ripata e abori olkila.

English: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
Masaai: Netayioloito taata ninche aajo ore pooki nikinchoo naa iyie eing'uaa;

English: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
Masaai: anaa ake enitoduaa nchere etebeluaki osoit to ldoinyo neme te nkaina e tung'ani nerrar ina sekendei, o suyai, o enterit, o enkosholai o ina sahabu. Enkai kitok naitayiolo olaiguanani ina nayooki atiu te siadi. Kedede ina kidetidet nesipa enkibalakinoto enye.”

English: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
Masaai: Radai ole imiet, Osem ole ile

English: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore te nkitoria e Ahasero te nkiterunoto e nkitoria enye, neiger ninche enkitang'oroto te nkaraki lelo oo manya Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
Masaai: “Etagore apa Olaitoriani oleng tenkaraki iloo papaai linyi.

English: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu too ntokitin nemeishu anaa endule aashu enkawuo oo sinkolioitin Te neaku ore eoshitoi, nemening'unoyu osinkolio ooshitoi, kaji eiko pee eyiolouni aajo kalo sinkolio ilo?

English: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neeta pooki rubata ilng'amat are, ooiruburubieki te nebo; neas ninye ena too rubat oosunta pooki e ilo ng'obor le Nkai.

English: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etii apa esuntai namanita ine wueji e oriong netii enkaji e Nkai, ore enkadori e ina tiyani natemishoreki natii enkaina e ilo tung'ani naa intemat ile enkaina enkadori, ore pooki nabo enye naa entemata enkaina nabo o endap te nkadori; metaa etetema ina kirrushai eina suntai, naa entiyani nabo.

English: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
Masaai: Ee, keishoru Olaitoriani ina sidai, ore enkop ang neiu ilng'anayio kumok.

English: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
Masaai: ore tialo nkolati enyena, keisho apa ninye olaiguanani enkishooroto anaake te risioroto eyieunoto enye, ometabaiki enkolong e keeya enye, anaa ake duoo neishu.

English: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
Masaai: Ore Farao tenebo enjore enye kitok tenebo enkumoi enye meidim aataretu ninye to larrabal, ina kata nanang'ari inkang'itie nemani aamuat isunta naateshetaki peyie edung'oo enkishui oo lkumok.

English: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
Masaai: Neitaarriyian ninye nkaik aainei to larrabal, neaku keidim nkaik aatoriuo enkawuo o suyai.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Ahas naataasa eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, tenaa aiyasiasa esupatisho o esipata to lkitok lai entolikioki nanu, naa tinimiasiasa entolikioki nanu peyie atum aibelekenyakinoyu enkaina e tatene arashu kedienye.”

English: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
Masaai: Kake ore iltung'ana supati naa kedung'oki ninche enkiguana edung'oki ninche enkiguana enkiborra enye oo nkonyek, tenebo enkiguana oo nkituaak naaibukoitie osarge; amu inaaibor onyek ninche, netii osarge inkaik enye.”

English: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
Masaai: Keaku ninye tenebo iyie olaisiaayiani lolmushaara o anaa sii olomoni. Eikisiaai ninye iyie ometabau olari le Yubilii;

English: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
Masaai: Neijia etiu empiunoto oo lootuata. Etiu anaa enkantererai, kenukari osesen te nkop eidaaya, neitopiuni te mpukunoto nemeidaaya ai kata.

English: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Aatoomono nanu iyie ntoduaaki enkitoo ino.”

English: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
Masaai: Mme taa ate kintoki aaisisaki intae, intae doi kincho erishata entawuasare iyiook, nitumutumu eniwalikiki lelo oowuasare enkitoo o ltung'ani, neme enatiu oltau lenye.

English: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
Masaai: “ ‘Mintobiraki kewan enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai nagueta, aashu empukunoto e ae toki natii shumata aashu enatii abori enkop, aashu ina natii atua enkare tiabori enkop;

English: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
Masaai: Ore pee edol esiamo ina nataasa Paulo, neilepie ltoiloishi, ejo te nkutuk oo Likonia, “Etadoutuo nkaitin naatiu anaa ltung'ana!”

English: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
Masaai: Kake ore ti atua lelo asarri netii enkitadamunoto oo ng'ok anaa ake te pooki ari.

English: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
Masaai: nejoki ilalashera lenye; “Aatushukokoki nanu impisai aainei, noona naatii enkutuk olbene lai!” Ore ake pee ening ina neikirikira tolkirutoto nerrinyokino maate ejokino, “Kaa bae ena naitaasa iyiook Enkai?”

English: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon Petero ninye, “Lo Kitok, mme naa nkejek aainei ake, kake o nkaik o endukuya ai.”

English: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
Masaai: Ting'iria nchooki nanu mairoro, ore peyie aidip airoro, nisurdaany.

English: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
Masaai: Ore etii ninye ae ang, ng'ura, netii oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot, ore pee edol ninye Yesu, nebatata te nkomom, neserem ajoki, “Olaitoriani, te niyieu eikindim aishiunye atisika.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu iltimito ilo kirragarie nejo ilpayiani le Israel, “Kainyoo pee eishoo iyiook Olaitoriani metimira Ilfilisti? Mayautu iyiook osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani ene aaitung'uaa Shilo, pee etum ninye aeu te nebo iyiook aitajeu iyiook aitung'uaa engolon oo lmang'ati lang.”

English: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo arikok loo ngarrin oo mbartan ajo mme olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neibelekenya aapuo te sujaroto enye.

English: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
Masaai: Ore ilopeny ina kop neitoomon iyiook to lng'ur otuluso, amu einuaa enkima neng'amaa iyiook pooki, amu eiterua asha naa keirobi.

English: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee emaniki iloiriruani ooiduruk, nerriaa te dukuya ninye ebuaku aajo, “Ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai!”

English: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong niyiolouu intae aajo atii atua Papa, nitii intae atua nanu, nanu natii atua intae.

English: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
Masaai: Etinyikua enkiting'oto oo ntokitin pooki, neaku enoto eng'eno oo ndamunot nauno nebor pee itumokiki enkomono.

English: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pedaia naa Serubabel o Shimei; ore ilayiok le Serubabel naa Meshulam o Hanania naa Shelomit enkanashe enye,

English: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
Masaai: naitotiu nanu ena aji anaa Shilo, naa kaitaa sii ena anasa oldeket too loreren pooki le nkop.’ ”

English: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
Masaai: Amu ina kata inken iroruat aainei, nimintoki aing'or ingok aainei;

English: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
Masaai: Kake atiaaka nanu intae, ‘Ijung'ujung'u intae enkop enye, naa kaisho nanu intae metaa eninyi, ina kop naruko kule o naishi.’ Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, otirishua intae aitung'uaa loreren.

English: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
Masaai: Teneyau inkatampo te shumata enkop, nedoli olokirrai te nkatampoi,

English: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
Masaai: Ore too mbaa pooki enkuna ena nabo enchoo orrekie le nkishui inyi meishiaakinore ororei supat le Kristo, peyie te naewuo adol intae aashu te nematii naning'oo ajo ituunote intasheshe to ltau obo, o te ndamunoto nabo, ninyokinyoko aairiamari te nkaraki enkirukoto o rorei supat,

English: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
Masaai: Oi napaji tenaa kaaning iltung'ana laainei, pee etum Israel ashomo too nkoitoi aainei!

English: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
Masaai: Nemanimanaa ninche aaing'oru endaa, neing'unyung'uny enkewarie pooki te neitu eraposho.

English: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Ekaiturrur intae nakutaki intae enkima engoro ai napi, naa kesholi intae te rishata enye.

English: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
Masaai: Nelang ninche Yordan, neiteru abaiki Aroer, o ebaiki ina anasa natii atua empolos o erata, te nkalo e Gad nelo Yaser.

English: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
Masaai: Teyietu nchira iyie Tarshishi, amu ore osempewuet lino neitomijoonoki.

English: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilsifi enetii Saul te Gibea, nejo, “Aimeisudori Daudi to ldoinyo le Hikila, otii enkalo o loo saen le Yeshimon?”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Eng'or olmeitai obo layaki Farao o Misiri; ore te siadi naa keisho ntae enchom, te neisho ntae enchom naa kearaa ntae enchom katukul.

English: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
Masaai: Edung'u ninche mbenek e ntim, o ntona olpurkel aaitaa endaa.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel tenipuonunu kenya atua ina kop naisho nanu intae nisampumpu ilng'anayio lenyena, eyaki intae irridat loo lng'anayio le dukuya le nkisampuare olapolosani;

English: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
Masaai: Ore nkera ang kutiti, o nkituaak ang, o ntare ang o nkishu ang pooki, kebik te idie too nkanas e Gilead;

English: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
Masaai: Naa ore taata, ng'ura, kitii iyiook atua enkaina ino: taasa anaa enidol ajo sidai neishaakino too nkonyek inono ti nintaas iyiook.”

English: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoshafat ajoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, “Tang'asa nkilikuanishore ororei lo Laitoriani.”

English: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
Masaai: “Amu olosho ninche lemeeta kiguana nemetii eyiolounoto atua ninche.

English: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
Masaai: Ore apa anaa enatiu oltung'ani loo nkulupuok neijia sii etiu lelo laa loo nkulupuok, ore anaa enatiu oltung'ani le keper naa neijia sii etiu ile keper.

English: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
Masaai: Amu etabawua enkata e nkiguana naa te nkaji e Enkai eng'asu, amaa te naa iyiook eng'as, kaji pasa etiu enkiting'oto e kuldo lemeiruk Ororei supat le Enkai?

English: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Shimei, “Miye iyie.” Neisho olaiguanani ninye olmumai lenye.

English: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
Masaai: Tang'amai, aatasayia ina kishoroto ai nikiyakaki iyie, amu aaing'urrie Enkai oleng, naa kaata sii inaabaiki.” Ina peyie earaki ninye meewa, neya ninye.

English: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
Masaai: kake aatoomonoko iyie pee meish enkirukoto ino, naa ore pee iitu, ntagolo lalashera linono.”

English: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
Masaai: Ore ejo ninche ai ng'eni neaku lmoda,

English: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
Masaai: Ore anaa enaing'asiate ilkumok te nkaraki ninye - ore elioto enye, neibelekenya, meekure enyaanyukie enkomom o ltung'ani, ore empukunoto neibelekenya arruoyo alang ene tung'ani.

English: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejo Raheli, “Aatudungoko Enkai enkiguana, netoning'o sii oltoilo lai naaisho nanu enkayioni.” Neaku eipoto enkarna enye ajo Dan.

English: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
Masaai: Kentorroni elakieki esidai? Ore eyia etuturutuo ninche engumoto tenkaraki enkishui ai. Tadamu ina naitasho te dukuya iyie pee airo esidai tenkaraki ninche, pee aibelekeny aiwuang'ie aitung'uaa ninche.

English: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
Masaai: Kaa sipata eeta ina nanyor nanu tiatua enkop ai, eidipa ataasa nkiaasin torrok? Keidim ilmuma o nkiri naaitaikiaki olasar aaiwuang'ie enkidaata ino? Eikintiship naa iyie ina?

English: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, saying,
Masaai: Neishooyo Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon enkitanapata tialo Yeremia eimaa Nebusaradan, ilo kitok le rripore ejo,

English: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
Masaai: Na Ai, kainyoo iyie pee nturraa iyiook ntarasi? Kainyoo pee epuru engoro ino too ntare e luaata ino?

English: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki osinka lai Yakobo o Israel ilo gelunoti lai, aaipotu nanu te nkarna ino aaipotu nanu enkarna ino hoo nimikiyiolo iyie.

English: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
Masaai: Neaku neijia etiu eyieunoto entorroni oo lbarnot linono ina kata kimbung Ilmisiri olgoo lino neirony ilki linono kutiti.”

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Esisa, intae, isinyat lo Laitoriani, esisa enkarna o Laitoriani!

English: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e kulo rorei pooki o te risioroto ena duata pooki, neirorie Natan Daudi.

English: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
Masaai: Pee atum aiteng'ena ilaitarruorrok nkoitoi inono, nikirrinyokino ilaing'okok aapuonu enitii.

English: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
Masaai: Nejoki Marisa, “Ayiolo ajo keitoki apiu te mpiunoto e nkiting'oto.”

English: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
Masaai: Nejoki, “Akua?” Nejoki Yesu, “Kuna, miar metua, miloloito, mipurrisho, minchakenoki elejare.

English: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Ninchopoki lelo kilani Aron olalashe lino, te nebo ilayiok lenyena, nibukoki eilata aput ninche, nikinteng'elaki peyie aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak.

English: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
Masaai: Etigiligilaki enkop tukul, etabee neaku mbelibelat, eikirikirieki enkop oleng.

English: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
Masaai: Neishopoki ninye olkila lioriong nerreten ninye te nkimeita, neitoki aishopoki ninye enkila sapuk, neishopoki tioriong enkila dorrop neen teina keene naripuno te nkarriyiano eina kila dorrop aeniki ninye.

English: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatii Olaitoriani tenebo olkitok lai olaiguanani, metaa sii tenebo Solomon, neitaa kitok olorika lenye le nkitoo aitalang olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai Daudi!”

English: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiteng'enani loo nkitanapat, “Itisipa, Olaiteng'enani; itisipa nchere nabo Enkai, nemeetae likae leme ninye;

English: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
Masaai: Neaku, aaing'orua nanu iyie ti atua ine wueji ino sinyati, naing'or engolon ino o enkitoo ino.

English: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
Masaai: Akaiwuang'ie enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche, peyie etum ninche aaisarkionie ewueji ai e tipat; ejing ilaikonyak atua neisarkionie ninye,

Masaai: Kake etawala Daudi ajo, “Eyiolo papaai lino oleng nchere anoto nanu omom too nkonyek inono; nejo ninye, ‘Mincho Yonatan eyiolou ena, pee megoro ake.’ Kake esipa, anaa enaishu Olaitoriani o anaa enaishu oltau lino, eroruata nabo ake natii erishata nanu o keeya.”

English: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
Masaai: Mputa nkomomi enye enkurruna, pee etum ninche aaing'oru enkarna ino, iyie Olaitoriani.

English: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
Masaai: Newaliki Nikodemo ajoki ninye, “Kaji eiko pee eidim aataa kuna baa?”

English: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: ilo oisalaasha enkop natoyio te shumata nkariak, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Masaai: Ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Yuda etang'asaki aaun too ntukusi enye, naa Nashon olayioni le Aminadab olarikoni lenye.

English: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilkumok loo looiteng'eni lenyena kuna, nejo, “Kegol ele rorei. Aing'ae oidim atoning'o?”

English: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Mahalel etoiwuoki Yared ilarin iip isiet o tomoni uni, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
Masaai: Ore pooki naba anaa enayieuni te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ino, niata erishata pee inchoru nindim aishoru te nena naatii olchumati lo laiguanani.

English: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Naa kepalaa ninye Isiraeli tenkaraki ina ng'oki e Yeroboam, apa naataasa neitaas sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”

English: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
Masaai: Ina peyie ejoki Yuda ilalashera lenyena, “Ainyoo taa doi kitum tinikiar olalashe lang metua, nikituroo osarge lenye?

English: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'orisho Yuda, ng'ura etii olarrabal dukuya o siadi, neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani nekut ilapolosak ntarumpetani.

English: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
