English: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
Masaai: Ina apune natii enkurma e Makpela, oloo saen le Mamre te nkop e Kanaan, nainyiang'ua apa Abraham tenebo ina kurma e Efron lo Lhiti aitaa enenye nanukarie iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
Masaai: Neaku eitoria apa Daudi Israel pooki; neisiaisho Daudi te sipata o te risioroto too ltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
Masaai: Neisho ninye meirurayu too nkejek enyena; neipotu ninye oltung'ani, neisho ninye metabarnu nena enat naapishana oo lpapit le ndukuya enye. Neiteru aitanyamal ninye, neing'ua engolon enye ninye.

English: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
Masaai: Ore ninye olchore lai lo ltau apa laisiliga nanu, oshi ooinos endaa ai, naatudumakine ninye nanu.

English: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninche, “Esarkionie ina aji, nimputuputu iloodung'oro ilmeneng'a. Enchom dukuya.” Metaa eshomo dukuya, nearisho tiatua ina anasa.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong ilo pisiai le Israel o lelo oolekuni le nkaji e Yakobo, nemeitoki aairishakino ilo apa otaara ninche, kake Olaitoriani eirishakino ninche. Ilo sinyati le Israel eirishakino te sipata.

English: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, nenyok Ilyahudi aaing'oru enkoitoi naarie metua, neme enkaraki ake natigila enkolong e sabato kake enkaraki sii natejo menye lenye Enkai, aitorisioki makewan Enkai.

English: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Keaku enkop pooki mitil; ore eyia maitaa nanu enkiting'oto.

English: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
Masaai: Neitoki ake atum ae kidetidet, neliki ilalashera lenyena nejo, “Ng'ura anyaaka aidetidet ae kidetidet; naa ng'ura, ore enkolong o lapa o lakir tomon oobo neaku kaapuonu aairrugokino.”

English: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
Masaai: “Tenetumi tiatua intae, tiatua ae nabo oo nkang'itie inyi naaishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai ino olee aashu enkitok naas entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino, agil olning'o lenye lo sotua,

English: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
Masaai: Tang'amu nkishorot aainei e nkisisa, Olaitoriani, nikinteng'en nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.
Masaai: kake ore te ndoyioroto e nkolong, neitanapisho Yoshua, neitayuni ninche aaitadou too lkeek, nenang'akini ninche atua ina apune apa naisudorie ate, nepik isoito sapuki enkutuk e ina apune, leton etii o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki aipotu Solomon ilo ayioni lenye, neitanap metesheta enkaji Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
Masaai: (Amu ore kuna baa o lminong pooki etaasa apa iltung'ana lena kop, lelo apa ootii dukuya intae, neaku eisarkionieki enkop);

English: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani awalu ajo, “Enchoo ena kerai naishu enkitok e dukuya, nimisajisasha ake, amu ninye ngotonye.”

English: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau enetii olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Mikaia, eikipuo iyiook Ramot-gilead, olarrabal anaa aikipal?” Newalu ninye ajo, “Ilepa shomo timirisho; kepiki ninche enkaina ino.”

English: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
Masaai: Tenaa ketii entorroni Gilead meeta nchere pee mepuonu ninche aaku pesho; Tenaa kepolosi iloing'ok te Gilead, ore lelo perereni lenye naa kepuo aatiu anaa sotot loo soito too nong'ot e nkurma.

English: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
Masaai: lelo oing'uaa inkoitoi e nkitashoto sidai aaim inkoitoi e naimin.

English: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
Masaai: Ana keitu isomama too nkitanapat inchere kegil ilapolosak le nkaji e Nkai enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata nemeikeni aajo eisarkionie ninche nemeikoni aajo eitarruoitie ninche?

English: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expences be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
Masaai: Ore ake sii aitayio nanu enkitanapata naipirta enintaasiasa kulo payiani loo Lyahudi te nchetata ena aji e Nkai; kelaakini kulo tung'ana te nkiputakinoto to lchumati le nkitoo nemeimutieki te kodi naing'uaa olkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju.

English: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
Masaai: Tenikirerei anaake nintagol elukunya ino, niyooki nabo olong agila, nimintoki aishiu.

English: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Masaai: Niminosinoso intae imukateni aashu ilpaek ootoito aashu ilooshal ometabau ina olong, ometaba anaa niyauu ilasarri le Nkai inyi; enkitanapata ena oo ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi too manyishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, atonyorrayie nanu pee aarubare korokoroni aashu keeya.”

English: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
Masaai: Nejoki Yepta lelo payiani le Gilead, “Ti nikintokiki nanu aaya ang mashomo aarare Ilamoni, ore ake pee aaisho Olaitoriani ninche, naaku nanu olarikoni linyi.”

English: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
Masaai: Naa ore etii kuna pooki nimikining'ining'i intae naitame intae aitulus katitin naapishana te nkaraki ing'ok inyi, nagil nanu olwuasa le ngolon inyi,

English: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
Masaai: Nejo, “Abba, Papa, eidimayu imbaa pooki te iyie; tooruoki ena kikompe; kake mme enaa enayieu nanu, kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”

English: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
Masaai: Nebukoki enkare embesen neiteru aisuj inkejek oo looiteng'eni nejut te nkarasha narretenare.

English: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo intae enaitaasa nanu o loo papa iltung'ana le kulie kuapi? Keidim apa nkaitin e lelo oreren aatokordu iloshon lenye te nkaina ai?

English: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
Masaai: Mirubarere esiamo aas intorrok, nimintayuyu shakenisho te nkiguana aarubare esiamo pee inturraa esipata.

English: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
Masaai: Ore pee eme erubata nabo, nemeyu rubat pooki te nebo ina; ore pee eisisi erubata nabo, neshipa nkulie rubat pooki te nebo ina.

English: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
Masaai: o enchankar ti atua iltung'ana lemelulung'a lukuny enye nemeeta esipata. Oojo ore orrekie le Enkai naa enkoitoi naduporeki.

English: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
Masaai: Amu kaaisho iyie iutarot sidain; miorore enkiteng'enata ai.

English: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
Masaai: Mme apa enkaraki nirara intae kumok aalang ilkulikae tung'ana pee etipika Olaitoriani enyorrata enye shumata intae negelu intae, amu intae apa kuti aalang iloreren pooki;

English: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
Masaai: Emijojo ake kaitang'or intae te Papa. Etii oloitang'or intae naa Musa laa ninye isiligigi.

English: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
Masaai: Katitin naapishana nanu aaisis iyie te nkolong te nkaraki inkiguanat inono naasipa.

English: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiba olalashe lenye naa olarani, niyiololo intae aajo meetae olarani omany enkishui nemeish atua ninye.

English: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, te kuna baa eishu iltung'ana, ore enkishui o ltau lai netii atua kuna pooki. Ooi, torrinyokoki nanu embiotisho nikincho manyaaki aishu!

English: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
Masaai: o ina anka natii apa endukuya enye. Nemeboitare inkarash e kitani napuyiapui, kake keirina ti ai wueji openy alamita.

English: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Masaai: Keng'amu ninye emayianata naing'uaa Olaitoriani, neng'amu esupatisho naing'uaa Enkai e njeunoto enye.

English: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
Masaai: Amu meiture laitoriak oltung'ani lo lkuaak supat, kake eiture olo ltorrono. Iyieu iyie nimiaata enkuretisho te ilo oitoreisho? Taasa naa isupati, naa itum errepet te ninye.

English: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Shaul neitoreisho Baalhanan ole Akbor te rishata enye.

English: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
Masaai: Ore tenajo aiturrur ninche; Olaitoriani ojo, nemetii ilng'anayio o sabibu arashu ilng'abolo olng'aboli etoito ninye mbenek, ore apa ina naishoo nanu ninche netulusoyie alo aing'uaa ninche.”

English: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
Masaai: Isudoi ninche pooki tenebo tiatua enterit, nkenoi inkomomi enye te nkop e abori.

English: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
Masaai: pee etum aitisinya ninye, eidipa aisuja te nkitukuoto e nkare o te nebo ilo rorei,

English: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
Masaai: Ore ajo pee ayiolou embae naisitaarieki nariku aitadoiki olkiaama lenye.

English: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, aatudumakinote nanu iltung'ana oouasa aarare; eing'oru entukus oo ltung'ana oouasa enkishui ai, nimikishilaa ninche iyie.

English: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Solomon atesheta ina aji o Laitoriani o enkaji o laiguanani o pooki apa naayieu Solomon neshet,

English: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ilgilat le nkalo e moikuape o lgilat le kopikop lelo ooipirare ilo odung'oro naa lgilat Sinyat, laa teine epuo lelo apolosak oopuonu enetii Olaitoriani aanyalelo asarri sinyat oleng ilo asar le ntapa, ilo asar le ng'oki, o ilo asar le nkitarruoroto, amu ore ine wueji naa aisinyati.

English: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
Masaai: Neenita pooki ilalema, naa arriyiak to larrabal, meeta hoo obo lenye lemeenita olalem, nerripisho te nkewarie.

English: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
Masaai: o Sadok olayioni lenye, o Ahimaas olayioni lenye.

English: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
Masaai: Neaku, lalashera, mikira iyiook nkera e rrindik, kake ine nkitok sayunoti nalakuno.

English: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
Masaai: amu te nejing, mme oltau lenye ejing kake enkoshoke, neipung ade ake?” (Ore pee ejo neijia neitisiny indaiki pooki.)

English: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
Masaai: te ndung'oto oo soito oopiki iwuejitin, o te nguetata oo nkeek, te siaai e nkarriyiano pooki.

English: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
Masaai: Neitarasaa ninye ina kishoroto aisho Eglon olaiguanani le Moab, naa oltung'ani apa opir oleng.

English: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
Masaai: O Libna, o Eter, o Ashan,

English: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
Masaai: Nanu Yohana oigeroki isirito naapishana e Asia: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani eing'uaa ilo otii taata, netii apa, naa ninye kenya olotu netii neing'uaa sii inkiyang'eta naapishana naatii dukuya olorika le nkitoo,

English: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
Masaai: Ore mbokishi e nkaji ang naa iltarakua, ore irishinani naa olchani onyaanyukie oltarakuai.

English: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
Masaai: Ore pee egelaki ninye olkekun, nepuonu enetii te nkaji natijing'a aa kumok oleng. Neinosaki ena bae te nkakenya o memuto, eishakenoki enkitoria e Nkai netem ajo aitijing'aa ninche mbaa e Yesu too nkitanapat e Musa, o too loibonok le Nkai.

English: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
Masaai: Aimaaishiaakino te naas anaa enayieu too naainei? Ana keiba enkong'u ino te nkaraki nara nanu aminin?’

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ore anaa enapa natubukoko engoro ai o engoro ai napi lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neijia eikoni aabukoki engoro ai napi intae tenipuopuo Misiri. Naa iakuku intae entaboi, o olkirutoto o ldeket o esulare. Mingiligili ae kata aadol ene wueji.

English: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina kata naitaa enkop e Misiri mitil, o ina kata nakinyi enkop te pooki nabore, o ina kata naosh lelo pooki ootii atua ninye, naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka ninche Enkai enkitarruorroto nagol, meiruko enda e monkoi,

English: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
Masaai: “Toriko ile Lawi intung'uai iltung'ana le Israel, nintuku ninche.

English: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Too nkalifuni are o iip uni oo nteipai o nkakeny; nerrinyokini taa ine wueji sinyati enapake wueji enye.”

English: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
Masaai: “Kake ore pee idolidolo ina taboi nayau emutata eitashe te wueji nemeishiaakino (tayiolo taa ake oloisoma ena), esikaki ildoinyo ilootii Yudea.

English: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
Masaai: Pee eibelekeny esipata oltung'ani te dukuya ilo otii shumata aisul,

English: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
Masaai: Neishiaakino ninche iyiook; amu inikitaasa eitalakitae iyiook; kake meeta hoo ele entorrono nataasa.”

English: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
Masaai: nedumunye te Sarid aipir enkae shoto enkalo o loo saen aing'or eneilepunye enkolong o metabaiki olpolosie le Kislot-tabor; nelo te ine o metabaiki Daberat, neitoki ailep alo Yafia;

English: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
Masaai: Amu ajoki intae, mikintokiki aadol katukul, metaba anaa nijojo, ‘Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani.’ ”

English: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
Masaai: Keaku kebolo nchomito inono anaake, ore dama o kewarie nemeikeni ninche; pee kitum iltung'ana aayaki iyie ina arsisho oo loshon, eriku ilaiguanak lenye erukunye aapuonu.

English: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
Masaai: Neitirrishaki olarrabal Saul oleng, netum ninye ilang'orok loo mbaa, netum olbae torrono te lelo ang'orok loo mbaa.

English: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:
Masaai: kitaasa iyiook eng'oki nikintarruoitie nikiaasisho te suujisho nikigolong'u, kimbelekenyate aaing'uaa nkitanapat inono o nkiguanat inono;

English: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu ajo eikitok Olaitoriani, nayiolo nchere etii Olaitoriani lang te shumata nkaitin pooki.

English: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Najo nanu: “Woi kewan ai! Amu aimina nanu; amu ara nanu oltung'ani loo nkirorot torrok; naton tiatua iltung'ana loo nkirorot torrok; amu etoduaa nkonyek aainei Olaiguanani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani!”

English: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
Masaai: Neitoki alo atua aji aishooyo inkishorot neitayu ilasarri oopejori. Netipika apa Yehu iltung'ana ntomoni isiet boo, nejoki, “Ore oltung'ani obo te lelo latipika nkaik inono metuluai neiturraa enkishui enye.”

English: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
Masaai: Neaku kiwaita iyiook ina kop teina kata too nkaik e lelo aiguanak oare le Amori ootii lido kekun le Yordan, ebaiki oerata le Arnon o metabaiki oldoinyo le Hermon.

English: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
Masaai: Neishopoki Rebeka inkilani sidan e Esau olkikau lenye, naata tiaji, olayioni lenye oti Yakobo, neripaki indapan oo lbalelon inkaik enyena tenebo emurt enye nasipa. Neisho ninye endaa sidai namelok tenebo emukate naitobira olayioni lenye Yakobo.

English: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
Masaai: Metaa ena elaakinoto oo laitang'orok laainei naing'uaa Olaitoriani, te lelo ooiro ntorrok ti alo enkishui ai!

English: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
Masaai: neitoki Daudi ajoki Gad, “Atii nanu atua osina sapuk; nchooki nanu matabatatakinoyu enkaina o Laitoriani, amu aisapuk olng'ur lenye oleng, kake mincho nanu abatatakino enkaina e tung'ani.”

English: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
Masaai: Ore nena onyek apa naatoduaa ninye, nemeitoki aekata aaigil aadol, nemeigil aekata ewueji enye adol ninye.

English: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon ajoki ninche, “Enchooki nanu matoomono intae nabo toki; enchooki nanu pooki ng'ae te intae ilgiso loo nkiyiaa apa liwaita le lelo tung'ana litaara.” (Amu eeta apa ninche ilgiso loo nkiyaa le sahabu, enkaraki naa ile Ishmael.)

English: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
Masaai: Nenyikaki oltau lenye enemeneng'a, nenyikaki enkishui enye lelo ooyau keeya.

English: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
Masaai: Neetae Olyahudi oji Apolo, laa te Aleksantria eini, nelotu elo Efeso; naa arriyia to rorei naa magilani too lkigerot.

English: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
Masaai: Kuna apa sii eibonuo Enok ilo apa le ishoi e naapishana ebaiki Adam ejo, “Ng'ura eewuo Olaitoriani te nebo iip inkuyu oo sinyat lenyena,

English: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Asa kulo rorei, ina aibon e Asaria olayioni le Aded, neitagoluo, neiwuang'ie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naa ninche olminong teina kop e Yuda o ene Benchamen, o te nena anas naawa ninye teina kop oo ldoinyio e Efraim. Neitoki ninye aitobir olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otii dukuya olgoriet le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
Masaai: ina kata apa earare enjore o laiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem o nena anas pooki e Yuda naatelekutua, Lakish o Aseka amu kuna apake nkanas e Yuda naasheta isunta naatelekutua sunta.

English: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
Masaai: Ore iloibonok lenye netumura te nturoto e monkoi, nedol induaat nemesipa, neibonoki ninche elejare ejoki: ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai’, eitu ninye eiro Olaitoriani.

English: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
Masaai: Aimidol ajo itipikate olgelati maate, niaakuku ilooiguenare too ndamunot torrok?

English: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
Masaai: “Tenelotu Esau aidaikie entukus nabo, neaku ore entukus natelekua neidim aisika.”

English: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo aajo ore pooki toki najing enkutuk o ltung'ani, enkoshoke elo neipang?

English: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
Masaai: ore oloitasheiki inkurman oo lng'anayio naa Shimei le Rematil; ore oloitasheiki ilng'anayio ooitayuni te nkurma oo sabibu naa Sabdi le Shifamit.

English: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
Masaai: Nji ejo Enkai, Olaitoriani, ilo oitayio shumata neisalaash, ilo olak enkop aitorioo o pooki naimu ninye, ilo oisho enkiyang'et lelo tung'ana ootii oriong enkop, neisho enkishui lelo oopuo ti oriong enkop.

English: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
Masaai: Ore te siadi neirriwaki enkerai enye ejo, ‘Keyanyit ninche enkerai ai.’

English: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
Masaai: kake mirukuruku intae, amu mirara loo nkerra aainei, anaa enatiaaka intae.

English: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
Masaai: neaku meidim iltung'ana aaitirisha oltoilo le mbuakunoto e nchipai o ltoilo lo lkiyio loo ltung'ana; amu etabuakutua apa lelo tung'ana te mbuakunoto sapuk oleng, nening'ori ina buakunoto te nelakua.

English: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
Masaai: Kake ore enatii meekure aa nanu oas inaas, kake ina ng'oki natii atua nanu.

English: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
Masaai: Aashu te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata oltung'ani netum ninye olom ti alo enkitok enye; nepik ninye ina kitok dukuya Olaitoriani, nedungoki olapolosani enkiguana tena kitanapata pooki.

English: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nkirorot enye, kelo ninye aidaikie ninche; ore pooki oodol ninche neipirripir ilukuny enye.

English: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye ntabo arubare nkitanyaanyukot. Etaasa ninye anaa apa Ilamori, laa ninche eiturrayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo siraeli.

English: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
Masaai: Pee eitaraposh ina kop mijooni nememanya, neisho enkop metubulaki nkujit?

English: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
Masaai: Neiseyie nkonyek enye ejo, “Inchoo etiu anaa enkirukoto inyi.”

English: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
Masaai: ilootoni ninche too nkuraren, netoni te nkewarie too lnukat lenye; lelo ooinos nkiri oo lbitiro, ore motori o lminong netii iltooi lenye;

English: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
Masaai: Naa ore amu mme sidai ina kutoto oo melin ebikieki te nkata e nkirobi, nejo lkumok lenye ai sidai te neporoo aapuo te ine, ejo te neidimayu nebaya Foinike, naa enkutoto ina oo melin te Krete, naipirta enkalo e nkilepunoto e kopikop o erishata e nkilepunoto e moikuape, peyie ebik te ine te nkata e nkirobi.

English: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
Masaai: Eiputa enkop enye nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, neirrugokino ninche ina siaai oo nkaik enye, ina naitobira ilkimojik lenye.

English: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
Masaai: Nenyiku Abraham nejo, “Amaa doi aindaikie isupati tenebo iltorrok?

English: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: aishakenoki ndung'ot pokira aa Lyahudi o aa Lyunani meirridu ti alo meirridu ti alo Enkai, neiruk Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
Masaai: Naa kesipa nchere ara nanu olo lgilata linyi linyikare, ore ake eyia etii olo lgilata linyikare alang nanu.

English: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya tadekenya nijo iyie, ‘Oi naaji tenaa teipa!’ Ore teipa nijo iyie, ‘Oi naaji tenaa tadekenya’ te nkaraki ina batisho naure oltau lino, o nena baa naadol nkonyek inono.

English: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
Masaai: Entorrinyokinoto isempewueti linyi, intae ilooena oota osiligi. Aibalunye nanu ena olong nchere karrinyoki intae eseriani.

English: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
Masaai: Kaipotu nanu keper o enkop nikinchakenoki iyie ena olong, nchere airragie nanu te dukuya iyie puaan o keeya, emayianata o ldeket, ore naa tegelu puaan, pee itum iyie o eishoi ino atobikoi,

English: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.
Masaai: Etorrinyuo ninye olpolosie pooki le Israel ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamatoo metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Yona olayioni le Amitai, ilo oiboni le Nkai; oing'uaa Gat-hafer.

English: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.
Masaai: Neilep ninche aapuo ina anasa. Ore ejing'ita ninche ang, nedol ninche Samuel eipang'u alotu anang'are ninche eloito ailep alo ine wueji e shumata.

English: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
Masaai: Ore ina atampoi neikununo anaa eng'ape te ndama o enkima naikununo anaa eng'ape te nkewarie neitu eiwuang te dukuya iltung'ana.

English: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
Masaai: “Ore te nkaraki olom oatayie apa lelo loo papa Yosef, olalashe lenye, nemiraki Misiri, kake etii apa Enkai te nebo ninye,

English: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Lo Kitok, inchooki ina are, pee maaitoki atir enkure, nemaitoki alotu ene neba inji aoku enkare.”

English: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
Masaai: Kake te nelo oltung'ani kewarie nerrorro amu metii ewang'an atua ninye.”

English: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
Masaai: Entoomon Olaitoriani enchan te nkata oloirujuruj, Olaitoriani ninye oitobiru olkutati o nkatampo, naa ninye oisho iltung'ana enkirujuruj e nchan, neitonyorij pooki toki tiong'ota.

English: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
Masaai: Neiperra nabo kata olkarasha le nkaji e Nkai aaku are, aiteru te shumata o metabaiki abori, neikirikira enkop nedanya ndapidapo;

English: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
Masaai: Naa keng'amaa olaiguanani ajoki, ‘Esipa, ajoki intae, ore anaa enintaasa lelo alashera laainei ooti, nanu intaasa.’

English: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
Masaai: Ore earita enkop, neitayu obo enkaina aitupuku neng'amaa enkaitoiyioni neeniki ina aina enkopito pile, ejoito, “Ele otang'asunye.”

English: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
Masaai: Amu atii nanu tenebo iyie pee aaitajeu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo: Kaiting'ie nanu iloshon pooki apa laidapashaka nanu intae, kake ore iyie maaiting'ie nanu iyie. Kaaitame nanu iyie te nkiririkinoto, nemaaing'uaa nanu hoo tiae oitoi mintamio.

English: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.
Masaai: Neitoki Naomi ajoki Rusi, ina tito o layioni lenye, “Keishiaakino entito ai te nilo iyie te nebo nkaisiayiak enyena, pee mikintanyamali ake ti ae kurma.”

English: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam airriwaa Adoram, laa ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai oo nkaik. Nenang iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli ninye too soito ometua. Neisarisaraki olaiguanani Rehoboam aked engari enye oo mbartan, neisikaki Yerusalem.

English: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
Masaai: Nikintajeu iyie aitung'uaa enkoitoi oo ntorrok, aitung'uaa iltung'ana ooiro nkirorot torrok,

English: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
Masaai: Te naa kenkop apa natung'uaitie edamu ninche, anaata apa enoto erishata nashukore.

English: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
Masaai: Kake ore tialo enkaji o Lrekab nejo Yeremia, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ore enkaraki nimbung'a enkitanapata e Yonadabu papaai linyi nintabaitie pooki, nitaasa nena pooki naaitanapa ninye intae,

English: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
Masaai: Einyototo inkera enyena neipot ninye aajo enamaiyiana; neija sii ejo olpayian lenye, eisis ninye ejo:

English: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
Masaai: Ore taata neiting'ieki enkishui ai te nanu; aaineputua nanu inkolong'i osina aaibung.

English: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata aaok enaisho oo sabibu eranyisho; keduaru ina aisho napi te lelo ook.

English: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
Masaai: Ore ilo shani litodua iyie, otubulua negolu, o metabaiki enchumata enye keper, naa dapash ninye abaiki enkop pooki;

English: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Keiro enkutuk ai enkisisa o Laitoriani, nchoo pooki naaishu eisis enkarna enye sinyati ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
Masaai: Naitoki adol olorika le nkitoo oibor kitok o ilo otonita neilanyisho enkop o keper aaing'uaa ine netii ninye nelaii ewueji neishaa ninche.

English: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
Masaai: Napik endamunoto ai aing'oru aturu eng'eno e nena pooki naasi tiabori keper; esiaai nemetii enchipai apa eishoo Enkai nkera oo ltung'ana metanyamaliki.

English: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: naa ore to lasar ooki nintayu mboreitin uni e naisho pee eaku olng'usil orropil to Laitoriani.

English: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
Masaai: Ore ina kata ake neing'abobunye entoki neeijo lpala too nkonyek enyena neitoki a dolishoyu. Neinyototo neibatisae.

English: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
Masaai: Amu ara sii nanu oltung'ani otii enkitoria, naaitorei, naata sii nanu sikarini laitore. Naitore ele ajoki, ‘Shomo!’ nelo; najoki elde ‘Wou!’ nelotu; naitore osinka lai ajoki, ‘Taasa ena!’ neas.”

English: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;
Masaai: nepuonu nena aloli naaitarrikinote dukuya Olaitoriani, dukuya ilapolosak o larishak laa ninche ootii lorikan te nena olong'i;

English: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
Masaai: Mishilaa nena baa pooki naajo iltung'ana, pee meya ake nining osinka lino kidekita iyie;

English: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ng'otonye ajo eisulieki, netaa eiting'o osiligi lenye, neya ninye likae kuoo, too lkuoo lenyena, neitaa oloti ng'atuny.

English: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo barnot le risiori enye ninye, “Nji iyie shomo tiaaki lelo tung'ana likitiaakitia, ‘Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto, kake inteneneng'aki iyie iyiook;’ nji shomo tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore enkilinta ai naa ninye sapuk alang empolos e Papaai.

English: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
Masaai: Kake enting'idata te nkaraki ning'arierie Kristo isinaitin lenyena pee itumutumu sii intae aating'idata te ng'ida sapuk te nkata naibalieki enkisisa o enkitoo enye.

English: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
Masaai: Keetae entoki nagol to Laitoriani? Ore te nkata nageluno kaashukokino te nkata oloirujuruj, naa ketum Sara enkayioni.”

English: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aatisila nanu iyie, kake mme anaa enkosholai; aatetema nanu iyie to lkokuet loo nkisilisilot.

English: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
Masaai: “Ore eton eitu esaisayu ninye, neisho; ore eton eitu ebaiki emion ninye neiu ninye enkayioni.

English: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
Masaai: Neitanapa Musa ninche ejo, “Ore ake te nkiting'oto e pooki arin oopishana, teina kata nategeluaki pee epalakinoi isilen, to sirua loo lng'oborri,

English: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.
Masaai: ina kata eitoduaya enkarsisisho e nkitoo enye e nkisisa, o enkishiaa e nkitoo enye too nkolong'i kumok. Inkolong'i iip o ntomoni isiet.

English: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of PrAzareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
Masaai: o lalashera lenyena, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa iip are o artam o are; o Amashai, olayioni le Asarel, olayioni le Asai, olayioni le Meshilemot, olayioni le Imer,

English: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
Masaai: Neaku eitirring'e Yehoshafat te seriani, amu eishoo ninye Enkai enkiyeng'iyeng too nkaloli pooki.

English: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
Masaai: Intamesin naalepo tomoni uni o nkurrarrun enye o nkishu artam tenebo iloing'ok tomon, o sirkon lipong'a tikitam, o lamuyeishi tomon.

English: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
Masaai: Kayieu niyiolouu ilalashera laainei nchere kumok inkatitin nayieu oshi nalotu abaiki intae, (kake eitu aaishori ebaiki taata,) peyie atum embata e nkisampuare tiatua intae o too loreren.

English: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
Masaai: Kake teneitoki ine neiwotiote aibelekenya neiborru, nelotu ninye enetii olapolosani,

English: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
Masaai: olo adol ina kop apa nainosie nanu olmumai pee aisho loo menye; nemeetae obo le lelo laatemenaitie nanu olo adol ina kop.

English: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
Masaai: kuna ninche enchakenisho, o nkikoot o nkitanapat naa ninche eirorie Musa nkera oo Siraeli ina kata apa eipang'u aapuku te nkop e Misiri,

English: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
Masaai: Amu eishoo apa Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Siria metoning'o oltoilo loo ngarrin oo mbartan, o loo mbartan, o ltoilo le njore kitok, neaku etiaakinote maate, “Ng'ura, eipotuo olaiguanani loo Siraeli, aiger o laiguanani le Hiti, o laiguanani le Misiri meetu aarare iyiook.”

English: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neyau ninye nturkuluoni are aashu nturkuluoni are kutiti, nelotu dukuya Olaitoriani te kutukaji ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neisho ninche olapolosani;

English: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
Masaai: Neipot enkarna oliare ajo Efraim, “Amu aitaa Enkai olotubula tena kop enyamali ai.”

English: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
Masaai: Tujurroki nanu Olaitoriani nikitem; tetema oltau lai o ndamunot aainei.

English: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa iltung'ana le Israel te Ramases, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Sukot.

English: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
Masaai: Minokinoko enkima too nkajijik inyi te nkolong e sabato.”

English: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:
Masaai: Naa ore pee aitashe taata maaiguanareki te ne, enkaraki osiligi oinosie olmumai Enkai iloo papa,

English: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena aayooki tadekenya, aashuko aapuo enkop oo lfilisti. Kake eshomo Ilfilisti Yesreel.

English: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo oo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ooing'uaa Yerusalem enetii Yesu ejo,

English: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
Masaai: Neshipayu oltau le ilo apolosani; neitayu ninye ina kila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o Terafim ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, nelo ninye te nebo lelo tung'ana.

English: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
Masaai: “ ‘Mbung'a enkolong e Sabato, pee intisiny, anaa enikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
Masaai: Kake entonyok eng'oru nena kishorot naata tipat aaisul te pooki. Naa kaitodol intae enkoitoi nalus te pooki.

English: He shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.
Masaai: nchoo ninye eton tenebo iyie, tiatua intae, teine wueji negelu ninye tiatua nabo oo nkang'itie inyi, teine neitiship ninye oleng; nimimbooki ninye enkop.

English: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
Masaai: Neikini Yosef te nkop e Misiri Manaseh o Efraim, laa ninche etoikio Asenat entito e Potifera olapolosani le Oni.

English: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
Masaai: nalo nanu asujaa naar ninye naitayu nanu olkuoo te nkutuk enye; naa te nelo naadumakino nanu, naibung olmunyei lenye naar metua.

English: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
Masaai: Tadamu Tobia o Sanbalat, na Ai ai te risioroto e kuna baa naataasa ninche, o enkoiboni sii naji No-adia o lelo kulikae oibonok laayieu naaitukuret.

English: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
Masaai: Nelo Yoram agiroo Saair tenebo ngarrin enyena pooki oo mbartan, nedumunye kewarie, ore ninye o lelo kituaak loo ngarrin e njore, near aamut lelo tung'ana pooki le Edom apa oo manita ninye. Kake eilanyishe enjore enye alo ang.

English: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
Masaai: Aitenkaraki nyoo naa nanu aayakini enkorropil naing'uaa sheba, arashu esonkoyo naarropil naing'uaa enkop nalakua? Ore lasarri linono oopejori meng'amaroyu, nemaaitiship nanu nkishorunot inono.

English: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
Masaai: “Keitu eshumi kuna tenkaraki nanu, nemishirakini olchumati lai?

English: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
Masaai: Neya ninye ntoyie inyi aitaa nkaitobirak oo sonkoyoni, o nkayiarak o nkapejok oo mukateni.

English: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki neitayu ninye nepejoo te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
Masaai: Ore nkoitoi inono o nkiaasin inono nikintadoikitio iyie ena, entorroni ino makewan ena, naa kedua, etabaikia atua oltau lino kewan.

English: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
Masaai: laa ninye apa oshomo dukuya intae te nkoitoi pee eing'uraki intae ewueji niunienie ilng'oborri linyi, nerikoo intae te nkima kewarie, pee eitodol intae enkoitoi niimiimi, nerikoo intae te nkatampoi te ndama.

English: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:
Masaai: Newaliki Esta ajoki, “Tenaa kanoto omom, too nkonyek inono, olaiguanani, naa te neitiship olaiguanani, nchoo maaishori enkishui ai te yieunoto ai, o ltung'ana laainei te nkomono ai.

English: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene isiet Yeshaia, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare,

English: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nejing Paulo o encholiek enye empeut te Pafos, nepuonu Perga te Pamfilia; nelo Yohana aing'uaa ninche te ine nerrinyo Yerusalem.

English: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
Masaai: Eishoo apa ninche menye nkishorot sapuki, e nkosholai o sahabu, o ntokitin e tipat, tenebo nkanas naasheta isunta e Yuda. Kake Yehoram eishoo enkitoria, amu ninye apa olkikau.

English: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
Masaai: Keitu apa eiturraa Akan olayioni le Sera enkirukoto ti alo nena baa naaiteng'elaki, nedoiki engoro olturrur pooki le Israel? Neme ninye ake oidaa te nkitarruoroto enye.’ ”

English: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai olaiguanani, “Tenikincho ninye olpisiaai le nkaji ino, maairiamariyie nanu iyie. Nemainos nanu endaa aashu aok enkare tene wueji;

English: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
Masaai: Kake keing'ua ninche ina kop neshipakino ninye isabatoni enyena ina kata eirrag aa mijooni metii ninche; naa keibelekenya ninche teina torroni, enkaraki apa natemenaitie nkitanapat aainei, neibayu iltauja lenye nkiguanat aainei.

English: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
Masaai: Ore eirorita ninche eton ake eitashe Petero eoshito elusie e kishomi, ore ade pee eboluni, nedoli ninye neing'asiai.

English: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
Masaai: Nadol nanu eng'ues eilepu aing'uaa atua enaiposha naata imowuarak tomon, o lukuny naapishana neishopokino nkishiliaa tomon e nkitoo nena mowuarak enyena. Netii enkarna e morore nena lukuny enyena.

English: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
Masaai: Eishopoko ninye kewan ildeketa anaa olkila lenye, meibulu ninche osesen lenye anaa enkare, meima iloik lenyena anaa eilata!

English: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
Masaai: Netum taa engoro ai ayupuyupo tialo ninche teina olong, naing'uaa nanu ninche naisudoo enkomom ai teine, nemuti ninche; nepuonu ntorrok kumok o nyamalitin shumata ninche, ometaa kejo ninche teina olong, ‘Aimeetuo kuna torrok shumata iyiook enkaraki nemetii Enkai ang atua iyiook?’

English: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ee esipa iokioko enkikombe ai kake ore entonata te nkaina ai e tatene ana te ne kedienye, mme nanu oishoru, kake eaku ene lelo ooitobiraka Papa lai.”

English: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
Masaai: Iyie nanu araposhoki nkonyek aainei, iyie olotonita to lorika le nkitoo te keper!

English: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
Masaai: Eikash irorei lo ltung'ani ng'en ooning'i te mborron alang imbuakunot oloitoreisho tiatua ilmoda.

English: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
Masaai: Ore ntakul inono netiu anaa isashat olng'anayioi oji kukumanka, tiatua ina arasha naimulumulieki enkomom.

English: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
Masaai: Amu meeta nchere meton ilo tung'ani ti atua ina anasa enye nasaruni o metabau keeya o lapolosani kitok; kake ore te siadi enkeeya o lapolosani kitok neidim ilo tung'ani atorrinyoyu ashomo enkop enye.

English: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena neing'uraki Absalom kewan engarri oo mbartan o ltung'ana onom ookuet te dukuya ninye.

English: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
Masaai: Aatokordua te nkaina o lmang'atinta lai ogol, aitung'uaa lelo apa laaiba nanu; amu kegol apa oleng te nanu.

English: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tenatum tiatua Sodom iltung'ana onom ooitashe too sipat, naa kapal enkanasa pooki te nkaraki ninche.”

English: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
Masaai: “Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Sardis, ingero nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo oata nena kiyang'eta naapishana e Enkai o lelo akir oopishana. “ ‘Ayiolo isiaaitin inono, iata enkarna anaa oltung'ani oishu, nitua.

English: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
Masaai: Nchoo enkomom ino meitawang'aki osinka lino; ntajeuoki iyie nanu te ina nyorrata ino nauno!

English: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
Masaai: Kenyor apa Israel Yosef oleng aitalang inkera enyena pooki, amu etoikioki ninye etaa kitok oleng, neitobiraki ninye olkila oodo loo inkaik adoru.

English: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani neisho Olaitoriani ninche olakordunoni, Ehudi, olayioni le Gera, lolosho le Benchamen, oltung'ani kedienye. Neirriwaa iltung'ana le Israel ninye meyaki Eglon olaiguanani le Moab kodi.

English: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo lelo aitasheikinok o ilkituaak le siaai nejoki iltung'ana, “Ejo Farao nji, ‘Maisho nanu ntae olkujita.

English: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: Kake ore ti atua kulo metii hoo oltung'ani oikena Musa aashu Aron ilo apolosani, apa oikena iltung'ana le Israel ti ong'ata e Sinai.

English: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
Masaai: ilo ning'o apa oitobira ninye o Abraham, ilo mumai apa oinosa te nkaraki Isaak,

English: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.
Masaai: Ore Rusi ina oo Lmoabu nejoki Naomi, “Nchooki nanu mashomo enkurma ang'osilu ilng'osil le nkano te siadi ilo latumie nanu ninye omom.” Nejoki Naomi ninye, “Shomo entito ai.”

English: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
Masaai: Ore nena keek nisirishore naatii enkaina ino te dukuya inkonyek enye,

English: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
Masaai: Nemor sii lelo apurrok ootashoki te nebo o ninye.

English: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Eliya ina, neimulumul enkomom enye to lkila nelo aitashe te nkutuk e nkapune. Naa ng'ura nelotu oltoilo enetii ninye, nejoki, “Kaa iyie iasita tene, Eliya?”

English: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
Masaai: Ore taaisere nejing Kaisaria. Neanyita Kornelio ninche, neipoto aiturrur olmarei lenye pooki o lchoreta le latia enye.

English: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Kidolita metii olng'ash aajo etii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie metaa kitejo, inchoo maitayu olmumai terishata ino o iyiook naa maitayu sii olning'o o iyie,

English: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
Masaai: naa ore apa pee eirriwaa intae Olaitoriani Kadesh-Barnea, ejo, ‘Elepa enchom embung'a ina kop naishoo nanu intae’ nitogolong'akita intae enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, neitu intae irukuruku ninye aashu ining'ining'i oltoilo lenye.

English: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
Masaai: neibalunye Olaitoriani ena olong tialo iyie nchere ira olorere lenye makewan, anaa apa enaisiligie intae, naa imbung'ubung'u intae nkitanapat enyena,

English: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
Masaai: Anaa enaigero oloiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo, “Ng'ura, airriwaa olkilikuai lai dukuya enkomom ino, oitobir enkoitoi ino.

English: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani atum olom tenkaraki enkop enye, neing'urrie iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
Masaai: Asaira olayioni le Natan apa oitasheiki lelo kituaak, Sabud olayioni le Natan ninye apa olapolosani naa olchore lo laiguanani;

English: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
Masaai: Netii sii apa imisai ong'uan oo soito oogueta te nkaraki olasar opejori entemata enkaina nabo, o lpisiai enkadori, naa entemata nabo olpisiai endapasho, naa entemata nabo enkaina enkilepata, laa ninye eiteleikini intokitin pooki naayieng'ishoreki laa teine eteyieng'ieki olasar opejori.

English: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
Masaai: Neer apa menye le Kish naa Kish menye le Saul, naa Saul menye le Yonatan, o Malkishua, o Aminadab o Esbaal:

English: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
Masaai: “Naa teneaku olalashe lino aisinani te mbata iyie, nikimiraki iyie kewan enye, mincho iyie ninye mikisiaayia anaa orrindik.

English: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
Masaai: Amu aikitok Olaitoriani, naa keisisi ninye oleng, naa keyanyituni ninye aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.

English: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
Masaai: paa ore ti atua nanu nitumutumu esipata niwuasarere ti atua Kristo naibala te naitoki alotu enitii.

English: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye te ina kata, neisho Enkai enashe, neimaki ina kerai aliki lelo pooki ooanyita metalaku Enkai Yerusalem.

English: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitirrishaki Delila ninye too rorei lenyena anaake, neitagor ninye, nenauru oltau lenye oleng.

English: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oitabayie inkolong'i isiet naa kemurati, pooki lee tiatua iishoritin pooki, oloba anaa olotoiwuoki te nkaji ino, anaa oloinyanguaki too mpisai inono te pooki omoni leme oinoti linyi.

English: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki ng'ae otung'uayie inkajijik, anaa lalashera, anaa nkanashera, anaa menye anaa ng'otonye, anaa nkera, anaa nkurman te nkaraki enkarna ai naa ketum ninche enaalus enkishui nemeish.

English: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
Masaai: nedoiki ene imiet Malkija, nedoiki ene ile Mijamin,

English: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
Masaai: Olayioni apa ninye le nkoliai o losho le Naftali, ore menye naa oltung'ani le Turo, olaitobirani lo suyai; naa ngen apa ninye oleng, neeta engeno nagut sapuk o ening'unoto o enkarriyiano te nkitobirata e pooki siaai o suyai. Nelotu ninye enetii olaiguanani Solomon, neas esiaai enye pooki.

English: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

English: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atiaaki ninche, “Ara ninye,” nerrinyo siadi nebatata te nkop.

English: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
Masaai: Ketawalikia ninye Enkai ajoki aa? “Atelekaka kewan ilewa oora inkalifuni naapishana leitu egilaki kung Baal.”

English: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
Masaai: nemeetae hoo olojing'aa, nemeetae hoo obo oing'oru Enkai.

English: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
Masaai: Naa eisudoo iyie ninche te seriani e ine nitii, intaserian iyie ninche tiabori olchurie lino, te nkaraki nena kirorot torrok.

English: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
Masaai: Ore eimu Yehu kishomi, nejo ninye, “Keseriani ake iyie Simri, oloata iloikop lo lkitok lenye?”

English: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia kitung'uaitie intae nanu nipuopuo aaisiaai kulie aitin; neaku maitoki nanu akordu intae.

English: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
Masaai: Neas iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaitanapa Yoshua, nedumu isoito tomon o are te mpolos e Yordan, te risioroto e siana oo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel, anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani Yoshua; nenap ninche aaya ine wueji apa neshomo aairrag, neirragie ninche te ine.

English: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
Masaai: Ore apa kulie katitin na nkuti olong'i ake etii ina atampoi shumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, naa ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani nebik ninche too lng'oborri ore ake te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani nedumunye ninche aaidur.

English: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

English: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
Masaai: Nejoki ng'otonye laisiaayiak, “Entaas pooki najoki intae.”

English: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
Masaai: Te nemeitiship olkitok lenye, laa ninye otisiraka kewan, neisho ninye meinyiang'uni ninye, meeta ninye esipata namirakinye iltung'ana loo loreren amu etonyorra apa ninye te sunkureisho.

English: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
Masaai: Aikintajeu ninye iyie too nyamalaritin ile, ore tenaapishana nemeeta entorroni nikintoki aiseyie.

English: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
Masaai: ilayiok le Daudi kulo pooki metii ilayiok loo nkapiak; naa Tamar enkanashe enye.

English: Rejoice evermore.
Masaai: Entishipata anaake.

English: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
Masaai: O Afia enkanashe ang o Arkipos osikari te nebo iyiook, o esirit natii atua enkaji ino.

English: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
Masaai: o Alamelek, o Amad, o Mishal; ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo nelo aikop Karmel o Shihor-libnat,

English: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
Masaai: “Milo ake ajo to ltau lino, teneidip Olaitoriani aturrumoi ninche te dukuya intae, ‘Tenkaraki esupatisho ai peyie aayawua nanu Olaitoriani maawa ena kop,’ amu enkaraki entorroni e kulo oshon pee eturrumoyie Olaitoriani ninche te dukuya intae.

English: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
Masaai: Ore apa Naaman olkitok le njore o laiguanani le Siria, naa oltung'ani kitok to lkitok lenye netum omom oleng', amu te nkaraki ninye apa eishoo Olaitoriani Siria enkisulata. Oltung'ani apa magilani yioloti, kake eeta enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Masaai: Sihon olaiguanani loo Lamori apa omanya Heshbon, naa ninye apa oitore ebaiki Aroer natii olomanaa lo erata le Arnon, o metabaiki empolos o erata o metabaiki olkeju le Yabok, ilo polosie loo Lamori, aa taa, olpisiai le Gilead,

English: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
