Masaai: Etii enkuretisho, o engumoto o rreshet dukuya intae, iloomanya Moab! Olaitoriani ojo.

English: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
Masaai: Ore enkilepunoto enye naa ineeiting'ie keper eing'uaa, ore manarot enyena nelo ineeiting'ie ninche, nemeetae entoki naisudoyioki te nkirowuaj enye.

English: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
Masaai: Eikitok Olaitoriani, naa keisisi ninye oleng; keureyuni ninye aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.

English: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
Masaai: Ore peyie indip aipoo ninye, nintayu oloing'oni lemeeta entioto olmeregesh oing'uaa intare nemeeta entioto.

English: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?
Masaai: Ipikipiki ilo alem aaitaa osiligi linyi, niasiasa inolminong ore pooki ng'ae linyi neidurukie enkitok ole latia enye; ijojo iakuku iloopeny ena kop?

English: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
Masaai: Enting'iria, intae ilalashera; o metabau elotunoto o Laitoriani. Eng'ura eanyu olaturoni le nkurma ilng'anayio sidain le nkop. Neng'iri o metaba anaa netum enchan e dukuya o ene siadi.

English: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
Masaai: Ore pee emitunye shetani too ntemat enyena pooki nelo aing'uaa eanyu ai rishata enye.

English: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
Masaai: Ore enatiu, Enkai natipika rubat pooki, aa naabo, nepik ilo sesen anaa enayieu ninye.

English: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye iltung'ana neijia inchere, “Ina eitaasi oltung'ani oar ninye metua.”

English: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Emputa iltooi enkare.” Neiput metabaiki nkutukie.

English: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Naa kaitoi nanu olkeju le Nail, namiraki ina kop inkaik oo ltung'ana torrok; Kayau ina kop aitaa mitil o pooki toki natii atua ninye te ina aina oo ltung'ana leeiking'a nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki naitorogonyaki olaisinani, oe nkaraki naigorito ilo oata osina kadumunye taata nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo; “Kapik nanu ninye atua ina seriani naa ninye eng'uar.”

English: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
Masaai: Kake ti nimiaraa lelo oomaaya ina kop aaiwang'ie te dukuya intae ore lelo lilekuku netiu anaa iltidii too nkonyek inyi o lkiku too matuan inyi, naa kepuo ninche aaitanyamal intae te ina kop nipuopuo aamany.

English: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
Masaai: Ore tendama neitanap Olaitoriani enyorrata enye nauno, ore te nkewarie netii osinkolio lenye te nebo nanu, enkomono e Nkai e nkishui ai.

English: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
Masaai: Neigut penyo, neirrabalakino enkop eomon inchere, te naa keidimayu metogiroi ina kata ninye.

English: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
Masaai: Amu keidim ninche aaibelekenya ilayiok linyi maaitoki aairukurukore nanu, pee eisiaai kulie aitin enye; netum engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyupo tialo intae, naa keidim ninye aidaikie intae nabo kata.

English: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Olaitoriani, ae ti aji?” Nejoki, “Enetii empopok, eiturrurrokino lmotonyi.”

English: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Tenitushukunye iyie te seriani, neitu nanu aairorie Olaitoriani”, neitoki ninye ajo, “Entoning intae lo orere pooki!”

English: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam ooudo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Abi entito e Sekaria.

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, eitu eisho intae Musa emukate naing'uaa shumata. Kake eishorita intae Papa lai ina mukate nasipa naing'uaa shumata.

English: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
Masaai: Kaitasheyie nanu enkitoria enye ntarasi tenebik ninye aibung neitabaya nkitanapat aainei, o nkikoot aainei, anaa enatiu ninye taata.’

English: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
Masaai: Aisilig naa ajo airriu asioki te nayiolou mbaa ainei eneikunari;

English: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
Masaai: Neishoru ninche tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai ntalantani nkalifuni imiet e sahabu, o ntalantani nkalifuni tomon e nkosholai, o ntalantani nkalifuni tomon oisiet o suyai, o ntalantani nkalifuni iip nabo e sekenkei.

English: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
Masaai: Neiriamariyie engolon o Laitoriani ninche; ore lkumok ooiruko neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani.

English: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
Masaai: ore too layiok le Shekania, o too layiok le Parosh, naa Sekaria, laa te ninye eigeroki ilewa iip o onom.

English: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
Masaai: Ore to lkiyioi lenye, nikidumaki iyie enkishirata, nikinchiraki iyie ejo; ‘Aing'ae ae kata eidaikieki anaa Turo, te mpolos e naiposha?

English: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
Masaai: Ee, te iyie aidim nanu aidaikie oltim, naa te Nkai ai nanu aidim aida esuntai.

English: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
Masaai: Amu kedumunye emutata te ninche asieku, naa aing'ae oyiolo emutata nalotu eing'uaa pokira?

English: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Masaai: Mpooki nanu te hisopo, pee asinyayu; ntukuoki, pee awang'u alang enturoto.

English: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
Masaai: Too nkoitoi e nchakenisho ino nanu ashipa anaa te neshipakinoi karsisisho sapuk.

English: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
Masaai: Ore peyie aidip airoro, eitu eitoki ninche aairo, nebaiki ororei lai ninche.

English: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae anterera atua lkiku nebulu lelo kiku negor, metaa eitu eiu ilng'anayio.

English: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong nena anas enye naagol, nepuo aatiu anaa nene wuejitin neeisikieki oo le Hafi o le Amori, nenen apa neeisikie ninche te nkaraki nkera oo Siraeli. Nepuo aaku ilmuaateni.

English: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
Masaai: Ore ake anaa ina naye pooki ti atua Adam, neijia sii etiu keitopiuni kenya pooki ti atua Yesu Kristo.

English: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
Masaai: Atagorokine apa nanu iltung'ana laainei, aisarkionie nanu enjung'ore ai; aaishorua nanu apik atua nkaik inono, neitu iyie ing'urrie ninche; ore lelo moruak ntanapa iyie olola oiroishi oleng.

English: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
Masaai: Nteng'ela imasaa inono too nkuapi, ore tenkata nalotu nitum dupoto.

English: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore to lari liokuni nelotu Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda enetii olaiguanani le Israel.

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neng'amaa ina sahabu te lelo arikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip neyau atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, pee eaku entoki nadamuni too ltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
Masaai: Ore ilo obol elusie, neituruk alo te dukuya ninche, nepuo ninche aaim kishomi, neipang auluo aaim ine. olaiguanani lenye nelo dukuya ninche, Olaitoriani otii endukuya enye.

English: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
Masaai: Ashomo nanu agiroo olokeri lo ltashalai, embata enkurma oo sabibu oltung'ani lemeeta endamunoto.

English: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Masaai: Ntirring'ie iroruat aainei te risioroto e nkisiligata ino, nimincho entorroni maaitoria nanu.

English: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
Masaai: naun aitubulaa olorika le nkitoria ino te Isirael ntarasi, anaa apa enaisiligie Daudi papaai lino, ajoki, ‘Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo te Israel.’

English: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
Masaai: Amu amaa te naa ore iltung'ana ooiduruk naa keituku enkisuaakinoto o sarge loo lkineji o loo loing'ok o nkuruon e ntawuo te nkipooto o lo sesen,

English: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
Masaai: Eitu ninche ejo, ‘Koree Olaitoriani laa ninye oilepunye iyiook aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri. Laa ninye otorikoyie iyiook tiong'ota, tiatua enkop olpurkel o ngumot, tiatua ina kop olameyu o enaimin nagut, tiatua enkop nemedung hoo ng'ae, nemetii hoo oltung'ani omanya.’

English: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
Masaai: Ore ti alo tung'ani, etiu nkolong'i enyena anaa nkujit; kebul ninye anaa entapukai e ong'ata;

English: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Shobai: Alian o Manahat o Ebai, o Shefi, o Onam. Ore ilayiok le Sibeon naa Aia o Anak.

English: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
Masaai: Te neituku oltung'ani kewan nepaash iloirerioni neaku entoki naasishoreki te nkanyit, naitisinyaki pee easishore olopeny enkaji, neirragieki aaitaanyu nena siaaitin sidain.

English: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesebel ina kitok enye ninye, “Keton aa iyie oitore Israel? Tudumunye inosa endaa, nincho metishipayu oltau lino; amu kaaisho nanu iyie ina kurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot le Yesreel.”

English: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
Masaai: Neba enchata e remet enye anaa enauner ore esipil e ina remet enye naa irratilini tomon o imiet; ore ilo onap elong'o enye nelo te dukuya ninye.

English: Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.
Masaai: Asai naa intae pee kiduaayaya nanu.

English: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.
Masaai: Kake te nejo ninche, ‘Wootu elepu enikitii,’ nikilep iyiook aapuo; amu eishorua Olaitoriani ninche apik enkaina ang. Neaku ele olmonekie te iyiook.”

English: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki naiseyie nkiri eilo asar neaku sinyati; naa tenelo neisuaakino osarge lenye olkila, nintuku iyie ilo sarge tiatua ewueji sinyati.

English: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
Masaai: Eya ninche osikiria le ilo okishi; neya olkiteng le nkoliai alakie esile enye.

English: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
Masaai: Amu tiabori lelo oipi loo lkiku elo ninye ashur; neman ninye nchorroi oo nkariak.

English: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
Masaai: Ore pee epolos ilo odung'oro pooki aabaiki Pafo, netum olkuyantiki, oloiboni le lejare, Olyahudi, oji Bar-Yesu;

English: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
Masaai: o ilaiguanak pooki le Simri, ilaiguanak pooki le Elam, o ilaiguanak pooki le Amedi;

English: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
Masaai: Metii enchankar inchere olkitok ake omayian oloti,

English: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Tadoi shomo enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda, niro teine ele rorei,

English: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee aaibung'a Ilyahudi te nkaji e Nkai naajo matar matua.

English: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
Masaai: Amu ejo Lkigerot, “Ting'idayu enkolupi nemeisho, tabuaa nchira, hoo nimisaisai; amu ina kitok naton openy naata nkera kumok naalang ine ina naata olmoruo.”

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Toduaa, aishorua nanu apik nkaik inono Yeriko, te nebo olaiguanani lenye o ltung'ana magil lo larrabal.

English: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu Yerusalem osototi loo suut, olmuaate emanyisho oo mbariak naitaa nanu nkanas e Yuda mijoonto, meetae olomanya.

English: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
Masaai: (ore apa Timna naa enkapiani e Elifas, olayioni le Esau; neiki Elidas Amalek. Kulo ilayiok le Ada, enkitok e Esau.

English: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
Masaai: Metaa meekure aa are, kake osesen obo. Ore enaidikidiko, Enkai, mincho erish oltung'ani.”

English: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
Masaai: Neji enkarna e ilo akira enduaran, neitaduari neye ematua e uni e nkare iltung'ana kumok te ina are, amu eitaduaraki.

English: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
Masaai: “Toning'oki nanu, na aji e Yakobo, o ele pisiai pooki le nkaji e Israel, apa laatoikioki nanu ebaiki pee eini intae, oowaki apa ebaiki itii nguseti;

English: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
Masaai: o tiong'ata teine apa netodolie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi enap intae, anaa enanap oltung'ani enkerai enye teina oitoi apa pooki niima o metaba anaa nipuonunu ene wueji.

English: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
Masaai: Yohat apa ninye olkitok, naa Sisa o liare; kake meeta apa Yeush o Beria ilayiok kumok, neaku eitaaki ninche olmarei obo.

English: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
Masaai: Neitanap Yuda pee eing'oru Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neibung nkitanapat enyena.

English: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
Masaai: Ore ina kata neilepie Enkiyang'et Sinyati Yesu arik ong'ata metetema shetani.

English: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Shobal: Alfan, o Manahat, o Ebal, o Shefo o Onom.

English: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
Masaai: o esidai o lmuntut o motonyi e naiposha, o lenkalem, o mpukunot enye pooki.

English: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ore tena kewarie, naa aikisikisiki pooki aaing'uaa nanu amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaosh olchekut neisardaka emboo oo nkerra.’

English: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
Masaai: Ng'ura, etiu iloshon anaa olkitong'ati le enkare naitong to ltoo, eikununo nkuapi anaa enkinyi terit napuyiapui; ng'ura, kedumu ninye lemankale pooki anaa enkini terit napuyiapui.

English: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Yedaia aa taa enkaji e Yoshua, naa iip naaudo o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.

English: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
Masaai: Ore sii Yoshua o Bani o Sherebia o Yamin, o Akub, o Shabetai, o Hodia, o Maaseia, o Kelita, o Asariaf, o Yosabad, o Hanan, o Pelaia lelo apolosak neretu iltung'ana aaitoning'u nkitanapat, ina kata etii iltung'ana iwuejitin enye.

English: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
Masaai: Ke nkata nabaa, Olaitoriani, eikoroj iyiook olmang'atinta? Kesukeny olmang'atinta enkarna ino ntarasi?

English: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
Masaai: Ore apa te siadi ena, te nkitoria e Artaseses olaiguanani le Parsia, ore Esra olayioni le Seraia, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Hilkia,

English: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa Nimrod naa olang'oroni magilani te dukuya Olaitoriani. Ore enkaraki ina etejoki, “Olotiu anaa Nimrod olang'oroni magilani te dukuya Olaitoriani.”

English: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
Masaai: Etiu apa ng'utunyi anaa osabibu le nkurma, otuunokoki embata enkare, oiu ilng'anayio nebore sii ilng'osil, te nkaraki enkare sapuk.

English: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
Masaai: Amu etaa nanu kabatata, neton ake aata emion ai.

English: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
Masaai: Neisho taa Yoshua iltung'ana meshomo, oltung'ani ake nelo enjung'ore enye.

English: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
Masaai: Entasheikinoto enkomono emingusugus, irripishosho nisholololo, niomonokiki sii ninche iyiook,

English: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
Masaai: Einosa loo papaai linyi mana ti ong'ata netuata.

English: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
Masaai: Iwa enker naisul eluaata, nipik ilkeek le nkima abori enye; nintokitokie indung'ot enyena, nintokitokie sii iloik lenyena tiatua.

English: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai ninye teina kidetidet, “Ee ekayiolo ajo itaasa ena te supatisho oltau lino, kake nanu laaibooyie peyie mikintaas eng'oki, metaa eitu aaisho iyie iseyie ninye.

English: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD, shall be put to death.
Masaai: Ore ilo omor enkarna o Laitoriani neari metua. Near ninye olturrur pooki too soito, ilo omoni o ilo inoti. Tenemor ninye ina Arna neari metua.

English: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

English: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing aji, nedol ina kerai o Mariamu ng'otonye, negil kung aaserem ninye; nebol ilbenia lenye neitaiki ninye inkishorot; sahabu o enkorropil o emanoo.

English: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani dukuya o meshomo Gilgal, nelo Kimham te nebo ninye; ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lpisiai sii loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, neriku olaiguanani te nkoitoi enye.

English: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
Masaai: Kake keoshokini ina kop enkukuo; te risioroto oo nkarn oo loshon loo loo menye enjung ninche.

English: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
Masaai: Neaku eitobira apa Solomon ntokitin pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani: ilo perere lo lasar le sahabu, ina misa e sahabu tenkaraki emukate naitisinyaki

English: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
Masaai: eyaua ninye ninche aitupuku ti atua enaimin o loip le keeya, negil iyenat enye tukul.

English: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
Masaai: Eimaka Yudas olayioni le Simon Iskariot, amu obo apa ninye te lelo tomon oare, laa ninye oyooki akaldaa.

English: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
Masaai: Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Metobikoi olaiguanani ntarasi! Kainyoo pee meisinanuo enkomom ai, aa ore enkanasa, ine netii nkuraren oo loo papa, netaa olmuate, ore nchomito enyena, netumuta enkima?”

English: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
Masaai: Iponaa iyie enkanyit ai, nikintoki nanu aitagol oshoke.

English: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
Masaai: Ore ilo mang'atinta oun naa shetani, ore enkisampuare, naa enkiting'oto e nkop, ore ilooisampu naa ilmalaika.

English: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.
Masaai: Ore enkarna enkaji enye kemookini aajo te Israel, enkaji e ilo oitayioki enamuke te nkeju enye.

English: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
Masaai: Embelekenyakinoto ilo apa litogolong'akitia oleng, lo tung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
Masaai: kake ore oloas esipata, kelotu enewang pee eibalayu iasat enyena inchere etaasaki ti atua Enkai.

English: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo supati metishipata te nkitoo; nchoo ninche eranyisho te ng'ida too ndapashi enye.

English: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
Masaai: Amu keisho ninye olmalaika lenye mikitagolie iyie, nikirrip too nkoitoi inono pooki.

English: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
Masaai: “Entoor ate ewuang'a tena umata, pee atum nanu aidaikie ninche nabo kata.”

English: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
Masaai: “Kake ore te nena olong'i, etulusoitie lelo sinaitin, nemisimisu enkolong, nemeitoki olapa awang'u

English: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Eewuo oltung'ani anang'are iyiook, nejoki iyiook, ‘Entorrinyoto enchom enetii ilo aiguanani oirriwua intae, nijokiki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kenkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israel pee irriwayie ilkiliku meshomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron? Ore enkaraki ina midou iyie teina dapash nitii, kake iye iyie.’ ”

English: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani: “Kajutu tioriong enkop oltung'ani laitobira, tung'ani tenebo eng'ues, o pooki toki naiserpepiari, o motonyi o loing'ang'e, amu aanyaaka ainosu ajo ainyoo apa peyie aitobirua ninche.”

English: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
Masaai: Naa tenemenejia etiu, aing'ae ooidim aitisipa nchere kara olalejani, neitodolu ajo meetae esipata te pooki natejo nanu?”

English: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
Masaai: “Aaitaboitaka iyie olmalaika likirrip. Itii apa iyie enchumata oldoinyio sinyati le Nkai, nishomo aimaa isoito le nkima.

English: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
Masaai: Ore ilbarnot tomon anapak loo masaa o larrabal e Yoab, neman ninche Absalom neosh ninye near ninye metua.

English: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
Masaai: Ning'idayuyu intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, o layiok linyi o ntoyie inyi o sinkan lewa, o sinkan inyi ng'oruo, o lawi ootii atua nkang'itie inyi, enkaraki nemeeta ninye erubata aashu enjung'ore tiatua intae.

English: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii tena neikirikira oltau lai, nepuku aing'uaa ewueji enye.

English: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
Masaai: “Imbung'a ina naaitanap iyie ena olong. Ng'ura, kaaraa nanu aipang'ie te dukuya intae Ilamori, Ilkanaani, Ilhiti, Ilperesi o Ilhifi, o Lyebusi.

English: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
Masaai: Amu meitoki eng'oki aitore intae, amu meekure itii abori nkitanapat kake abori empiris.

English: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
Masaai: neeni oltau lai too nkisudorot mayiolo, netung'ututa enkutuk ai enkaina ai;

English: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, miim ina oitoi tenebo ninche, imboo enkeju ino pee meim inkoitoi enye;

English: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
Masaai: Etiaka apa Elisha ina kitok naitopiwuoki enkerai enye, “Inyo tenebo olmarei lino, shomo tamanya ewueji neba anaa enitamanya, amu eipotuo Olaitoriani olameyu, naa kelotu ajing ena kop too larin oopishana.”

English: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
Masaai: nening olpayian lenye ina, neitu ejoki ninye ae, neitu erishie ninye; ore ilo mumai lenye pooki naa keunoyu, ore enkiroroto ake pooki nateenie ninye kewan naa keunoyu.

English: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
Masaai: Neijia entotiu sii intae, na kituaak entadou ate too lpayiani paa te netii te ninche olemeiruk Ororei, netumi aateyietu metii ororei te nkaraki olkuaak loo nkituaak enye,

English: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Nerishu sii ewang'an tiatua enaimin, nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

English: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
Masaai: Nimikiosh iyie enkolong te ndama, anaa olapa te nkewarie.

English: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
Masaai: Kake kejoki ninye ntae, ‘Ajoki ntae, mayiolo nanu kaji ng'uaa; entalamaki nanu, intae pooki oora laasak loo ntorrok?’

English: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
Masaai: inchoo enkitok ai eyieraki likae lee, naa inchoo ilkulikae eirrugokino ninye.

English: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
Masaai: “Takedo ele doinyo le Abarim, oldoinyo le Nebo, otii enkop e Moab, oipirakinore Yeriko; ning'or ina kop e Kanaan naisho nanu iltung'ana le Israel meitaa enenye;

English: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kake ore naa tena kata, meekure aitaas ilekunot le kulo tung'ana anaa enaikuna too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
Masaai: Kadamu nanu isiaaitin inono pooki, naing'asia te nena kiasin magil.

English: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
Masaai: Bet-araba, o Semaraim, o Betel,

English: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore tadekenya nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,

English: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, keikashieki Sodom o Gomora te ina ang te nkolong enkiguana.

English: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino Hesekia esuntai neomon Olaitoriani ejo,

English: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
Masaai: Tenajo nanu, “Maitoki aimaki ninye, arashu aigil airo te nkarna enye.” Nejing atua oltau lai anaa enatiu enkima nayupuyup naikenoro tiatua iloik laainei, nanaure nanu ajo aibookino, nemaidim nanu.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
Masaai: “Entiaki iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Kuna ntokitin naaishu nindimidimi intae aainosa tiatua ing'uesi pooki naatii oriong enkop.

English: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
Masaai: Netii nkikompeni uni naaitayioki aaikunu anaa ilgululu, meetae ake ene meeta endukuya e entapukai, o lng'osila o nkikompeni uni naaitayioki aaikunu anaa ilgululu, meetae ake ene meeta endukuyao entapukai to likae ng'osila; nepuo lelo ng'osil pokira ile aaipang te ina kitashet o ltaa.

English: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
Masaai: Nelikini olaiguanani le Asiria aajoki, “Ore lelo oshon apa liwa te araroto nilo apik nkanas e Asiria, meyiolo ninche nkitanapat e Nkai eina kop. Ore enkaraki ina eirriwayie ninye ilng'atunyo atua ninche, naa ng'ura, earita ninche iltung'ana metuata. Amu meyiolo ninche nkitanapata e Nkai eina kop.”

English: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
Masaai: Naariku nanu atua endung'oroto e oriong; naa ng'ura, etii ilgilat olgos o manaa teilo odung'oro; ilgilat tomoni uni ootii dukuya ilo gos.

English: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
Masaai: Neng'or iltung'ana loo mbaa isinkan linono te suntai; netuata embata oo sinkan lo laiguanani; ore osinka lino Uria Olhiti netua sii ninye.”

English: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho dama nkolong'i pooki te nkaji e Nkai, kake ore kewarie neipang alo airrag oldoinyo oji oloo Loirienito.

English: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
Masaai: Ina pee ejo Lea, “Ashipa nanu! amu kaaipot nanu inkituaak aajo nashipa.” Ina pee eipot enkarna enye ajo Asheri.

English: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
Masaai: Neipot enkerai neitasheyie te mpolos enye.

English: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
Masaai: Naa te nining'ining'i njoreitin o lmarenke loo njoreitin, eming'aing'ae; amu meeta nchere pee metiu neijia; kake eton eng'or ina kiting'oto.

English: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
Masaai: “Koree doi ina oitoi nalo emanyisho e wang'an, naa koree emanyisho e enaimin,

English: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
Masaai: “Ore too nkiterunot oo lapaitin linyi ninchooyoyo olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani: iloing'ok oare ooti, o lmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto;

English: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Metaa tiaaki ninche, ena ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Entushukunye enatii, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa kashukokino sii nanu intae, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
Masaai: Neitobir sii aitaman isunta eina aji nkajijik naakedo too nchot pooki.

English: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
Masaai: Ekuetu ilakedok loo mbartan, eimerlel ilalema neiwuang'u iremeta, olorora olo aye osototi loo mpopoki. Meeta eneiting'ie mpopoki enye nerrorro ninche te nena popoki enye!

English: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
Masaai: Ore ilo ojo te wang'an eloito neton ake eiba olalashe lenye neton etii ilo atua enaimin.

English: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo oanyisho nelotu nena olong'i enkalifu, iip uni o tomoni uni.

English: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo laapong nanu, nepik kewan olbae; ore lelo laaiba nanu nenyor keeya.”

English: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father's house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kepuonu inkolong'i, pee adung' nanu engolon inyi o engolon e nkaji e papaai lino, metaa meitoki atii oltung'ani kitok atua enkaji ino.

English: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumunye ilo tung'ani ajo alo, neitirrishaki olaputani ninye, o menyaaki aigil aairrag ine.

English: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore ilo lo lmumai nebarn ina dukuya enye naitisinyaki te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neya ninye lelo papit le ndukuya enye naitisinyaki nelo apik enkima ti abori ilo asar le seriani.

English: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Saul, “Emincho oltung'ani hoo obo epalari te nkaraki ninye; kelo osinka lino aarare ele Filisti.”

English: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
Masaai: Neetae oloiteng'eni te Dameski oji Ananias. Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye te nduaata, “Ananias,” nejo ninye, “nele nanu, Olaitoriani.”

English: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
Masaai: Neituku ninye isorri e nkoshoke o loilelek nepejoo ninche tenebo ilo asar opejori te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
Masaai: naa ore amu eitabayioki, etaa ninye enjeunoto oo ntarasi te lelo pooki ooning ninye,

English: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
Masaai: Nening Musa iltung'ana eyietu aaishir too lmareita lenye, oltung'ani ake te kutukaji o lng'obor lenye; neyupuyup airowuaju engoro o Laitoriani oleng, neisinanuo Musa.

English: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
Masaai: Enkomono ena e Habakuki oloiboni le Nkai, te risioroto e Shiginot.

English: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
Masaai: Eshomo apa iloo papaai linyi Misiri aa iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana; ore taata neitotiuo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi anaa ilakir le shumata te nkumoi.

English: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
Masaai: nerik iltung'ana lenyena le sotua, nepuo aasuj ninye inkolong'i naapishana esuj aigutaki ninye oleng toldoinyo le Gilead.

English: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
Masaai: Neishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, ejo, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki ti alo iyie, enkaraki nikitung'uaitie Enkai ang nikisiaai inkaitin e Baal.”

English: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
Masaai: Kedol Ashkelon ina neureishoyu; neijia sii etiu Gasa, nemerregela te mion sapuk, neijia sii etiu Ekron, amu keiting osiligi lenye. Ekeidaikieki olaiguanani le Gasa, nepuoi aaisik aaing'uaa Ashkelon memanya.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu imbalie te nkutuk ino inemesipa nitoduaa elejare, neaku ng'ura, kaagilunore iyie, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
Masaai: Itudung'okito enkiguana niaariara metua oltung'ani supat lemeirish ninye intae.

English: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oitapong'oo oltung'ani modooni te nkoitoi.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani. Meisisi enkarna o Laitoriani, enchoru enkisisa intae isinkan lo Laitoriani,

English: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
Masaai: Penyo netunoki ninche, penyo neibung'a ntona, narumishoyu te nkop, penyo neibung'a ntona enye enkop, te nekut ninye ninche netoyu, neya osiwuo ninche anaa suut.

English: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
Masaai: o nkituaak naaishiunyeki loiriruani o nkeyaitin: Mariamu Magdalena, nataarayioki loiriruani oopishana metung'uai,

English: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
Masaai: Neiger Musa ena kitanapata neisho ilapolosak lelo ayiok le Lawi, apa ootanapa osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, o lpayiani pooki le Israel.

English: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidipayu olasar, neirrugo olaiguanani o lelo pooki ootii tenebo ninye aaserem.

English: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Mushi naa: Mahali, o Eder, o Yeremot, lelo pokira okuni.

English: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
Masaai: Ijojo sii ore oloinosie olmumai olperere lo lasar, neme toki kake ore oloinosie olmunmai enkishorunoto natii olperere lo lasar, neen ilo mumai.

English: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neim lelo tung'ana okuni magil atua ilng'oborri loo Lfilisti; neoku enkare te ilo shorro le Betlehem apa otii embata e kishomi, neyaki Daudi. Kake eitu eok; eibukoyie ninye abukoki Olaitoriani,

English: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
Masaai: Ti nikiomonono entoki te nkarna ai naa kaas ina.

English: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nijing iyie enkisiaayiare e ine wueji sinyati o enkisiaayiare o lperere lo lasar pee meitoki alotu engoro shumata iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
Masaai: Netoni pooki te dukuya ninye anaa enaikunari te mbotoro eiteru to lbotor te inoto ometabaiki oloti te inoto anaa kitisho enye; neing'or iltung'ana ate te nking'asia sapuk.

English: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
Masaai: Ina pee tejo, ‘Ng'ura nele nanu, oewuo pee aas eniyieu, eyieunoto ino, Na Ai ai!’ anaa enatisiraki tialo nanu ti atua olpiyayati le mbuku.”

English: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.
Masaai: Neaku meidim iltung'ana le Israel aaitasheiki ilmang'ati lenye, eibelekenyate ninche aaisho oriong ilmang'ati lenye, enkaraki nataa ninche entoki e nkidaata. Maitoki ae kata nanu aaku te nebo iyie, aashu ake ti nindaikie nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki aitung'uaa atua intae.

English: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
Masaai: Naa kadou nanu alotu airorie intae te ine. Naa kaya nanu embata e ina kiyang'et natii shumata iyie napik shumata ninche; naa kenap ninche ilo ola le kulo tung'ana te nebo iyie, pee mintoki iyie anap openy.

English: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilkituaak pooki enetii Yeremia neikilikuan ninye, newaliki ninche anaa enatiaka ninye olaiguanani. Nepuo ninche aaing'uaa ninye, amu ore ina kiroroto neitu apa ening'i.

English: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
Masaai: Amu eibala olosho le Yuda etoikioki Olaitoriani lang, naa ore te ilo osho, neitu ejo Musa ae naipirta ilapolosak.

English: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
Masaai: nikietuoki aakur te ninche nchere ishomo aiteng'en Ilyahudi pooki ootii Loreren metung'uai Musa, eji nepal memurat inkera enye nemesuj lkerreti lang.

English: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
Masaai: naa ijo, “Ekaiba apa enkitamioto naautarieki netanya oltau lai ererioroto!

English: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.
Masaai: Neomon ninye, neng'amaa Enkai esayiata enye, o enkomono enye, neitoki Enkai arrinyoki ninye enkitoria enye tiatua Yerusalem. Neyiolou taa Manase ajo Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.

English: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
Masaai: “Ore te iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Irorie imotonyi e pooki pukunoto o pooki pukunoto eng'ues e ong'ata, ‘Enturrurrunye wootu, enturrurroto too nkaloli pooki enturrurrokinoto ina masho o lasar ilo laitobiraki intae, e masho kitok oleng o lasar te nchumata e lelo doinyo le Israel, naa inosinoso inkiri niokioko osarge.

English: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
Masaai: o lalashe lenye Asafu laa ninye apa oitashe te nkalo enye e tatene, aa taa Asafu ole Berekia, olayioni le Shimea,

English: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
Masaai: Amu etiu empaasharoto anaa esakutore, ore engolon e nkong'u naa esuujisho anaa eseremata oo ntokitin neme Enkai. Ore enkaraki nitanya ororei lo Laitoriani, kitanya sii ninye iyie pee miaku olaiguanani.”

English: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
Masaai: Naa kaaitajeu te kulo tung'ana o too Loreren laa ninche aairriwaki

English: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
Masaai: Neiko ninye neijia aitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ine wueji sinyati, te nkaraki enkiduruk oo ltung'ana le Israel, o te nkaraki nkitapong'ot enye, o ngok enye pooki; neiko sii neijia te nkaraki ilo ng'obor le ntumo, otii tenebo ninche empolos oo lduruki lenye.

English: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
Masaai: “Ena enkitanapata o lasar le ntapa. Ilayiok le Aron ooishooyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya ilo perere lo lasar.

English: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
Masaai: Teneyam oltung'ani entito o ng'otonye tenebo, naa entorroni ina, naa kepejori ninche te nkima, ilo lee o nena kituaak, pee meitoki esuujisho atii atua intae.

English: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
Masaai: Nejo Rusi, ina tito oo Lmoabu, “Ore te nebo nena, aatiaaka ninye, ‘Tataaniki ilaisiayiak laainei, o metaba anaa neidip enkisampuare.’ ”

English: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
Masaai: kake mindimidimi ainosa kuna, olkurragos, olmotonyi loo lmurran o mpukunot oo sidan,

English: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Masaai: Ore hoo neen ate aaitupukoo, maning nanu olkiyioi lenye, naa ore hoo neishoru ninche ilasarri oopejori o lasar le ntapa, mang'amu nanu ninche; kake kamut nanu ninche to lalem, o to lameyu o tolmeitai.”

English: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
Masaai: Ore eing'asiate pooki nemilo neikilikuana taa ake aajo, “Ainyoo eutu ena bae?”

English: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nepuo ile Lawi atua aas enkisiaayiare enye ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, aasisho ti abori Aron o layiok lenyena. Ore anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa too naaipirta ile Lawi ina ninye eitaasa ninche.

English: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani leme asipani naa olminong te lelo supati, kake ore ilo oitoriori enkoitoi enye naa olminong' te lelo torrok.

English: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
Masaai: Nejoki Yosef ninche, “Kaa bae ena nikintaasa? Aimiyiololo aajo ore oltung'ani laijo nanu naa kaidim aibonisho?”

English: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
Masaai: Etakekenutuo aajo kalo tung'ani naa kaa kata etuutua Enkiyang'et e Kristo natii atua ninche, ina kata apa namurutoo aalimu inkisilisilot e Kristo o enkitoo nasuju.

English: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
Masaai: Eeta eseriani kitok lelo oonyor enkitanapata ino; meetae entoki narror ninye.

English: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Helkat te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Rehob te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
Masaai: Naa te neewuo oltung'ani leiking'a amanyisho te nebo intae, aashu te netii likae tung'ani atua intae too ishoritin inyi, neyieu ninye neishoru olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, nchoo ninye eas anaa eniasiasa.

English: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
Masaai: Einyototo ninye eton aa kewarie, neitobiraki enkaji enye pooki endaa nanya, neing'uraki inkaisiaayiak enyena esiaai naas.

English: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le ngoro napi naa kelak enkitamioto enye; amu tinilaku ninye taata, naa iyooki ake aigil alaku.

English: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
Masaai: Ore ilooti tung'ana oare le pesho, nepuonu aaitang'or ninye, nepuonu lelo le pesho aaishankarrare Nabot te dukuya iltung'ana, ejo, “Etediaa Nabot Enkai o laiguanani.” Neya ninche ninye auluo enkanasa nenang ninye metua too soito.

English: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
Masaai: Metaa era iishoritin ebaiki Abraham o metabaiki Daudi iishoritin tomon o ong'uan; ore ebaiki Daudi o metabaiki yararoto e Babilon era iishoritin tomon o ong'uan; ore ebaiki e yararoto e Babilon o metabaiki Kristo nera iishoritin tomon o ong'uan.

English: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Elisha nenukari ninye. Ore ilooti wuampan loo Lmoabu naa kegira apa aarasaki ina kop te rishata o loirujuruj teilo ari.

English: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
Masaai: Misioki enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, niming'arie likae tung'ani ng'ok enyena, torripo kewan taa sinyati.

English: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani aitalioo kewan te Solomon kewarie nejoki ninye, “Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino, nategelua ene wueji te nkaraki kewan ai pee eaku enkaji o lasar.

English: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisilig endamunoto enye naa olmodai, kake ore ilo olo te ng'eno nagut naa kekorduni.

English: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
Masaai: Amu te naa keimulumularo Lomon lang Supati, naa te lelo ake oopuo enkiminata eimulumularo.

English: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajoki ninye, “Kaa iyiook kintaas iyie, pee etum enaiposha aitirring'ayu te iyiook?” Amu etoponari enaiposha ailugo oleng.

English: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
Masaai: Kake ore taaisere, neyieu ninye ake neyiolou enaitang'orie Lyahudi Paulo pee eisitaaitie, neen ninye, nejoki lapolosak kituaak o lkiaama pooki menototo, neriku Paulo neitasheyie te dukuya ninche.

English: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
Masaai: Esipa ira iyie Enkai naisudoo kewan, iyie na Ai e Israel, Olaitajeunoni.

English: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
Masaai: o Kenas, o Kora, o Gatam o Amalek; kulo ilarikok le Elifas te nkop e Edom; Naa ilayiok le Ada.

English: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
Masaai: Ore olng'ur lenye netii shumata lelo ooure ninye too ishoritin pooki.

English: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;
Masaai: Ore eidipa kuna pooki aatadoiki iyiook te nkaraki nkiaasin ang torrok o te nkitarruoroto ang kitok, nikidol aajo, iyie Enkai ang naitamio, aitodorropu too nkitarruorot ang, ninchoo iyiook olpisiai loo lekunot oba nji.

English: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika e Israel. Ore ake etiu neijia nemeeta apa oltau le Asa eleyiata too nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.

English: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
Masaai: ejoito, “Osarge ele lo sotua oitanapa intae Enkai.”

English: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
Masaai: Kuna ninche iishoritin e keper o enkop ina kata pee eitobiri. Ore te nkolong apa naitobirua Olaitoriani Enkai enkop o keper,

English: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani otoduaa Enkai ae kata; te nikinyorra maate, nebik Enkai ti atua iyiook neitabari enyorrata enye ti atua iyiook.

English: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, meikenayu ilmang'ati laainei! Aatudumakinote nanu ilkumok aagilunore;

English: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
Masaai: Metaa aikigili iyie nikirragieki tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem.

English: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
Masaai: ore mikiaata ntiyot, nikiaata eyiolounoto, o eng'iriata o lng'ur; te Nkiyang'et Sinyati, o te nyorrata,

English: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.
Masaai: Nelotu Gideon o lelo tung'ana iip apa ootii te nebo ninye auluo e nkang oo lng'oborri te mpolos e nkewarie, ina kata ake pee eibelekenya ilarripok, nekut ninche intarumpetani, nedany lelo tooiapa ootii nkaik enye.

English: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neya Musa oloikulu neyuk ninye anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; erubata apa e Musa ena to lmeregesh lo lasar le nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki neishoori, ina eilata olkidong'oe, oina kurriny pooki naimulumulita enkoshoke,

English: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
Masaai: Kake, ilo orere ake etoduaa Ilyahudi, neigany olom, neishankarru nena naatejo Paulo, nemor Enkai.

English: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD'S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
Masaai: “Esika entung'uai empolos e Babilon, enchoo pooki tung'ani eitajeu enkishui enye! Emincho edung'ori intae te nkitamioto enye amu enkata e lap o Laitoriani ena, enkitalakunoto naitalak ninye.

English: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
Masaai: Ore tioriong nena rishinani o tioriong nkeek neguetaki ilkerubi, o lng'atunyo, o iltuka, te risioroto e rishata e nabo ake enye, neitaman olmarisian.

English: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
Masaai: Naa kaing'or nanu intae naisho intae entoisho napon intae, naitadedeyie nanu osotua lai o intae.

English: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
Masaai: Naa kelotu alej nkuapi naatii lubot pokira ong'uan e nkop, aa taa Gog o Magog, neiturrur ninche te nkaraki olarrabal, neba esiana enye anaa osinyai le naiposha.

English: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye nedaa neokisho, nelo te ngolon eina daa nainosa too nkolong'i artam, o nkewarietin artam, omeshomo Horeb ilo doinyo le Nkai.

English: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
Masaai: Aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani Enkai olng'ejep te nkaraki lelo ooiteng'eni, pee atum nanu aitagolo to rorei ilo otalepori. Ore anaake tadekenya, naaputu ninye matoning'o te nkiok ai, matoning'o anaa lelo ooiteng'eni.

English: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Ninye ake sii oitasheyie intae o meiting'o miatata entorrono naiguanareki te intae te ina olong o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki, o te nkiyang'et ino pooki, o te ng'eno ino pooki, o te ngolon ino pooki, ninyorru o le latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.”

English: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
Masaai: Kitiu iyiook pooki anaa nkerra naaimina, kishomo aaidapashari; kimbelekenyakinote oltung'ani ake enkoitoi enye; neiteleikia Olaitoriani shumata ninye entorroni ang pooki.

English: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Hesekia ilapolosak o Lawi tenkaraki lelo sotot.

English: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
Masaai: Neipotu Musa iltung'ana pooki le Israel nejoki ninche, “Itoduaa intae ina pooki nataasa Olaitoriani too nkonyek inyi te nkop e Misiri, ina naitaasa Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki o enkop enye pooki,

English: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon oobo Eliashib, nedoiki ene tomon oare Yakim,

English: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
Masaai: Enyor apa Solomon Olaitoriani, nelo too nkikoot e Daudi papaai lenye. Kake eitayu apa ninye ilasarri nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
Masaai: Eitu ninche kisiaai iyie te nkitoria enye, naa ore te supatisho ino kitok ninchoo iyie ninche, o te nkop sidai nalala nitipika iyie dukuya ninche, neitu ninche errinyunye aaing'uaa isiaaitin enye torrok.

English: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
Masaai: ejo ‘Embelekenyata taata, pooki ng'ae te intae, aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono o nkiaasin torrok, nibikibiki ti oriong ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani intae ebaiki apa o ntarasi;

English: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani o Haman ilo sirua te nebo Esta enkitok o laiguanani.

English: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
Masaai: “ ‘Kake tenikining'ining'i intae nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, nimintijing'ung'u olola too nchomito ena anasa te nkolong e sabato, kake nintaa enkolong e sabato sinyati nimiasishosho teina olong,

English: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, teyietu inchiraki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nijoki ninye: “Itadamua iyie aitaa kewan olng'atuny tiatua iloreren, kake itiu iyie anaa olasurai otii inaaiposha; idanya iyie apuku too lkejek linono, nintanyamal inkariak too nkejek inono, nindurukie ilkejek lenye.

English: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan nesinyayu ilng'anayio lenye pooki, enkishoroto enkisisa to Laitoriani.

English: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaishiraki Olaitoriani metaretu; amu eeta apa ninye ngarrin iip naaudo oo sekenke, neisomita apa iltung'ana le Israel te nkisikong'ata too larin tikitam.

English: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
Masaai: Nesujaa Ilmisiri, nepuo atua emirta ninche nepuo empolos e naiposha, mbartan pooki e Farao, ngarrin oo mbartan enyena, o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan.

English: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.
Masaai: Amu ore ena yasata e ina kitok o laiguanani naa keyiolou nkituaak pooki, nemenu ilpayiani lenye, te neimakini aajo eitanapishe olaiguanani Serser ajo meyauni Fashiti dukuya enye, neany elotu.

English: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
Masaai: Ae ng'ae lemeureisho neisis enkarna ino, Olaitoriani. Amu iyie ake openy osinyati. Eikipuonu nkuapi pooki aserem iyie, amu ore inkiguanat inono neidipaki aaibalunye.”

English: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
Masaai: Ore naa enchoo metagolo nkaik inyi, nipijuju; amu etua Saul olkitok linyi, naatubukokitio nanu enkaji e Yuda eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata ninche.”

English: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Ore ilturrurri loo layiok le Aron naa ninche kulo. Ore ilayiok le Aron naa: Nadab, o Abihu, o Eliesa, o Itamar,

English: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
Masaai: Kulo apa ootii enkisiaayiare o laiguanani, metii lelo apa ootipika olaiguanani nkanas naasheta sunta te Yuda pooki.

English: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
Masaai: Eitaraposho iloata esumash too ntokitin sidain, nearaa ilkarsisi erook.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aitabaya nanu nkisiligat apa naitayio nanu te nkaji e Israel o te nakaji e Yuda.

English: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
Masaai: Etetema olaikooni aing'oru irorei ooitishipisho; neiger aitobiraki irorei oosipa.

English: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
Masaai: Ore kulikae lenye neitasheiki imasaa e nkisiaayiare, amu keyieuni apa neikeni ninche teneitijing'uni o teneipang'ieki aaya.

English: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
Masaai: Kake ore ilo rorei ojo “Eikenakaki”, mme enkaraki ninye ake pee etisiraki;

English: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
Masaai: Nelikini Solomon aajoki, “Ng'ura keure Adonija olaiguanani Solomon; amu eji eibung'a ninye imouarak o lperere lo lasar, nejo, ‘Nchoo olaiguanani Solomon eng'as ainos olmumai nchere mesesekuan ninye osinka lenye to lalem.’ ”

English: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
Masaai: neitoki sii Olaitoriani aishooyo ninye o laiguanani lenye apik atua enkaina e Israel; near Yoshua ninye te nepi o lalem, o pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye; eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani obo ti atua ninye eishu; neitaas olaiguanani lenye anaa apa enaitaasa olaiguanani le Yeriko.

English: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
Masaai: Ore nena kera inyi nitejo intae keidaikieki o nkera inono, nena nemeyiolo taata ninche esidai o entorrono, kepuo ninche atua ine, naa kaisho nanu ninche ina kop, naa keya ninche aaitaa enenye.

English: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
Masaai: Ore te nkaina ai e tatene einyeito ilmang'ati, naareu ninche nanu aarrumoo, naapikaki nanu aarare inkoitoi enye e nkidaaroto.

English: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi, neikeni pooki oata ilarin tomoni uni neilep, ore esiana enye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni oisiet.

English: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
Masaai: Ina pee aigeroko intae aiko neijia, pee te nalotu nemaitame lelo ooishiaakino neaku ninche laaiting'id. Amu ayiolo intae ajo ang'ida nanu ning'idada sii intae.

English: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.
Masaai: Neaku te ina olong apa o larrabal nemetumi olalem arashu empere te nkaina e likae tung'ani obo le lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo Saul o Yonatan; kake eeta apa Saul o Yonatan, olayioni lenye.

English: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
Masaai: Niya ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono, nena nikitoikio nanu, nintainye ninche olasar peyie emuti. Amaa isiaitin inono enkiborra oo nkonyek kenkiti toki apa

English: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
Masaai: Nepuku ninye aing'uaa ninche alo aishir; neshukunye airorie ninche. Neitayu ninye Simon tiatua ninche neen ninye te dukuya ninche.

English: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
Masaai: Newaliki esiamo aajoki, “Kitoning'o too nkitanapat nchere ebik Kristo ntarasi; oo naa pee ijo iyie meeta nchere pee meilepieki Enkerai e Tung'ani. Ai ng'ae doi ena Kerai e Tung'ani?”

English: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
Masaai: Neitadoyio ninye ninche te nkeene aimie elusie, amu ore apa enkaji enye naa esuntai e nkanasa apa eshetakino.

English: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
Masaai: Nepolos Balak ilmong'i o ntare, neyaki Balaam o lelo kituaak ootii te nebo ninye.

English: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
Masaai: Kake eitu eshilaa Yesu ina natejoki, nejoki oloitore enkaji e ntumo, “Miureishoyu, iruko ake iyie.”

English: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
Masaai: Eibung orreshet entutunyo enye, neirrag orreshet oibung ninye.

English: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
Masaai: Naa kainyoo pee ilepunye iyiook aitupuku te Misiri, ayau iyiook ene wueji torrono? Mme ewueji ene e nkurma, aashu ilng'abolo aashu isabibu aashu ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka; nemetii enkare naoki.”

English: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
Masaai: ina naisho nanu intae, ninchosho Olaitoriani nkishorot naaing'uaa eluata oo nkishu, aashu enoo ntare, olasar le nkima aashu olasar opejori, aashu olasar ake duo, pee intabayaya ilo mumai aashu olasar lo lpela, aashu too lasarri linyi ootegeluaki pee intobirakiki esong'ouna narropil Olaitoriani,

English: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ntokitin naataaruaki to larrabal, neitisiny ninche nena kishorot pee eitobirieki enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
Masaai: Near ninche ina olong iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni tomon loo Lmoabu, oogol pooki, eitu ninye eimisho obo.

English: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
Masaai: Mapik nanu dukuya nkonyek aainei entoki ake pooki torrono. Kaiba nanu esiaai e lelo ooibelekenyate aaing'uaa Enkai; manyikaki nanu.

English: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
Masaai: Nejoki oltung'ani obo otii atua ilo orere, “Olaiteng'enani, tiaaki olalashe lai maatooriki enjung'ore ang.”

English: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
Masaai: Amu eidimayu naa tenelo olkitok lai olaiguanani aaku tenebo loo menye naaikenari nanu o Solomon olayioni lai anaa ilaitarruorrok.”

English: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
Masaai: Kuna ninche inkarn oo layiok le Esau: Elifas olayioni le Ada enkitok e Esau, Reul olayioni le Basement enkitok e Esau,

English: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aing'ae aikata oidima atiaaki Abraham inchere keitanak Sara inkera? Ore ake eyia, natoikio ninye enkayioni te nkata emoruao enye.”

English: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
Masaai: Kake etiaaka menye laisiaayiak lenyena, ‘Entasieku olkila oisul, enchopoki; naa entipik olgisoi enkaina enye, ninchopokiki namuka nkejek enyena;
