English: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
Masaai: Ore enkitoria o enkitoo o engolon oo nkitoriat naatii abori shumata pooki, neishori iltung'ana loo sinyat le Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul; ore enkitoria enye naa keaku enkitoria oo ntarasi, ore enkitoo pooki neisiai nening ninche.’

English: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
Masaai: Ore oshi embae nang'orishore keeya naa ng'ok, naa nkitanapat engolon oo ng'ok:

English: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
Masaai: Ore taaisere aa enkolong nasujita ene Nkitobirare, neiturrurrokino lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo Pilato,

English: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
Masaai: nepuo apa ninche Negeb, neitoki aapuonu Hebron; o Ahiman, o Sheshai, o Talmai, ore apa lelo le ishoi e Anak naa ine etii. (Eteshetaki apa Hebron ilarin oopishana te dukuya Soan te Misiri.)

English: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
Masaai: Itejo iyie, ‘Woi kewan ai, amu etoponayie Olaitoriani osina le mion ai, atalepori nanu too nkigorot aainei, nematum enkiyeng'iyeng.’

English: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
Masaai: abuaku aranyita osinkolio le nashe, nalimu nkiaasin inono e nking'asia.

English: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oitoreisho; eishope ninye te nkitoo; eishope Olaitoriani, neterretene ninye aishop engolon. Ee, eitasheyieki enkop, nemeigusugusieki ae kata;

English: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
Masaai: Indim iyie airriwai inkiwuang'at pee etum aashom, nikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Noona iyiook?’

English: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
Masaai: Nening apa Yakobo ajo einyala shekem entito enye Dina; netii apa ilayiok lenyena nkishu ti ong'ota, negira Yakobo eitu ejo ae o metaba anaa nepuonu ninche.

English: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Nanu doi ele laairorie, iyie,”

English: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eirriwaa Saul ilkiliku meshomo aaya Daudi, nejo ninye, “Kemuei ninye.”

English: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuo aalamari penyo aalam enkanasa, nejoki Yosef olaitasheikinoni le nkaji, enye, “Inyo, tusuja lelo tung'ana, ore ake pee inepu, tiaaki ninche, ‘Ainyoo pee itushukutuo entorrono te sidai? Ainyo pee itupurroitie enkikompe ai enkosholai?

English: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
Masaai: Irrugu keper ino, Olaitoriani, nilotu adou! Iseyie ildoinyo pee epuru!

English: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.
Masaai: Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani Farao oltau, nemeisho ninche meshomo.

English: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
Masaai: olayioni le Melea, olayioni le Mena, olayioni le Matata, olayioni le Natan, olayioni le Daudi,

English: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani, “Shomo amu, emasaai ai nageluno ninye pee eya enkarna ai aitayiolo iloreren, o laiguanak o nkera e Israel;

English: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
Masaai: Aimeibelekenyakino kulo pooki ninye, neitalaku elap, nesukeny ninye ejo, “Woi ninye ilo osot ntokitin neme nkunenyena - ae te nkata nabaa ilo asotoki kewan elaakinoto oo silen.”

English: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye irubat are too lpijat lo ng'obor le Nkai tioriong.

English: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
Masaai: Ore iyiook pooki oosiaisho te nkitoria ino - ilaitasheikinok, o lbalusuni, o laitasheikinok loo lkerenketi, o lkulikae arikok, nikitoning'okinote nchere pee eitobir olaiguanani enkitanapata, neitirrishi oleng, nchere ore pooki ng'ae oserem ae ai aashu tung'ani too nkolong'i tomon uni, metelekuake iyie lo aiguanani nenang'akini ninye eululu oo lng'atunyo.

English: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
Masaai: Enining'o! Aishoo intae enkidimata, metaa indimidimi aaitunyoi ilasuriaa o nkulupani, o engolon pooki e ilo mang'atinta, nemeeta enaiko intae.

English: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie oure enkarna ai, keilepaki intae enkolong e supatisho eetae enkishiunoto too naipuko enyena. Ipuopuo intae intigiranana anaa ilasho ooti ooitigiran epuku to lale.

English: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
Masaai: Etipikakitia ninche ate ing'apeta o Asherim te pooki doinyo naado, o tiabori pooki shani onyori.

English: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lo lmarei le Yeroboam oye tena anasa neinos ildiain. Ore pooki ng'ae oye tiong'ata neinos intaritik oloing'ang'e; amu Olaitoriani oiroro ena.” ’

English: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
Masaai: Enchoo eton pooki tung'ani etiu anaa pee eipoti.

English: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Anatot te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Almon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas naaudo.

English: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
Masaai: Eyioloi olpayian lenye too nkishomin neyioloi te neton tiatua lelo payiani le ina kop.

English: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
Masaai: Amu eilepa ninche aapuo Asiria eikununo anaa osikiria li ong'ata olimana openy; einyang'ua Efraim isintan.

English: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
Masaai: Neitoki ajo, “Engilie entubukoki” neigilie ninche eniare. “Neitoki ajo “Engilie ene uni;” neigilie ninche ene uni.

English: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
Masaai: Te neishir oltung'ani supat te nkaraki eretoto, nening Olaitoriani, nekordu ninye ninche aitayu ti atua enyamali enye pooki.

English: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD'S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
Masaai: Keyooki alotu too nkolong'i e siadi, paa ore ilo doinyo le nkaji o Laitoriani neitasheyieki aaitoodor too ldoinyo, neilepieki aaitogiroo too ldoinyo, ore loshon pooki nerukokino ninye,

English: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
Masaai: Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani: “Kaitirring'a nanu aing'orisho te manyisho ai, aing'or asipu anaa te ndama eirowuaja, anaa enkatampoi e nkoiliolio te nkata e nkisampuare eirowuaju.”

English: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Masaai: Ira iyie ewueji enkisudoroto te nanu, eikigolie iyie nanu te ng'olikinoto nikintaman nanu enkordunoto.

English: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
Masaai: nijo, Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani la aiguanani le Yuda, ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi; iyie o sinkan linono, o ltung'ana linono ooimu kuna shomito.

English: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
Masaai: Etua tenkaraki e nena ng'ok enyena naataasa, neas ntorrok te dukuya Olaitoriani, neibung olkerreti le Yeroboam. O tenkaraki sii ng'ok naataasa erikoki Isiraeli ing'ok.

English: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
Masaai: neoshoki Aron enkukuo nena kineji pokira are, aoshoki enkukuo te nkaraki Olaitoriani o te nkaraki Asasel.

English: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
Masaai: Mme neijia etiu lelo torrok, kake eikununo anaa suut naakutaa osiuo.

English: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
Masaai: Ore ineeiting'ie lelo pisia oare ooipila nimbung'ie lelo kererin oare le nkikodo e sahabu, nimbung'ie te nkalo e dukuya te nena keenta e nkila dorrop naatii ironyi.

English: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Keton ena kishomi eikeno; meboli ninye, nemeeta oltung'ani ojing'u aimu ina kishomi; amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, naa ine etijing'unye, neaku keton ninye eikeno.”

English: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
Masaai: Te negeluni apa kulie aitin, neaku nchomito etii olarrabal, Amaa, ketumi apa elong'o anaa empere ti atua nkalifuni artam te Israel?

English: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
Masaai: Amu iyookiki intae aatiu anaa olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli otoyu mbenek enyena, aashu anaa nkurman nemetii enkare.

English: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
Masaai: Ina pee ijoki isinkan linono, ‘Pooki ake pee intokiki aadol enkomom ai, tenelotu olalashe linyi oti tenebo intae.’

English: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
Masaai: Ena erubata oltung'ani torrono naing'uaa Enkai, enjung'ore naibalakinye ninye Enkai.

English: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
Masaai: “Naa keishooyo olalashe olikae, metaari metua, neishooyo menye enkerai, nedumakino nkera ntoiuo enye neishooyo ninche metaari metuata.

English: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
Masaai: kaing'ae otorikoyie ninche aimie ine negut? Anaa embarta naimita olpurkel, eitu apa ninche errorro.

English: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neaku sapuk oleng enchipai te Yerusalem, amu ore ebaiki enkata e Solomon olayioni le Daudi olaiguanani le Israel, eitu aekata etumi entoki naaijo ena te Yerusalem.

English: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.
Masaai: naayaki nanu iltung'ana pooki enitii anaa esiankiki narikuni ang aarikoki olpayian lenye. Aing'oru iyie enkishui o ltung'ani obo ake, ore iltung'ana pooki neserianu.”

English: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neyieng ninche ilkuoo le kerra le pasaka, te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan o lapa liare. Ore ilapolosak o Lawi nekurru, nepuo ninche aaitisiny ate, neyau ilasarri oopejori atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
Masaai: kulo ninche ilaiguanak le Edom.

English: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
Masaai: Ore naa taata iyie Olaitoriani, iyie Enkai, nisiligishore iyie ena bae sidai tialo osinka lino.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kaibelekeny nanu enkishopo ai nalo olarrabal, kake inchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Neibelekeny olaiguanani loo Siraeli enkishopo enye nepuo ninche olarrabal.

English: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ekanang'aki ninye erruat e mueyian ore lelo oololoito te nebo ninye nanang'aki atua olosilisili kitok aashu te neirridu inkiaasin enyena.

English: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
Masaai: Ore enkisisa ai naa ng'ejuk te nanu, ore enkawuo ai naa ng'ejuk anaake te nkaina ai.

English: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
Masaai: Naa tenincho ninye meshomo mincho ninye meshomo too nkaik naarook;

English: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
Masaai: Kake tenaa nabo ake etukutaki, naa ilarikok, nena lukuny oo loshon loo Siraeli, likinturrurrokino.

English: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.
Masaai: Nejo iltung'ana le Israel, “Itoduaa iyie ele tung'ani oilepua? Esipa eewuo ninye ailepu pee emor Israel; ore oltung'ani oar ninye metua, neitaaa ninye olaiguanani karsis te nkarsisisho kitok, neisho ninye entito enye neitaa enkaji e papaai lenye metalakunoyu te Israel.”

English: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
Masaai: nejing ninye atua eseriani; neeng'iyeng'a ninche too rruatin enye, lelo oopuo te supatisho.

English: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
Masaai: nchoo oldoinyo le Sion eng'idayu! Nchoo nena toyie e Yuda eng'idayu te nkaraki nkiguanat inono!

English: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
Masaai: “Enturrurrunye nipuonunu, entinyiku wootu te nebo, intae lo pisai loo loshon! Meyiolo ninche toki lelo oonap nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye oo nkeek, netoni aaomon ina ai nemeidim aitajeusho.

English: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.
Masaai: Nenutayu ina kitok; neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai nejoki Daudi, “Atunute.”

English: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
Masaai: Amu kaji aiko te nangiri aing'or ina torroni nalotu atua iltung'ana laainei? Arashu kaji aiko te nangiri te nadol ina mutata o lorere lai.”

English: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
Masaai: netooshokitio ninche iltung'ana laainei enkukuo, neishooyo ninche enkayioni aainosie emulayoi, nemir entito aainosie enaisho oo sabibu, netooko ninche ina aisho.

English: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
Masaai: Ina pee ewaliki Shetani Olaitoriani ejo, “Keure Yoab Enkai te mpesho?

English: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
Masaai: Ninye otalakua iyiook aitung'uaa enkitoria e naimin neidurrie iyiook maape enkitoria o Inoti lenye kirotet,

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: ng'ura, karriny nanu lelo ootarayioki too lng'oborri le Yakobo, naing'urrie imanyishoritin enyena. Neitokini aashet nkanas too wuejitin apa neetelekutua neitashe enkaji enkitoo te wueji apake neitasheyie.

English: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
Masaai: Neshetu ilperereni loo lasarri tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, laa ninche apa etejo Olaitoriani “Atua Yerusalem etonie enkarna ai ntarasi.”

English: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ninye eishir, neishir sii Lyahudi ooiriamunore, nenyamalu to ltau lenye netum osina,

English: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
Masaai: Kake eitajeuo Olaitoriani Israel, te njeunoto oo ntarasi; mikintukurruni iyie nimikisuli o akenya.

English: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
Masaai: Neitoki aya olmoti obore nkuk naaishu naaing'uaa olperere lo lasar te dukuya Olaitoriani, o mboreitin are enkaina enkorropil naidongoki aarrar; neyau ninye atua lelo karash lo lng'obor

English: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Lo Kitok, ai ng'ae ilo pee atum airuko ninye?”

English: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore olasar lenye naa olasar opejori oing'uaa eluaata oo nkishu, neyau ninye olbung'ae lemeeta entioto, neishooyo ninye te kutuk aji olng'obor le ntumo, pee etum ninye ataa keng'amaroyu te dukuya Olaitoriani;

English: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
Masaai: Ekeilep oleng aalang keper, kainyoo indim ataasa? Egut alang enemeneng'a, kainyoo indim atayiolo?

English: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
Masaai: Naa teneboitare oltung'ani ninye, nejing olduruk leina kitok ninye, neaku ninye oloiduruk nkolong'i naapishana; ore pooki dapash nairrag ninye neiduruku.

English: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
Masaai: Neaku naa taata, nchooki nanu ena kop oo ldoinyo apa naa ninye eimaka Olaitoriani ina olong; amu itoning'o apa iyie ina olong eneikununo ile Anakim te ine, eeta nkang'itie naasheta kituaak; ebaiki netii Olaitoriani te nebo nanu, naa kamiraa nanu ninche aipang'ie anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.”

English: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
Masaai: Ore enkewarie pooki neme iloik laainei, ore emion naaitame nanu nemeyagaa.

English: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
Masaai: Neaku ore ninche o nena pooki naara nkunenye nedoyio eishu aapuo enemeneng'a neikeno enkop te shumata ninche, neidak ninche te mpolos e ina umata.

English: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
Masaai: Metaa etaa Yakobo karsis oleng, netum intare luaat kumok, o nkaisiaayiak o ilaisiaayiak o intamesin o sirkon.

English: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Masaai: Neitoki asuju olosho le Benchamen, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Benchamen naa Abidan olayioni le Gideon,

English: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
Masaai: Nipikipiki iltung'ana oare lemeeta tipat, meetu aaitang'or ninye. Naa nchoo ninche eishankarrarre ninye ejo, ‘Itediaa iyie Enkai o laiguanani!’ Nimbung'ubung'u taa ninye aaya auluo, ninang'inang'a too soito metua.”

English: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
Masaai: Ng'ura itoning'o iyie enaitaasa ilaiguanak le Asiria nkuapi pooki, eidaike ninche katukul. Paa ijo iyie eikikorduni?

English: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
Masaai: “Ene enkiting'oto e ina bae. Ore tialo nanu Daniel, aaitanyamala ndamunot aainei oleng, neibelekenya emua o sesen lai; kake atushuma ina bae too ndamunot aainei.”

English: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
Masaai: etuuno ninche nkurman, neun nkurman oo sabibu netum enkisampuare kitok.

English: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
Masaai: Neteyieng'a nkishu enyena, eitushula enaisho enye oo sabibu, neitobira sii emisa enye.

English: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
Masaai: Ore olotashare ninche neitobir aram Yedia olayioni le Harumap, ina kipirakinoto e nkaji enye. Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Hatush olayioni le Hashabneia.

English: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Bildad le Shushi awal ajo:

English: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
Masaai: shomo iyie tudumunye tusujai Olaitoriani Enkai ino niureyu ninye, nimbung nkitanapat enyena nining oltoilo lenye, nisiai ninye nimbung'are ninye.

English: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
Masaai: ilayiok le Hebron: Kora, Tapua, o Rekem o Shema,

English: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
Masaai: nedotu Olaitoriani ninche aitung'uaa enkop enye te ngoro o te mpijan o te ngoro sapuk, nenang'aki ninche atua ae kop, anaa enatiu ena olong.’

English: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
Masaai: Ore enkolong o enkolong neinosakino lomon, ore enkewarie o enkewarie neibalunye eng'eno.

English: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
Masaai: “Ore ilo tung'ani, ilo kitok leina kop, eirorie iyiook te nkisikong'ata, neiko iyiook anaa aikira ilaikitalak leina kop.

English: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Mpotu ninye.” Ore ake pee eipotu ninye, nelotu ninye aitashe te kutukaji.

English: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
Masaai: Neitoki Yonatan ajoki ninye, “Ore taisere naa olapa ng'ejuk; naa eikilai iyie, enkaraki nemetii toki olorika lino.

English: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
Masaai: Olaiguanani magilani, onyor isipat; intasheyie iyie esipata; ninguana iyie te sipata o te supatisho ti atua Yakobo.

English: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu ng'ura, etii ilarikok le njore enkiguana, nejo ninye, “Aata olkilikuai lino lo kitok le njore.” Nejoki, Yehu, “Kalo obo te iyiook pooki.” Nejoki ninye, “Iyie lo kitok.”

English: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
Masaai: Nchoo ilo tung'ani metotiwuo anaa nkanas naaibelekenya Olaitoriani metii olng'ur; nchoo ninye ening olkiyioi tadekenya oltoilo le batisho dama,

English: And again he entered into Capernaum, after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
Masaai: Ore pee errinyo, Kapernaum eishari nkuti olong'i, nening'i aajo etii ang.

English: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
Masaai: “Te nepuku oloirirua torrono aing'uaa oltung'ani neimaa wuejitin neetoito eing'oru eneyeng'iyeng'are, nelau;

English: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
Masaai: Ore pee edalu enkolong nepej, ore enkaraki meeta ntona netoyu.

English: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i tomon nedoli aajo ninche oopir naa biot aalang lelo barnot pooki ooinos endaa sidai o laiguanani.

English: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Nejoki ilang'eni le tung'ana Farao, “Olkimojino le Nkai ele.” Kake eitogoloki oltau le Farao neaku mening ninche; anaa enatejo apa Olaitoriani.

English: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
Masaai: toning'o iyie itii keper enkomono enye o esayiata enye, nintagol ninche.

English: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Naa keaku ninche ine Aron o noo layiok lenyena, erubata enye naisho ninche iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaake, too lasarri lenye le seriani; neaku olasar lenye to Laitoriani.

English: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
Masaai: na aji e Daudi! Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Tudung'o enkiguana te sipata tadekenya, niyau aitung'uaa enkaina e ilo oitorogonyisho ilo oitorongonyaki mepuku ake engoro ai anaa enkima, neyupuyup nemeetae oltung'ani oidim atara, tenkaraki nkiaasin inyi torrok.

English: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in flotes by sea to Joppa; and thou shall carry it up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa aikidung'u iyiook mbaoi naaba anaa iniyieu te Lebanon, nikiyaki iyie too rridat aaimunye enaiposha e Yopa, pee itum iyie aawa Yerusalem.”

English: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
Masaai: Ntajeu iltung'ana linono, nimayian enjeunoto ino; laa iyie olchekut lenye ninap ninche ntarasi.

English: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, toning'o oltoilo lai! Nchoo nkiyiaa inono meinining'o oltoilo le sayiata ai!

English: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
Masaai: Nelo taa Daniel atua ine netii Ariok, laa ninye etegelua olaiguanani meidaikie lelo tung'ana ang'eni le Babilon, nelo ajoki ninye nji, “Mindaikie iyie lelo tung'ana ang'eni le Babilon; torikoki nanu mashomo dukuya olaiguanani, pee alo aitodol olaiguanani ina kibalakinoto.”

English: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
Masaai: Amu te Yerusalem epuku ilo pisiai, naa to ldoinyo le Sion epuku olturrur le lelo ooleku. Olom lo Laitoriani olo aas ena.

English: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
Masaai: Ng'ura elotu ninye too nkatampo, naa kedol pooki ong'u ninye, lelo pooki ootaremo ninye ore loshon pooki le nkop, neyietu neishir te nkaraki ninye. Neijia taa Esai.

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
Masaai: neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Usa; neosh ninye tenkaraki naitorioyie enkaina enye aibung ilo sanduku; neye ninye teine te dukuya Enkai.

English: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
Masaai: Amu ore ina kisudoroto e ngogong'i neasisho taata, ore ilo oibooyo ninye neiko neijia o metaba anaa neiwuang'ieki ninye.

English: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Amu etiaka Olaitoriani Musa,

English: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
Masaai: Ore Sebadia o Meshulam, o Hiski, o Heber,

English: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.
Masaai: Keidim engolon ino e oshoke atobikoi, arashu keidim inkaik inyi aatagol, te nena olong'i naalotu aarare iyie? Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro, naa kaas ina.

English: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
Masaai: Ore apa olpolosie le nkalo o loo ntoluo naa ina aiposha kitok o ilo omanaa lenye. Ele ninye olpolosie omanita iltung'ana le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya neipang Yonatan alo atua enkurma ewueji netoning'okinote o Daudi, nelo te nebo ninye enkiti ayioni.

English: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
Masaai: Nesotokino enkanasa pooki enkalo e kutuk aji.

English: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Isikong'a iyie iloshon, ndaikie iyie lelo torrok; aitujutoyie iyie aiwuang'ie enkarna enye ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
Masaai: ilo tung'ani magilani o sikari, o larishani o loiboni le Nkai, o laitumusumusoni o lpayian,

English: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
Masaai: ore olosujaki ninye naa Eser olayioni le Yoshua, ilo aitoriani le Mispa, neitobir aram enkae rishata, enkipirakinoto e wueji neshumieki imasaa o larrabal teine nelojare e suntai.

English: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
Masaai: Neijia etiu oltung'ani eirrag nemeitoki adumunye; o metaa meetae keper, meitoki adumunye, arashu edumuni aaitung'uaa injo enyena.

English: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
Masaai: Eitu kiel endukuya te ilata, kake aaela ninye nkejek te na ilata.

English: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
Masaai: Neaku ore eidipayu nena, neruk nkanas sapuki o nkutiti elikioo ilo rorei neyaki lomon supati le nkitoria e Nkai. Neiriamariyie ilooiteng'eni lenyena tomon o aare ninye,

English: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
Masaai: Kake ore taata, amu meekure aata dikai wueji naisiaaishore te kulo kirinen, naa larin kumok ayieu ake nalotu abaiki intae,

English: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
Masaai: Ore amu kaaisilig ajo ining'isho, aaigeroki kuna ayiolo ajo ias oleng aitulus enatejo.

English: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
Masaai: naa keureisho sii ninche teine neika, netii enkuretisho enkoitoi; neitapuka aipilipil olchani oji olmolosi, onyaanyukie oseki, nekedoo entargeeti elo; neish eyieuna enye; amu elo oltung'ani ewueji enye nebikie intarasi, ore lelo aishirak nepuaya too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Solomon ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto neigeroki tiatua embuku oo nkatinin e Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai o tiatua e naibon e Ahija le Shilon, o too nduaat e Ido ilo aduaani, eipirta Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

English: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
Masaai: Nening olayioni le nkanashe Paulo ina rreshoto enye nelo ajing emanyata neliki Paulo.

English: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
Masaai: “Aime toki te intae pooki, lelo oogiroo? eng'ura nidolidolo, tenaa keetae osina onyaanyukie osina lai oyawuaki shumata nanu, ilo laatipika Olaitoriani teina olong e ngoro enye napi.

English: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening Ilfarisayo inchere eitigira Isadukayo nepuo aatumo.

English: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
Masaai: Neilepaki enkolong egiroo Penuel, neitong'ojinari te nkaraki enkupes enye.

English: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
Masaai: Nejo Saul, “Eyautua ninche too Lamaleki; amu etelekutua iltung'ana nkerra sidain o lmong'i, pee epolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai; ore nkulie nikitumuta iyiook tukul.”

English: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
Masaai: Neinos Gedalia olmumai tialo ninche o ltung'ana lenye, ejo, “Emiureishoyu intae te nkaraki ilkituaak loo lkaldayo. Entobik intae tena kop, nisiaayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon, amu keserianu te intae.”

English: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
Masaai: Neibung ninche ninye near metua, nenang'aki auluo ina kurma oo sabibu.

English: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
Masaai: Nelo apa Samson Gasa, nedol ninye emulayoi te ine, nelo enetii ninye.

English: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
Masaai: Naa ena apa enkitobirunoto e ilo iket lo ltaa, naa sahabu naidongoki ebaiki entonata enye o metabaiki ntapuka enyena esiaai e nkidong'ore, te risioroto e ilo rrekie otuutaka Olaitoriani Musa. Neaku eitobirua ninye ilo iket.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, “Nairriwaki nanu enkop olameyu; mme olameyu le ndaa aashu olameyu le nkure e nkare, kake oloning'ieki ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
Masaai: Neitoki Rispa entito e Aia aya ilkuniyiani neisalaashaki te ndapidapoi ebaiki enkiterunoto e nkisampuare o metaba anaa neshaiki enchan ninche eing'uaa shumata; neitu ninye eisho imotonyi o loing'ang'e epuonu aadoiki ninche te ndama, arashu ing'uesi e ong'ata te nkewarie.

English: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
Masaai: Neitayu to sesen lenye inkilani enyena e nkoliai, nepika enkarasha aitoipie elukunya enye peyie medoli enkomom, nelotu aton te kishomi e Enaim, natii enkoitoi nalala nalo Timna; amu etodua ajo etubulua Shela, neitu eishori ninye meyama.

English: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
Masaai: Ore naa taata na Ai e Israel, nchoo ilo rorei lino meitabari apa lirorie osinka lino Daudi, papaai lai.

English: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
Masaai: Nemusu Daudi ajo eitasheyie Olaitoriani ninye metaa olaiguanani le Israel, ore enkitoria enye neisisi oleng te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena Israel.

English: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
Masaai: tung'uai teine enkishoroto te mbata o lperere lo lasar, shomo; tang'asa toning'ore olalashe lino, pee intoki ashukunye aitayu enkishoroto ino.

English: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
Masaai: Neing'oru ninche eneiko pee eibung, kake etureita olorere, amu etayioloito aajo ninche eipirta ina kitanyaanyukoto; neaku eshomo aaing'uaa.

English: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.
Masaai: Eidimayu pee eing'or Olaitoriani osina lai, naa kaalaaki nanu Olaitoriani too supati tele deket lena olong.”

English: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye too nkiasin enyena sapuki; meisisi ninye te risioroto e nkitoo enye sapuk!

English: He said, Bring them hither to me.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eyakaki.”

English: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki neitu iyie ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani, neitu intabaya ina goro enye napi aarare Amalek, neaku kintaasa iyie Olaitoriani ena bae ena olong.

English: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
Masaai: nelotu olkilikuai enetii Yoab nejoki, “Ore duoo eturito ilmong'i enkurma nedaa isirkon tembata enye;

English: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
Masaai: “Oi lekua ooisikarra te Sion, o lekua oodol eserian to ldoinyo le Samaria, lelo tung'ana ning'ot le dukuya too loshon, laa ninche esaru olosho le Israel!

English: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
Masaai: eiteng'en iyiook maibai nena pooki neme nne Enkai, o ng'uarrat e nkop, nikitoni te nkiririkinoto, te nkitorioroto o to rrekie le Enkai tena kop,

English: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche lelo ooikena Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, laa ninche esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel too nkisiajat e Moab te mbata olkeju le Yordan te Yeriko.

English: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
Masaai: Atushuma nanu ororei lino to ltau lai, pee maas ake eng'oki ti alo iyie.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tayooki inyo tadekenya taanyu Farao elotu enetii enkare, nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.

English: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
Masaai: Nebol ninche nkutukie enye aaing'orie shumata, neidapashaki ilng'ejepa lenye enkop.

English: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
Masaai: Nelotu olaiteng'enani loo nkitanapat nejoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, kaasuj pooki weuji nilo.”

English: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
Masaai: Irriwua iyie enchan kitok, Enkai, nintagol enjung'ore ino enaurate;

English: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
Masaai: “Najoki nanu nkera enye tiong'ota, emipuoyie nena kitanapat o loo papaai linyi, arashu isujusuju inkiguanat enye, arashu indurukiekie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Meeta nchere pee eitu kiyookiki aadung'ie rashe aajoki, ‘Olabaani tabaa kewan,’ nijojo, ‘Taasa sii iyie te ine nitubulaka, mbaa nijo nena nikitoning'o nchere itaasa te Kapernaum.’ ”

English: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
Masaai: Neya ninye arik iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni imiet, nepik ninche atua olnukata te rishata e Betel o Ai, te nkalo o loo ntoluo le nkanasa.

English: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
Masaai: Ore empalai e nena naaigeroki naa keishoori anaa enkitanapata te pooki osho, o te nkitayioloto oo ltung'ana pooki, nerretena Ilyahudi pee eitalaku elap enye te lelo mang'ati lenye.

English: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
Masaai: Nening Daudi ti ong'ata nchere ebarnita Nabal nkerra enyena.

English: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
Masaai: Atisila nanu ninche te silet nasilishoreki, too nkang'itie pooki eina kop; aishirie nanu ninche, aidaikie nanu iltung'ana kumok; neitu ninche eibelekenya aaing'uaa nkoitoi enye.

English: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumu ilo piyayati le mbuku, nebatata nena ng'uesi naaishu ong'uan te dukuya ilo kuoo le ker, nemeetae ake enemeibung'ita enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, o ngirran e sahabu naabore empuruonarropil naa enkomono oo sinyat.

English: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
Masaai: Aatamana ninche anaa lotorok, neyupuyup anaa enkima oo lkiku; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!

English: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon ooudo Petahia, nedoiki ene tikitam Yeheskel,

English: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
Masaai: Ore enabayie ilalashera naa inchere, ore pooki naasipa, ore pooki nayanyitayu, ore pooki naata errepet sidai, te netii orrekie sidai netii orrekie oiririkino enkisisa, kuna entadamu.

English: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku tara, neton te misa tenebo looiteng'eni lenyena tomon aare.

English: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
Masaai: Entishipata te nkaraki ina hoo ninye, te naa aimeeta inchere pee mitumutumu intemat oo mpukunot kumok te nkiti kata,

English: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Art thou that Daniel, which art of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?
Masaai: Neitijing'uni Daniel meeu dukuya olaiguanani. Nejoki olaiguanani Daniel, “Ira iyie lido Daniel, apa ora obo loo yarunot le Yuda, apa oyaua olaiguanani papa lai te Yuda.

English: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
Masaai: Toning'o naa taata, amu kitegelua iyie Olaitoriani pee ishet enkaji naaku ewueji sinyati; ntagoluoyu taasa ina.”

English: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.
Masaai: Neaku etokordua Olaitoriani Israel ina olong; ore olarrabal negiroo te idiaalo Bes-afen.

English: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
Masaai: Eewuo emutata enitii iyie, oi intae oomanya ina kop; etabawua enkata, etinyikua ina olong enkolong enkishirata neme enkolong nabuakuni too nchumat e lelo doinyo.

English: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
Masaai: Nedumunye Samuel, neilep te Gilgal alo Gibea e Benchamen. Neiken Saul iltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye, naa iltung'ana oobaya iip ile.

English: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina emainyeito aapuo auluo enkang oo lng'oborri, nikinapaki nena morot.

English: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
Masaai: Naa tena oitoi inyanya; eena ntae impolosi, etii namuka nkejek inyi netii ng'udisin inyi nkaik inyi; ninyanya te naipuk. Eng'iroroto ena o Laitoriani.

English: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
Masaai: Amu kining ake inchere etii kulikae linyi ootoni ti atua enturuaisho neitanyamaluo too siaaitin e kulikae nemeeta esiaai naas.

English: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
Masaai: Newalu Petero nejoki Yesu, “Olaiteng'enani, aisidai kitii ene; nchoo iyiook kishetu ilng'oborri okuni, olino obo o le Musa obo o le Eliya obo.”

English: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
Masaai: Amu enkaina o Laitoriani etii enkikompe, etii enaisho naitokitok naing'oling'olaki aaitobiraki, nepiku ninye, neok lelo aarruok pooki.

English: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
Masaai: o Lyebusi o Lamori, o Lgirgashi,

English: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
Masaai: Iroshiyie iltauja le kulo tung'ana, nintiming'ana nkiyiaa enye, ninkeno nkonyek enye; pee medolisho too nkonyek enye, nemening'isho too nkiyiaa enye, neyiolou too ltauja lenye, neibelekenya pee eishiunyeki.”

English: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: apa naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa te nchumata oldoinyo le Sinai, ina olong apa naitanapa ninye iltung'ana le Israel pee eyaki nkishorot enye Olaitoriani to lpurkel le Sinai.

English: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le dukuya te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan o lapa te nkalo e nteipa, ninyanya imukateni neitu eisuijieki ninkoko neijia o metabaiki enkolong e tikitam o obo o lapa te nkalo e nteipa.

English: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
Masaai: Neipang'unye ninche ina ng'ape apa natii enkaji e Baal, nepejoo.

English: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
Masaai: Nchoo loreren mikisisa iyie, na Ai, nchoo loreren pooki mikisisa iyie!

English: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
Masaai: Ore etonita ninche te mesa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ilo oiboni apa otorrinyuo ninye ariku;

English: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
Masaai: Ina pee eyilou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani ina kata naitaa ina kop enkop mitil naitomijoon naa ene pesho te nkaraki nena baa olminong lenye pooki naataasa ninche.

English: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
Masaai: Naa ti niosh abuaku ore lelo ng'oborri ootii enkalo o loo saen nedumunye,

English: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: “Emayiana lelo ooisilisili te nkaraki enayieu Enkai amu enenye enkitoria e keper.

English: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
Masaai: Nejo ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Embung'a Mikaia eyaki Amon olbalusui le nkanasa, o Yoash olayioni lo laiguanani;

English: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
Masaai: Kebaa naa elusoo, te netaara iltung'ana torrok oltung'ani supat ti atua enkaji enye te nchumata e ndapash enye, aimaikilikuanu nanu osarge lenye te nkaina inyi, namut intae aiwuang'ie te nkop?”

English: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
Masaai: Anaa esong'uana narropil ekang'amaa intae, ina kata naitupuku intae too loreren, naiturrurru intae aitung'uaa nena kuapi pooki naaidapashakaki intae; naa kaibalunye esinyatisho ai tiatua intae edolita iloreren pooki.

English: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
Masaai: Amu einos ninche endaa enkarruoisho, neok enaisho oo sabibu naikonyuno te ng'olon.

English: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
Masaai: Nebuaku kulikae ejo ena nebuaku kulikae ejo ai: amu eing'oling'ole ina tumo: naa aimeyiolo esejata sapuk ajo aainyo pee eiturrurroteki te nebo.

English: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Abna te nebo iltung'ana tikitam enetii Daudi te Hebron, neitobiraki Daudi osirua Abna o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
Masaai: ore olasar le seriani naa, ilmong'i, oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Ahira olayioni le Enan.

English: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
Masaai: Ore epuoito ninche einosaa lomon, ng'ura, nerish ninche pokira oare engarri oo mbartan e nkima. Nelo Eliya to lkutati shumata.

English: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
Masaai: Ore shumata sunta inono iyie Yerusalem, atipika nanu ilarripok; endama pooki o enkewarie pooki, nemegira ae kata ninche. Ore intae lelo oodamu Olaitoriani nemiyeng'iyeng'ang'a,

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Iwa lelo arikok pooki loo ltung'ana, ililio ninche to ldalati te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee etum ina goro napi o Laitoriani atapaasha Israel.”

English: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
Masaai: Amu nena pooki eing'oru iloreren lemeyiolo Enkai; amu eyiolo Papa linyi le shumata ajo iyieuu nena pooki.

English: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
Masaai: lelo apa ooidaikieki te Endor, lelo otaa nkik te nkop.

English: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu iyie; ntajeuoki nanu; pee atum atisipu enchakenisho ino.

English: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
Masaai: Neboreyu intae ilng'anayio le supatisho, ooimu atua Yesu Kristo, neyau enkitoo e enkisisa e Nkai.

English: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nedumu ilapolosak ilo sanduku.

English: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
Masaai: etiaaka ninche olbalusui nchere pee meinos ina daa sinyati oleng, meteleku ake tenaa ketii olapolosani oikilikuanishore Urim o Tumim.

English: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, “Keitu apa nanu akordu intae aitung'uaa Ilmisiri naitung'uaa Ilamori, naitung'uaa Ilamoni naitung'uaa Ilfilisti?

English: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
Masaai: Eisidai te neishori Olaitoriani enashe, pee eranyi enkisisa e nkarna ino, iyie Olotii shumata Aisul;

English: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
Masaai: Kake kitanang'ayioki iyie aaiturraa, aaitalam enkurare ino, anaa enkaitubului nemeyieuni, neitemori too mpopoki e lelo ootuata, te lelo ootaaraki to lalem, lelo oosulakino isoito le ululu, anaa empopok naitunyi too nkejek.

English: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
Masaai: Eiguran nkera enye anaa lkuoo le kerra, neiguran nkera enye aaipid.

English: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
Masaai: Nepuonu sii lkumok le lelo ooiruko, neirridu, neibalunye nkiaasin enye.

English: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli ti atua empolos e naiposha aaim enkop natoyio, etaa nkariak esuntai te ninche te nkaina e tatene o te kedienye.

English: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Olaitoriani olmeitai iltung'ana, enkaraki naitayutuo ilo ashe oitayio Aron.

English: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kintamanaki irresheta, nikijing aluam olkirutoto.

English: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
Masaai: olmaati: le meeta olaiguanani, kake epuo pooki aairiamari to lturrur obo;

English: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu eirut olaiguanani aashu lelo sinkan lenyena ootoning'o kulo rorei neitu epolos nkilani enye.

English: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
Masaai: Amu ore enkaji pooki e papa lai netaa ninche iltung'ana ooishiaakino keeya te dukuya olkitok lai olaiguanani; kake itipika apa iyie osinka lino atua lelo oodaa te mesa ino. Kainyoo naa ai sipata naata nanu, naa, pee aishiraki olaiguanani?”

English: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ilarin ntomoni ile oltung'ani neilep neaku ore entemata e nkinyiang'a ino tialo olee naa keaku shekeli tomon o imiet, ore te ng'oruoi naa keaku shekeli tomon.

English: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei ninye oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
Masaai: Tadamu naa ilo likintobirua too nkolong'i e kitisho ino, eton eitu epuonu inkolong'i torrok, nenyikaa ilarin oleng, ina kata nilotu ajo, “Maatayie ninche enchipai;”

English: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Maajoki metabaiki katitin naapishana, kake metabaiki ntomoni naapishana katitin naapishana.

English: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Musa; te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye, neaku etaasa ninye.

English: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
Masaai: Kepuonu ninche aadung entim enye, Olaitoriani ojo. Hoo nemeikenayu amu eikumok ninche aalang olmaati; meeta ninche esiana.

English: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
Masaai: Neaku eitoreisho Daudi te Israel pooki, neitoreisho ninye too sipat o too nkiririkinot too ltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
Masaai: iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni artam ooterretenate te nkaraki olarrabal ootalang'a te dukuya Olaitoriani aapuo olarrabal, aapuo nkisiajat e Yeriko.

English: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: meetae iruparen naitobiraki pee earieki intae naapuo aaku, ore pooki ng'ejep odumakino intae te nkiguana, nintukurrurru. Ena ninye enjung'ore oo sinkan lo Laitoriani naa kailepie nanu ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
Masaai: Neiroshiu neiu enkayioni, nedung'oki ninye enkarna ajo Eri.

English: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
Masaai: Kaa naa kijo enoto papa lang Abraham to rrekie lo sesen?

English: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
Masaai: eitasheyieki olorika lino le nkitoo apa moitie; itii iyie ebaiki apa ntarasi.

English: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
Masaai: Metaa eishoo apa ninche mpisai ilaguetak loo soito, o laguetak loo mbaoi, o endaa, o enaoki o eilata aaisho ile Sidon o le Turo, pee eyau iltarakua te Lebanon, aaya enaiposha, neya Yopa, te risioroto e nkishoroto nanoto apa ninche te Sairos olaiguananile Parsia.

English: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Amasa, “Mpoto iltung'ana le Yuda te nebo meetu enatii ti atua nkolong'i uni, nitii iyie ene makewan.”

English: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
Masaai: Ore eiriamariyie olorora kitok, neibelekenyakino nejoki,

English: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
Masaai: Ore pee kibatata te nkop, naning oltoilo laajoki te nkutuk oo Lhebrania, ‘Saulo, Saulo, aainyo pee kisilisil? Iyie doi omeyu te niroro ljipeta!'

English: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
Masaai: o Hadoram, o Usal, o Dikla,

English: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
Masaai: Neya ninche nkishu enye, o ntamesin enye nkalifuni onom, o nkerra nkalifuni iip are o onom, o sirkon nkalifuni are, o ltung'ana ooishu nkalifuni iip nabo.

English: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
Masaai: Pesho ake nanu aitisinya oltau lai, naituku nkaik aainei te sinyatisho.

English: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
Masaai: “Ore Finehas, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron olapolosani, neiwuang'ie engoro ai too laiguanani nchere eeta ninye olom lai ti atua ninche, metaa eitu nanu amut iltung'ana le Israel to lom lai.

English: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye eng'idare oltau lai, nchoo ilo oata osina ening neng'ida.

English: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
Masaai: neisho ninye iliatuani leina aji meiutuuti nkaloli pooki, ore ina punyua nayutuutuni nepuoi aaibukoo te wueji neiduruk tiauluo enkanasa;

English: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
Masaai: Tudumunye, shomo taarare ina kop te leleki, etonita te seriani Olaitoriani ojo, ina nemeeta nchomito aashu isekenke, ina nabikito openy.

English: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
Masaai: Nelo Yesu te ine aito enkalo o lkerenket le Turo o Sidon.

English: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
Masaai: Metaa neitashe Paulo te dukuya ilo kiu le Areopago, nejo, “Lo lewa le Atene, adolita ajo ore te pooki oitoi irara ilaseremak oleng.

English: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
Masaai: neibatisai pooki to lkeju le Yordan eirridu ng'ok enye.

English: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni le njore liokuni, to lapa liokuni, naa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida ilo apolosani, aa ninye olkitok; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel. Ore apa te nena olong'i neing'oru olosho le Dan enjung'ore enye maate ewueji nemany; amu ore ebaiki ina kata meetae enjung'ore ti atua iloshon loo Siraeli nanoto ninche.

English: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eibooki oloirujuruj ore enchan oo nkokua neitu elotu, kake ore eyia eton ake inkununo anaa e mulayioi itanya iyie ikurru.

English: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atupukoi nkolong'i artam dama o kewarie.

English: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
Masaai: Neisiaai Israel Olaitoriani too nkolong'i pooki e Yoshua, o nkolong'i pooki e lelo payiani apa ootung'uayie Yoshua, apa ooyiolo esiaai pooki nataasa Olaitoriani te nkaraki Israel.

English: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, entarany enkisisa enye te umata oo supati!

English: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
Masaai: Wou, maiputa ate enchipai ang omekenyu; matishipakinoto ate te nyorrata.

English: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
Masaai: Nesai pee mearaa ninche meshomo olodo le nkop.

English: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
Masaai: Etung'uaitie enkoitoi naitoriori, eibaabaa aasuj inkoitoi e Balaam olayioni le Beor, otonyorra dupoto naing'uaa eyasata oo ntorrok.

English: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
Masaai: Ore sii apa Efa ina apiani e Kaleb, neiu Haran, o Mosa o Geses, naa Haran apa menye le Geses.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel; keas apa pooki ng'ae enaba anaa esidai too nkonyek enyena makewan.

English: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo shani onyaanyukie olayakuji lelokeek, ‘Tinikibukokiki nanu eilata aaitaa olaiguanani maitoria intae, wootu naa entaseriana to loip lai; naa te neme neijia, nchoo meipang'u enkima te ilo shani loo lkiku nemut lelo tarakua le Lebanon.’

English: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le nkitok e Hodia, ina anashe e Naham, naa iloomenye le Keila le Garmit o Eshtemoa le Maakuti.

English: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
Masaai: Kitaboitate tenebo iyie kulo arin tikitam; netiu aikata eibiru isupeni e kerra inono anaa inkineji inono, neitu ainos ilmeregeshi loo ntare inono.

English: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
Masaai: Asaria menye le Seraia, naa Seraia le Yehosadak;

English: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
Masaai: Naitoki aing'orisho naning olkurragos oishirita to ltoilo sapuk eipirri te mpolos o loing'ang'e nejo, “Wooi, Wooi, Wooi, ninche lelo oomanya enkop, te nkaraki enkorui e nena tarumpetani netaa keosh ilmalaika okuni.”
